But when the Son of Man comes in his glory , and all the holy angels with him , then he will sit on the throne of his glory . ||| La'pa Rimormiori A'na A Muai owa'an de hota Agodi plo'lu-mneh ' u . Then the King will tell those on his right hand , ‘ Come , blessed of my Father , inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world , ||| Nhor nia'nama Agodi plolli emeka Ray pa A'ukot la mak kden la A wa'lu malganna pa giwra , Hononmi mmiai , yoma A A'mu Nara ' a-napalga miy . Mai pia mliola rialam la ' a Uplerlawna gen warwuarnu maka Ha Nwahi ' targa tiy miy la ' a ler maka Uplerlawna Na'ohi-na'ara nohkerna-rai miaran di .
for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat . I was thirsty and you gave me drink . I was a stranger and you took me in . ||| Yoma la ' lerni la A'uplara , de mimial pa A'una , me A tie'ru kerna de mial pa Agemnu . Me la ' lerni A'uhulti-uhamra , de mhiaria nhiari mai A ' u .
I was naked and you clothed me . I was sick and you visited me . I was in prison and you came to me . ' ||| A'uniki-ulai mere miala naniair mai A ' u . Alier la nnieni-nhiena , miy er mak kodi atiawi mai A ' u . Alier la roma nhio'la ralamni de ma mtiomra-mniah ' a pa mtiulan mai A ' u .
Then the righteous will answer him , saying , ‘ Lord , when did we see you hungry and feed you , or thirsty and give you a drink ? ||| Noma riy mak kholi-kleta la plol wawna rakot ma A ' u , riwra , Matroma , mowenia mamkek nana Matro'mu Narehka-naplara pa amalla Matro'mu Na'ana-nemnu ?
When did we see you as a stranger and take you in , or naked and clothe you ? ||| Ne mowenia itwatrom de , Matro'mu emeknekama mak kahulti-kahamra pa amreiniana Matro'mu la a rom mamni ? Ne la ' hanmeni la amlernana Matro'mu de Muniki-mulai piede amala naniair pa Omhu'ru la ?
When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you ? ' ||| Me mowen pia amamkek nana Matro'mu temni nhi ' a onde Mdiella roma nhio'la pede am tiy mtulan tiy O ' a Matrome ?
The King will answer them , ‘ Most certainly I tell you , because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers , you did it to me . ' ||| Noma A'ukot la re , Totpena miatga , la ' a hya ' ed maka ha mhi ' a la A i'nu-na'ru mak kakleha weli ho'mana hade emekwalima mhi ' oleka harella mai A ' u .
Then he will say also to those on the left hand , ‘ Depart from me , you cursed , into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels , ||| Noma hota A'ukot la mak kden la A wa'lu malwiru re giwra , Ratar doin miy lia A wa'lu malwir di ! Hota mlier la nhiorghala-wniaghala ralamni la ai mormiori mak kmormior pia nodi liarni maka ha rhi ' targa la hegana amlawanni nor wutga hopopanni re , pa mior wutga la hande .
for I was hungry , and you did n't give me food to eat , I was thirsty , and you gave me no drink , ||| Yoma la ' lerni la A'urehka-uplara de miy edonna mial pa a'una-gemnu .

' ||| La ' lerni la A'uhulti-uhamra mana miy edonna mrieinian A lia miy likatmi . Uniki-ulai miana miy edonna mhierun nana A naniai'ru la A te'mu , me Adiella roma nhio'la me Alier la mehra-mau mana miy edonna mtiomra-mniah ' a pa mtiulla-msiayn A ' u .
Then they will also answer , saying , ‘ Lord , when did we see you hungry , or thirsty , or a stranger , or naked , or sick , or in prison , and did n't help you ? ' ||| Noma mak kden la malwiru re rakot la riwra , Matroma , mowenia amamkeka Omuplara me tiermu kerna pa ami edonna mal pa Mu'una-muemnu ? Onde O ' emolmolan neka mak kahulti-kahamra onde mak kaniki-kalai onde mak kamehra-kamau me maka kden la roma nhio'la ralamni pa ami edonna mtomra-mnah ' a pa mtulla-msayn O ' a ?
Then he will answer them , saying , ‘ Most certainly I tell you , because you did n't do it to one of the least of these , you did n't do it to me . ' ||| Noma A'ukot la giwra , Totpena miatga , la'pa miy edonna mhima-mrie ' a A i'nu-na'ru mak kakleh weli , de emekwalima miy edon mhima-mrie ' olek A ' u .
These will go away into eternal punishment , but the righteous into eternal life . ||| Pede hota rala niukum lawna ra rukmua hare pa nodi liarni , mere la'pa riy mak kaplol la Uplerlawna yamkekni de hota rmormiori lia mormiori plalahwa pa nodi liarni .
When Jesus had finished all these words , he said to his disciples , ||| La'pa Yesus Nwatutga hare honona pa nhorwua noma Nakot la maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re Niwra ,

Ne hota la ' ler de Rimormiori A'na A ' die , ral A ' pua la'pa rwairia A lia auwlakra hananni .

the voice of one crying in the wilderness , ‘ Make ready the way of the Lord ! Make his paths straight ! ' ||| Hota e ' de polpuolu-hawaunia la wo'orletna-kawurloini pa niwra , Mpiahi ' targa talla la Orgahi-Orha ' a , mpiale'era loini-talanni !

Yohansi nhaun pa niwra , Hoi ! Mhioitio'ora-mtiahnei dioinia do'omi-halmi re pa mai pia rharan miy ee ! Totpena hota Uplerlawna Namou-nawitan miy lia do'omi-halmi !
All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him . They were baptized by him in the Jordan river , confessing their sins . ||| Riy rahu rehi rwatiawua Yerusalem , me Yudea liewnu rriw niana pa rmai pia ratlin la Yohansi ha nakotkota . Noka ir rakota plele'er momuoga do'oni-halli re , ne Yohansi nharania re la ' gerlawna Yordan .
John was clothed with camel 's hair and a leather belt around his waist . He ate locusts and wild honey . ||| Yohansi naniayarni de ra ' nana la onta wullu me rewni de ra ' nana la ha ulti me ya'anni-yemannu de kongoha nora gani turnu .
He preached , saying , After me comes he who is mightier than I , the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen . ||| Lir di de Yohansi ed maka nakot niwra , Hota Riy id mak kreh nian a ' u Nmai pia klernohor a ' di . Hota awue'er doin lakni wniowni ho'mana a ' g edonna puar nana .

Jesus said to them , Come after me , and I will make you into fishers for men . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la re , Ee , ma mliernohor A ' g ee ! Mai pia Awuatut miy totpena la ' emkameni la miy mitial reri i'na la dodo'ondi , de hota emkade wal pia mihak rimormiori totpena hota rpesiay mai A ' u .
Immediately they left their nets , and followed him . ||| Noma rleretniekla rteman taru tialli , ne rlernohora Yesus .

They were astonished at his teaching , for he taught them as having authority , and not as the scribes . ||| Riy rwer rer wiawni la wniatutnu-wniaye'eni de , yoma Nodi plolli wibawa pa Nwatutu . Pede wniatutnu de ematia ' a makwatutu-kwaye ' a agama Yahudi wniatutnu .
Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit , and he cried out , ||| La ' a gen miaka nhi'inde Yahudi rhi ' kreini-iskolli la , de riy ida maka hegana nhu'ru ralma . Nhaunu-nhaunu pa niwra ,

Hota Omhi ' nan emkameni mai ami oo ! Ommuai pia mpieyat ami ? A ' g e gat niohora he ' O ' a ! O ' di de maran yamou-wuhur yatoha yang suci maka Uplerlawna Nwalir niana pa Nhopan pa Ommuai lia nohkerna wawannu !

The unclean spirit , convulsing him and crying with a loud voice , came out of him . ||| Noma yatni-rha'ani de nkahyoi-nkada'al meman neka riy de , na'nama nhaun matmiati dewade nhargot meman la ralamni .

Immediately , when they had come out of the synagogue , they came into the house of Simon and Andrew , with James and John . ||| La'pa rhoitio'or la gen id maka Yahudi re rhi ' kreini-iskolli de , noma Yesus Nora Yakowsi me Yohansi rodi liarni la Simon nora Andarias likatni .
Now Simon 's wife 's mother lay sick with a fever , and immediately they told him about her . ||| La ' de Simon yananni entepartarlia yanina yoma temni npahna , noma rakot nohora patke ' de mehrani la Yesus .

At evening , when the sun had set , they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons . ||| La'pa lera ntuinia , dewade rodia riy honona mak kamehra me maka hegana ha nhu'ru ralma pa rla'awa Yesus .

A leper came to him , begging him , kneeling down to him , and saying to him , If you want to , you can make me clean . ||| Lera ida ne riy mak kanieni ulityata-temyata nmai noma nwaltior tar lia Yesus gaini ralamni na'nama nwak la niwra , Amee ! Mtiulan mai a ' u . Agat niohora de Omuodi plolli pa Mhi ' kalwied nan a ' u , hornama Ompuayow nohora a wakwa'ku di .
Being moved with compassion , he stretched out his hand , and touched him , and said to him , I want to . Be made clean . ||| Yesus Nsaynia riy de pede Nran limni pa Nteman la riy de pa Nakot la , Arieiniana o wakwakmu pa omkialwied wa !

When he entered again into Capernaum after some days , it was heard that he was at home . ||| La'pa lera woru-wotelu rlardoinla dewade Yesus Nmai owa'an la leta Kapernaum , noma rod kiota-ral de'eta de E ' etla roma nayanni .

Noka rwaye'er doinia roma ritni mak kden la Yesus o'tani wawannu , nhorwua dewade ralernu mak kaliu'uta de na'itar neka u'tani maka enanin la wawannu .
Jesus , seeing their faith , said to the paralytic , Son , your sins are forgiven you . ||| La'pa Yesus Namkek tutga riy mak kmai re pesiayni raruri , noma Yesus Nakot la riy mak kaliu'uta de Niwra , Ama , dodo'ondi de A'umou-uwitn oleka do'omu-halmu .
But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts , ||| Dewade makwatutu-kwaye ' a agama mak kamtatna la hande rwarora-rwalai la ralamni riwra ,

Immediately Jesus , perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves , said to them , Why do you reason these things in your hearts ? ||| La ' ler de meman pa ira ralma-riorni re , Yesus Nat niohora momuoga , pede Nakot la , Ee , hya ' ed mak kariei pia mimpiaror nana yatiana rena ? !
Which is easier , to tell the paralytic , ‘ Your sins are forgiven , ' or to say , ‘ Arise , and take up your bed , and walk ' ? ||| La'pa plet pa A'ukot nek la mak kaliu'uta di giwra e do'oni-halli ramou-rawitn oleka de , miplin niohor ma'ta plollola pa e do'oni-halli ramou-rawitn oleka me edonna , mere la'pa Apuaran pia A'ukot la e ' pa namat pa npopna u'tani pa nala'awa de mimiat niohor memna A ru'ru-la'yu etla yoma mimkek nan memna .
But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins-he said to the paralytic- ||| Pede hota la ' dodo'ondi de Agiwra tiut muemna tiy miy , la ' a noh di wawannu , de Rimormiori A'nani A ' g ed mak kodi plolli pa umou-uwitna riy do'oni-halli . Noma Yesus Nakot la mak kaliu'ut de
I tell you , arise , take up your mat , and go to your house . ||| Niwra , Hyalia , mumat doin la pa mpuopna u'tamu de pa mlia'awa rommu .
He arose , and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all , so that they were all amazed and glorified God , saying , We never saw anything like this ! ||| Dewade mak kaliu'ut de namat doin na'nama npopna u'tani pa nla'awa la ' a hare gaini ralamni . Riy honona la hande mana rwer rer wiawni , ne ra'uli-rawedia Uplerlawna . Rwer rer wiawni pia riwra , It edonna tamkek ma'ta hihi ' a-yapyapi maka itamkeka la ' ler di !
He went out again by the seaside . All the multitude came to him , and he taught them . ||| Noma Yesus Nla ' owa'an la danau aratni , ne riy harahu rmai tiemna dewade Nwatutga re .
As he passed by , he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office . He said to him , Follow me . And he arose and followed him . ||| La'pa Yesus Nalala ' rer mia'ta noma Namkek nana mak kawoka blastena id de nanni Lewi , Alpius a'nani . La ' ler de de Lewi e namtatna la gen miaka nhi'inde enawoka blasten la . Noma Yesus Npol lia , E ! Mua mliernohor A ' g ee ! Noma Lewi naprir pia nlernohora Yesus .
He was reclining at the table in his house , and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples , for there were many , and they followed him . ||| La'pa Yesus e Nana'an rer lia Lewi romni dewade riy harahu maka nhi'inde leta mniotni sukni atia'ala re , emeka mak kawoka blastena me riy mak ha riwra riy dodo ' a-halala rmai pia rora Yesus me maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re pa ra'an rewre'wa , yoma riy harahu mak emkare nhi'inde rlernohor reri Yesus .
The scribes and the Pharisees , when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors , said to his disciples , Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners ? ||| Riy Parisi dom makla ' walia makwatutu-kwaye ' a agama ramkek wali hare . Noma ratiana riy maka Yesus ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re riwra , Oi ! Nihya'pa miy tungkurmi de Nora mak kawoka blastena , ror wutga riy mak khi ' do ' a-kyap hiala dom to ' pa re ra'an wutu ? !
When Jesus heard it , he said to them , Those who are healthy have no need for a physician , but those who are sick . I came not to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance . ||| La'pa Yesus Natlin nana yatianni re noma Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , Mak edonna kanieni edonna rma rahaka dokter . Eneknek to ' a makamehra nanpena ed mak kwahaka dokter . Amuai die A ' g edonna mua puolga riy mak kiwra irakleha do ' a-hala , mere Amuai di totpa Apuolga riy dodo ' a-halala pa rhoitio'or doini do'oni-halli re .
John 's disciples and the Pharisees were fasting , and they came and asked him , Why do John 's disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast , but your disciples do n't fast ? ||| Ler ida ne , maklernohora Yohansi makharani rora Parisi mniotni ratatahan reri lara , ne riy rmai pia ratiana Yesus riwra , Nihya'pa maklernohora Yohansi re rora riy Parisi ratahan lara , ne maklernohor reri O ' a de ra'ana ?
Jesus said to them , Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them ? As long as they have the bridegroom with them , they ca n't fast . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Emkameni la miy wniarormi dena de ? ! A ' di de emeknekama muanke ' a mak kiwra kmehlima . Riy maka rpol niana-rwak nana pa ra'ana-remun la yawoka-yale ' u la mehlima-marya ' a , de hota edonna ratahan lara la'pa muanke ' a muaka kmehlima ntepartar mua't la ya'ana la ' mei wawannu toh ? ! Hade yala'ani atia ' hade !
But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them , and then they will fast in that day . ||| Mere hota la'pa nte'ela la ' lerni , nanpena ira'ala muanke ' a muaka kmehlim della mak ka'an wutu re onni . La ' ler de nampena iratahan lara .
No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment , or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old , and a worse hole is made . ||| Riy edonna rga ' pua rala kokanan warwuaru ra rlowna rain mak kawniali . Yoma la'pa emkade de kokanan warwuar die hota napliu'uta-napdiedan nana rain mak kawnial de ne hota na'itar la pritni .
No one puts new wine into old wineskins , or else the new wine will burst the skins , and the wine pours out , and the skins will be destroyed , but they put new wine into fresh wineskins . ||| Emkade wal lia riy edonna rga ' pua rhuria anggur tur warwuarnu la ' a ha ulit mak mahnek oleka . Yoma anggur tur warwuarnu de hota nhi ' nana ha ulit mahnek de ema reye'era pa anggur tur de rhur dioinia ne ha ulit de ho'mana ta'en niana rnair owa'ana . Anggur tur warwuaru de rhuria la ha ulit warwuaru .
He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields , and his disciples began , as they went , to pluck the ears of grain . ||| La lera id la ' Sabat lerni , de Yesus Nora maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re rala ' a la nhyi ' wetra ' lawna ida ralamni , ne maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re rkura wetra ' lawna re harni pa ra'ana .
The Pharisees said to him , Behold , why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day ? ||| Noma riy Parisi rakot la Yesus riwra , Mumkek la me ! Nihya'pa maka Mpuatutu-mpuaye ' a re rpera-rdaitia it agamni deullu-tatarni yoma ir e rkar lia ' a Sabat lerni ? !
He said to them , Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry-he , and those who were with him ? ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , Miy mpiaik nan olek la ' a hya ' maka Daud nhi ' a la ' lera e nora talanwalli re raplara mere rakleha yamanna toh !
How he entered into God 's house at the time of Abiathar the high priest , and ate the show bread , which is not lawful to eat except for the priests , and gave also to those who were with him ? ||| La ' ler maka Abiatar nhi ' imam o'ta lawanni , de Daud nler la Uplerlawna roma kreini ralamni na'nama na'ana rot miaka ha ral oleka la Uplerlawna . Nhor nia'nama nal walia roti rella ' mutu korni pa ra'an wal lia . Mere la'pa deulu-tatra agama , de mak ka'ana roti re de eneknek to ' a imam-imam rmeh ' a .
He said to them , The Sabbath was made for man , not man for the Sabbath . ||| Uplerlawna Nhi ' a Sabat lerni totpa Ntulan la rimormiori . E ' edonna Nhi ' a Sabat de emeka ler mak kla kwar lawna la rimormiori wawannu .
Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath . ||| La hade pede Rimormiori A'nani A ' die mana , A ' g ed mak kodi plolli pa A'ukot nohora hya ' ed mak kaplola onde nhala pa itsi ' a la Sabat lerni .
He entered again into the synagogue , and there was a man there whose hand was withered . ||| La lera id de Yesus Nla owa'an la gen miaka nhi'inde Yahudi rhi ' a kreini-iskolli . La ' noma Namkek nana riy ida etla hande de limni walli nmati .
They watched him , whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day , that they might accuse him . ||| La hande de riy doma riwra rahaka kahelli-kaha'arni la ' Yesus totpena Nhi ' de rodia la letgara lawawna hakim . Pede honona rkil rer lia hota Nhi ' kalwieda makamehra-kamau la Sabat lerni me edonna ?
He said to the man whose hand was withered , Stand up . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la riy maka limni walli kmat die Niwra , Mai pia mtiutrier lia riy honona gaini ralamni .
He said to them , Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm ? To save a life or to kill ? But they were silent . ||| Nhor nia'nama Yesus Natiana riy mak kden la ' hande niwra , La ' a agama deullu-tatarni de rakot targa hota it tsi ' a hya ' a la Sabat lerni ? Hota it tsi ' a samomuounu me onde tsi ' a yatyatni ? Tamori-talewna rimormior me onde twaror nohora wniunu-wnienna la it rimormior wialli ? Mere ir rherier tio'owa .
When he had looked around at them with anger , being grieved at the hardening of their hearts , he said to the man , Stretch out your hand . Noma riy de nwetar limni de mtatande nekpa nnienni nmolu .

Others fell on the rocky ground , where it had little soil , and immediately it sprang up , because it had no depth of soil . ||| Dom de rtuin la watgau ralamni pa ntai tani oke ' to ' a . Plet pa nmor wia yoma tani mniha .

Noma riy honona re ramta'at wenna .

but they , when they saw him walking on the sea , supposed that it was a ghost , and cried out , ||| La'pa ir honona la puou die ramkek tutga E maimiaini de lola tah ' i ulti wawannu de rhoiya la hegan lora , reiniande honona re polpuollu-hawaunnu ,

and ran around that whole region , and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was . ||| Noma rawlar pia rla'awa leta-ruhun maka rehgorgoru pa rhim nana mak kamehra-kamau , mak kanin rer tio'ola u'ti wawannu re , pa rodia la Yesus la ' a geni-tien maka ratlin nana Ndella .
Wherever he entered-into villages , or into cities , or into the country-they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment , and as many as touched him were made well . ||| La ' meni-meni maka Yesus Nla ' a de , la ' a let paheli-ruhun patatra re , de rken tiarga mak kamehra-kamau re la ya'olu-yala ' a geni ralamni . Mak kodia makamehra-kamau re rwak lilili-mamuau lia Yesus totpa makamehra-kamau re rteman to'ola Yesus rayanni tawnu totpena rkalwieda . Dewade he'-he ' mak kteman nan to ' a Yesus rayanni tawnu re , honona rnek pa rler la kalwiedni-paitiotni .
Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him , having come from Jerusalem . ||| Lera ida ne Parisi wokni id nor wutga makwatutu-kwaye ' a agama re rwatiawua Yerusalem pa rma rwahaka Yesus . Rma rpepan reria noma
Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled , that is unwashed , hands , they found fault . ||| ramkek de maka Yesus ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a dom de ra'ana mere edon rohma limni emeka hya ' maka upni-tgarni rwatut tiarga la ' ululu .
For the Pharisees and all the Jews do n't eat unless they wash their hands and forearms , holding to the tradition of the elders . ||| Parisi mniotni ra'itra Yahudi re korni rlernohora hya ' mak upni-tgarni rdeul taru-rtatar targ oleka wa pa ra'ana de rohma limni .
They do n't eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves , and there are many other things which they have received to hold to , washings of cups , pitchers , bronze vessels , and couches . ||| Ne la'pa rwatiawua ya'olu-yala ' geni de edon rohma limni ma'ta de , ta'en nian ra'ana . The Pharisees and the scribes asked him , Why do n't your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders , but eat their bread with unwashed hands ? ||| La ' hade pede Parisi mniotni rora makwatutu-kwaye ' a agama ratiana Yesus , Nihya'pa riy maka Ompuatutu-mpuaye ' a re edon rmor niohora it upni-tgarni deullu-tatarni ? ! Ira'an de edonna rohma ulga limni .

Niwra , Emkadilla Uplerlawna lirni , Rimormiori ri eneknek to'ama ral nurnu tutnu re rha'wa nan to ' A na'nu , mere ralamni re olieta mai A ' u .
They worship me in vain , teaching as doctrines the commandments of men . ' ||| Hare kniola tiernu-niawur nehlani mai A ' die hamamuamua re yoma ira rwatut tio ' a rimormiori wniatutnu-wniaye'eni .
For you set aside the commandment of God , and hold tightly to the tradition of men-the washing of pitchers and cups , and you do many other such things . ||| Uplerlawna lirni-tunnu de , miy edon mhie'du nana , mere rimormiori deullu-tatarni nanpena mtie'la rer pitpitga .
He said to them , Full well do you reject the commandment of God , that you may keep your tradition . ||| Miy edon mliernohora Uplerlawna lirni de , mere mimliernohor to ' a miy upmi-tgarmi deullu-tatarni .
For Moses said , ‘ Honor your father and your mother , ' and , ‘ He who speaks evil of father or mother , let him be put to death . ' ||| Yoma Musa niwra , Mhiu'ru-mhielam la inmi-ammi , ne la'pa hameni nwohora-ntatra inni-amni , de hota nlernana niukum matmiati .
But you say , ‘ If a man tells his father or his mother , Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban , ' that is to say , given to God , ||| Mere mpiatutu-mpiaye ' de edon nhala pa riy id nakot la inni-amni niwra , Agiwa galla miy , mere agal oleka la Uplerlawna .
then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother , ||| Noma mhiur niohora riy de , pa hota edon na'unni-namta'ata inni-amni .
making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down . You do many things like this . ||| La ' talan emkade pede miy edon mliernohora Uplerlawna lirni de , mere mliernohor to ' a miy upmi-tgarmi deullu-tatarni maka mpiatutu-mpiaye ' a re . Ne mpiatutu deulu-tatra harahu mak emkade wali mak kreiniande riy edon ratlina-ratailla Uplerlawna lirni .
He called all the multitude to himself and said to them , Hear me , all of you , and understand . ||| Nhor nioma Yesus Npol lia riy rahu mak kden handi pa rma rawoka ne Nakot la re Niwra , Hononmi mitlina totpena miatga .
There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him , but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man . ||| Mak ita'ana edon nhi ' akdeha-aktiahl ita . Eneknek to'ama yatyatni-halalli maka itakot nohora me tsi ' nana . Hade ed maka khi ' pa takdeha-taktiahli .
If anyone has ears to hear , let him hear ! ||| He ' tlinni erla de , totpa natlin reri !
When he had entered into a house away from the multitude , his disciples asked him about the parable . ||| Nhor nioka Yesus Nhoitio'or doin riy rahu re pa Nla'awa roma ida nayanni , na'nama maka Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re ratiana riwra , Tuna , Mtiulan pa Mukot nohora yawalliohora de nnia'eratni mai ami .
He said to them , Are you also without understanding ? Do n't you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside ca n't defile him , ||| Yesus Niwra , Miy die emek ir wal pia edonna miat mua'ta lira re nnia'eratni ? ! Miy e miplin mua'ta mak itlumu-ttella de edon khi ' akdeha-aktiahl ita ? !
because it does n't go into his heart , but into his stomach , then into the latrine , making all foods clean ? ||| Yoma maka itlumu-ttella de edonna la'awa it ihranu ralamni mere , la'awa it apannu ralamni ne hota nlergot owa'ana ! Emkade de Yesus Nakot Niwra ya'ana-yemnu honona de , raya'ana-rayemun momuou .
He said , That which proceeds out of the man , that defiles the man . ||| Yesus Nakot la , Mak kwatiawua it ralamni ed maka khi ' rira pa rakdeha-raktiahli .
For from within , out of the hearts of men , proceed evil thoughts , adulteries , sexual sins , murders , thefts , ||| Yoma it ihranu ralamni ed mak kodia ralma-rior yotyota-yatyata , pa nhi'nande riy ralira-raliai , rkamnelu-rkamna ' a , rwunu-rwenna ,
covetings , wickedness , deceit , lustful desires , an evil eye , blasphemy , pride , and foolishness . ||| riy ralamni rapal niana re ' a-tniaru kupna-kai , rahankerna-raralmha'ara , pudi-akla ohpa-lahara , pareta-pahawa , ihru yata-ralam yata , rapolu-raliella rira , tulu-petna , raplin niohora talan plollola .

Now the woman was a Greek , a Syrophoenician by race . She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter . ||| Patke ' de Yahudi atia ' a , mak kwatiawua Fenisia yapatni la ' a Siria . Nwak la Yesus niwra , Tungkurg ee , Mtiulan pa Mhuokar doini hegan mak khu'ru ralma a a'nu .

He said to her , For this saying , go your way . The demon has gone out of your daughter . ||| Noka Yesus Nakot la patke ' de , Onnila lirmu di , mlia ' meman la dodo'ondi , yoma hegan de ema ratargot oleka la a'namu ralamni .
She went away to her house , and found the child having been laid on the bed , with the demon gone out . ||| Patke ' de nawal lia roma nayanni . La ' de nlernana a'nani e nanina la lewu wawannu , ne hegan de ema ratargot oleka wa .

Looking up to heaven , he sighed , and said to him , Ephphatha ! that is , Be opened ! ||| Nhor nioka Yesus Nwatniar rer lia lyanti , ne Nhedga aranni na'nama Nakot la , Efata ! nnia'eratni de Muphyar wia .
Immediately his ears were opened , and the impediment of his tongue was released , and he spoke clearly . ||| Noma riy de tlinni naphyar wia ne , mtatan de nekpa namni wniutnu mana natiewar doin la , ne naltier samomuou wa .

In those days , when there was a very great multitude , and they had nothing to eat , Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them , ||| Lera ida ne riy rahu rawoka owa'an la Yesus onni . If I send them away fasting to their home , they will faint on the way , for some of them have come a long way . ||| La'pa Agolin doin hare pa rla'awa de apannu rahgali , yanhi'pa gaini rmokal lol talan letgara , yoma dom de rwatiawua geni-tiena mak olieta .

They ate and were filled . They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over . ||| Rirahu re ra'an pa rpehera , na'nama maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re rwaho ' a-rwatierun de rlernana maka ha ra'an atre ' a , de kriou penpuenu wo'itu .
Those who had eaten were about four thousand . Then he sent them away . ||| Rhor momuoga mak ka'ana re la'pa edon nhal de riy riwnu wogata . Nhorwua dewade Yesus Nhopan pa honona rawal lia ' genni-tienni .
Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha . ||| Na'nama Yesus Nora maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re rha'at la puou pa rla'awa Dalmanut yapatni .

Riwra rtota Yesus la klieratni pede rhopan pa Yesus Ntutga hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona id totpena irat muemna de Yesus plolli-mneheni nwatiawua Uplerlawna .
He sighed deeply in his spirit and said , Why does this generation seek a sign ? Most certainly I tell you , no sign will be given to this generation . ||| Noma Yesus Nhedga aranni Niwra , Adoh ! Nihya'pa rimormiori la lera-mela ri rhopan pa Aghi ' a hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona ? ! Mere mitlino ! Hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona kuku ' nek ho'mana , A ' g edon tiutga tiy miy .
He left them , and again entering into the boat , departed to the other side . ||| Nhor nioka Nto'or doinia ir la hande pa Nha'at owa'an la puou pa rleret lia walli .
They forgot to take bread , and they did n't have more than one loaf in the boat with them . ||| La ' noma maka Yesus ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re rhortaplin pa edon rodi wareherni roti , enekneka ida nmeh ' a la puou ralamni .
He warned them , saying , Take heed , beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod . ||| Noma Yesus Nwagahniorta re Niwra , Hyalia , mhioratreria ! Hota miy ererma la ' a tgo ' a Parisi rora ray Herodes .
They reasoned with one another , saying , It 's because we have no bread . ||| Noma rwarora pa idma nakot la ida riwra , Nakot emkade yoma itakleh roti .
Jesus , perceiving it , said to them , Why do you reason that it 's because you have no bread ? Do n't you perceive yet or understand ? Is your heart still hardened ? ||| Yesus Nat niohora hya ' ed maka ha rakotkota pede Nakot la re , Nihya'pa miakokan nohora roti hadamonna ? ! Miy ralma-riormi edonna nla ' nan ma'ta ? ! Ralammi ratehra to'owa .
Having eyes , do n't you see ? Having ears , do n't you hear ? Do n't you remember ? ||| Matmi reprepra mere edon mimkek nana , ne mtiaru tlina mere edon mitail nana . Miy edonna mhiorat nan ma'ta ? !
When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand , how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up ? They told him , Twelve . ||| La ' lera maka Aghawierie'er roti wolim pa Agaitiutur nana riy riwnu wolima , de miy orgahami miwok nan korni kriou penpuen re , maka ha ra'an atre ' a re wo'ira ? Rwahla riwra , Kriou termida wehrani woru .
When the seven loaves fed the four thousand , how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up ? They told him , Seven . ||| Ne la ' walia rot mieha wo'itu maka Agala tiutria riy riwnu wogata , dewade miwok rehenu de kriou penpuenu re wo'ira ? Rwahla riwra , Kriou wo'itu .
He asked them , Do n't you understand yet ? ||| Noma Nakot la re , Miy ralma-riormi edonna nla ' nan ma'ta ? !
He came to Bethsaida . They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him . ||| Nhor nioka Yesus Nora maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re rte'ela leta Betsaida . La ' hande de , riy rodia maka matni yata id pa rla rwak la Yesus pa , totpa Nteman nana la .
He took hold of the blind man by the hand , and brought him out of the village . When he had spat on his eyes , and laid his hands on him , he asked him if he saw anything . ||| Yesus Nte'la la mat yata de limni pa Nodgiota la leta to'orni . Noma Nakrui lia riy de matni , ne Nteman limni la riy de matni , noma Natiana Niwra , Mumkek oleka hadomdoma ?
He looked up , and said , I see men , but I see them like walking trees . ||| Riy de namkek la gaini , nhor nioka niwra , A'umkek nan riy , yoma a'umkeka riy ralala ' a , mere yamkekni emolmolan to ' a orona-augona .
Then again he laid his hands on his eyes . He looked intently , and was restored , and saw everyone clearly . ||| Yesus Ntemn owa'an limni la riy de matni , dewade riy de ntot pa niwra namkeka na'nama riy de matni nkalwied wa , nhi'nande namkek nana hya ' a-hya ' de reprepra .
He sent him away to his house , saying , Do n't enter into the village , nor tell anyone in the village . ||| Nhor nioka Yesus Nhopan pa riy de nla'awa romni mere Nakot la , Mlia ' de yana mliola leta de ralamni pa mpiahauria hadi !
Jesus went out , with his disciples , into the villages of Caesarea Philippi . On the way he asked his disciples , Who do men say that I am ? ||| Noma Yesus Nor mutwualli re rla ' a leta-ruhun mak kdella leta Kaisarea Pilipi onni . La ' talan letgara Enatiana mutwualli mak ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re Niwra , Nhi'inde riy e riwra A ' die he ' o ?
They told him , John the Baptizer , and others say Elijah , but others , one of the prophets . ||| Noma mutwualli re rwet la riwra , Tuna , riy dom de riwra Yohansi makharani O ' a , mak kmori owa'ana , dom de riwra makwohorulu-ktatrulu Eli . Dom de riwra makwohorulu-ktatrulu dom to ' a .
He said to them , But who do you say that I am ? Peter answered , You are the Christ . ||| Noka Yesus Natian owa'ana , Mere A'utian tek miy . La ' miy wniarormi de , A ' di de he ' A ' u ? Noma Petrus nwet la , Matro'mu , O ' di de Ray mak kodia mormiori-lewlewna maka Uplerlawna Nano'taru Mesias O inhatti !
He commanded them that they should tell no one about him . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re Niwra , Maka Petrus nakota de naplol memna mere yan memmemna mikot nohor ma'ta hadella riy doma .
He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things , and be rejected by the elders , the chief priests , and the scribes , and be killed , and after three days rise again . ||| La ' ler de de pa nodi liarni Yesus Nwe'er doin meman la maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re , de Uplerlawna ralma-riorni totpena Rimormiori A'na E ' de hota Ntutulu-nlelewua kropna-krieutu , yamuki-yama'ala , me hota ina-ama Yahudi rora imam-imam re o'tani-matni , me makwatutu-kwaye ' a agama rwayotli E ' a . Ne Uplerlawna Nala pa hota rwen E ' a mere la'pa nodia la lera wotellu owa'an de Enmori owa'an la E matmiati ralamni .
He spoke to them openly . Peter took him and began to rebuke him . ||| Nakota ploloi-plele'era lir di . Noma Petrus nheduma pa nte'la la Yesus pa rla'awa walli na'nama npolliohora Yesus pa nakot la , Matroma , awuakwak de Uplerlawna Nter dioini-nhal doinia mak Omukot de !
But he , turning around and seeing his disciples , rebuked Peter , and said , Get behind me , Satan ! For you have in mind not the things of God , but the things of men . ||| Hya ' maka Petrus nakota de edon nlernohora Uplerlawna ralma-riorni pede Yesus Nkillia maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re na'nama Nawenan la Petrus Niwra , Eh , mlia'awa walli hega'nu ne ! La'pa omiwra hota A ' g edon lier la yamuki-yama'ala de wniarormu de wniarora rimormioria de . Wniaror de edonna nwatiawua Uplerlawna .
He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them , Whoever wants to come after me , let him deny himself , and take up his cross , and follow me . ||| Noka Yesus Npolga riy mutlialawna rora maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re pa Nakot la Niwra , Riy meni mak kiwra klernohor A ' u , de nhoratdoin momuoga hya ' ed maka e ralamni nod rer lia , ne nre ' wut lia A ' pua nler la yamuki-yama'ala onde matmiati pa emolmolan nekama nhoi wawayanni la auwlakra pa nlernohor A ' u .
For whoever wants to save his life will lose it , and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it . ||| Yoma la'pa hameni maka edon nhoratdoinia mormiorni noh di wawannu de hota e ' edon nler la mormiori-dardiari plalahwa pa nodi liarni . Mere la'pa riy maka khoratdoinia mormiorni la noh di wawannu onnila A ' u me Uplerlawna Kot Kalwiedni-Paitiotni rerieini , de hota nlernana mormiori-dardiari pa nodi liarni .
For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life ? ||| La'pa riy mak klernana nohkeran di re'eni-tniarnu honona mere hota edonna nlernana mormiori-dardiari plalahwa pa nodi liarni , de hota re'eni-tniarnu re nodi untu hya ' la ' riy dena ? !
For what will a man give in exchange for his life ? ||| Nohkeran di re'eni-tniarnu honona , ta'en niana nawel niana mormiori-dardiari plalahwa de mai ita toh ? !
For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation , the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father 's glory with the holy angels . ||| La'pa he ' maka kmola-kma ' pa kreinian A ' u me kwayow nana A li'ru-A tu'nu la ' riy yatyata-halala mak kahmena pesiay gaini ralamni la ' a lera-mela ri , de hota Rimormiori A'na A ' muana , muola-mua ' wal pia rieinian riy della , la ' ler maka hota Amuai owa'an de godia A A'mu plolli-mneheni hititni-repreparni pa Agor wutga Uplerlawna hopopanni malaikat mak edon kheik la do ' a-hala ralamni Ammai die .

Noma Yesus Natiana re , La kupan de he ' a herni-gaini me he ' nanni mak kden la kupan dena ? Noma rwet la riwra , Ray mak ktorna horta-hairi Romawi Kaisar o'tani inhat ee !
Jesus answered them , Give to Caesar the things that are Caesar 's , and to God the things that are God 's . They marveled greatly at him . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la re , Hade emkade , miala kupan maka ray herni-gaini etla de la ' a ray , yoma hanni hade . Ne miala la Uplerlawna hya ' maka Uplerlawna gahani wali . La'pa ratlin nana lira wniahla re honona , de honona rwer rer wiawni .
Some Sadducees , who say that there is no resurrection , came to him . They asked him , saying , ||| Noma Saduki riy doma rmai pia ratian nohora Yesus la ' a emkameni la riy mak kmati hota rmori owa'ana , yoma Saduki re er mak edonna kpesiaya riy mak kmati hota rmori owa'ana .
Teacher , Moses wrote to us , ‘ If a man 's brother dies and leaves a wife behind him , and leaves no children , that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother . ' ||| Riwra , Tungkurga , Musa e nhorat targa mai ita , de emkadilla , La'pa muanke ' ida nmati mere nakleh ma'ta a'na , de muanke ' a mak kmat die hyalli nor owa'an yerni patyat de rmehlima , totpena rlernana hyalli mak kmati olek de duratni-waitni .
There were seven brothers . The first took a wife , and dying left no offspring . ||| Mere la ' lera ida , de muanke ' a riy wo'itu rwahyal riaralma . Noma yanulu nmehlima , mere edonna nlernan ma'ta a'na , ne nmat wia .
The second took her , and died , leaving no children behind him . The third likewise , and the seven took her and left no children . Last of all the woman also died . ||| Noma garni mak klernohor hyalli nora yerni rmehlima mere edonna nlernan wal mia'ta a'na noma nmati owa'ana . La'pa emkade walli la ' a hyalli re korni re ror owa'an yerni de rmehlima mere id mana nakleh ma'ta a'na de rmat wia pa emkade mamain pa nodi liarni pa la ntutu mueman la gari hoho ' a . La'awa hohoni noma pat de mana nmat wia , mere nakleh etia a'na ida .
In the resurrection , when they rise , whose wife will she be of them ? For the seven had her as a wife . ||| Hota la'pa la'awa lerni pa mak kmati honona rmori owa'ana , de hota he ' hawni patke ' a dena ? Yoma mak kwahyali re wo'itu meman pa rora pat de rmehlima .
Jesus answered them , Is n't this because you are mistaken , not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God ? ||| Noma Yesus Nwahla yatianni re Niwra , Oi , miy wniarormi de nhala , yoma miplin niohora Puka lirni , me miplin wualia Uplerlawna plolli-mneheni .
For when they will rise from the dead , they neither marry nor are given in marriage , but are like angels in heaven . ||| Yoma riy mak kmati re hota rmori owa'ana , de hota edonna rmehlima , mere hota rmori-rdar lia Ilyamou-Watyatoha , emolmolan nekama Uplerlawna hopopanni malaikat la ' Ilyamou-Watyatoha mak edon rmehlima .
But about the dead , that they are raised , have n't you read in the book of Moses about the Bush , how God spoke to him , saying , ‘ I am the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob ' ? ||| Nah , la ' a miy wniarormi de mak miwra riy hota edon rmori owa'an la matmiatni ralamni , de emeknekama miy edonna mpiaik nan ma'ta Orgahi-Orha ' a lirni maka Musa nhorat taru , maka enatlin nana la ' ler maka nlernan ai la ' a pu'na-kiarti ralamni de . Orgahi-Orha ' a lirni emkadi , A ' di de Abraham , Isak me Yakop Uplerlawna ma'ta A ' u . Nakot emkade kennama Abraham , Isak me Yakopa rmati olekwa .
He is not the God of the dead , but of the living . You are therefore badly mistaken . ||| Ha nnia'eratni de Uplerlawna mutnu-rahanu maka kmati rmori owa'ana me Uplerlawna de ir Uplerlawanni . Uplerlawan de , riy mak kmati Uplerlawanni atia ' a hade . E de de , mak kmormiori Uplerlawanni E ' a . Pede miy wniarormi de nhal toto ' a .
One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together , and knowing that he had answered them well , asked him , Which commandment is the greatest of all ? ||| Noma tungkurga agama ida maka kmai pia natlin nana Yesus nora Saduki mniotni rawahla lira , ne nat niohora Yesus Nala wniahlani naplollol meman la riy re , dewade natiana Yesus niwra , Tungkurga , lira nhiopan meni ed maka khi ' ononni la ' a agama deullu-tatarni ?
Jesus answered , The greatest is , ‘ Hear , Israel , the Lord our God , the Lord is one . ||| Yesus Nwahla , Lira nhiopna , nhiedu tniehra ononni inhat de emkadi , Mitlina , Israel mniotni miy , Orgahi-Orha ' a Uplerlawna-Mempulwatnu id to ' a . Enekneka E ' a makla ' it Matromni .
You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart , with all your soul , with all your mind , and with all your strength . ' This is the first commandment . ||| Miala miy rurmi-laimi , ralma-riormi , ihrami-ralammi tetema pa mhima-mrie ' a Uplerlawna Matromlawanmi de .
The second is like this , ‘ You shall love your neighbor as yourself . ' There is no other commandment greater than these . ||| La ' wornu de emkadi , de niwra , Miatu mtiulla-msiaynia mira ' a-mipal wualia rimormiori wialmi pa emekwalima mimkek rer lia inon wamuehemi . Lira nhiopna dom de edon rarehia lira nhiopna ri .
The scribe said to him , Truly , teacher , you have said well that he is one , and there is none other but he , ||| Noka makwatutu-kwaye ' a agama de nakot la Yesus , Plollolli hade Tungkuru , lirmu de plola , Uplerlawna de ida Nmeh ' a to ' a . Enekneka E ' a makla ' it Matromni .
and to love him with all the heart , with all the understanding , all the soul , and with all the strength , and to love his neighbor as himself , is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices . ||| Ne plola pa itala it rurni-laini , ralma-riorni , ihranu-ralamni tetema pa tsima-tre ' a Uplerlawna it Matromlawanni de , me tatu ttulla-tsaynia , tara ' a-tapal wualia it rimormior wialli pa emekwalima itamkek rer lia it inon wamueheni . Itsi ' a hade de narehi-nalawan meman la it prehenni-maunu honona maka itiwra talla Uplerlawna .
When Jesus saw that he answered wisely , he said to him , You are not far from God 's Kingdom . No one dared ask him any question after that . ||| Yesus Nwarora riy de lira wniahlani de nodia wniarora-wnialai samomuou , noma Nakot la , O edon oliet la riy maka Uplerlawna Nodi plolli la emeka ir Rayni . Ne riy id mana edonna nparan pia nhar lirni pa natiana Yesus .
Jesus responded , as he taught in the temple , How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David ? ||| Yesus Nwatut mua't la Uplerlawna roma kreini . La wniatutnu ralamni de Yesus Niwra , Hya ' a nariei pia makwatutu-kwaye ' a agama re riwra Ray Makamori-Kalewan maka Uplerlawna Nano'taru , de Daud duratni-waitni hade ?
For David himself said in the Holy Spirit , ‘ The Lord said to my Lord , Sit at my right hand , until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet . ' ||| Daud nmeh ' a nek de , Uplerlawna Nhiwni Narialmua pa nakot nohora Uplerlawna lirni la Ray Makamori-Kalewan de niwra , Orgahi-Orha ' a Nakot la a Matromlawnu Yesus Niwra , Muliwnu Mumtatnu la ' A wa'lu malganna , la'pa A'utowra arwalmu pa ratniowar la O nayanmu .
Therefore David himself calls him Lord , so how can he be his son ? The common people heard him gladly . ||| La'pa ray Daud nmeh ' a neka nwet la Ray Makamori-Kalewna , niwra e Matromlawanni , de nihya'pa mikota ray Daud duratni E ' a ? Riy mutlialawan re rahepur nohora yatlin la .
In his teaching he said to them , Beware of the scribes , who like to walk in long robes , and to get greetings in the marketplaces , ||| La ' a wniatutnu ralamni de Yesus Niwra , Erammi la ' a tungkurga agama re ! Nhi'inde rala ' nohora raini plalahwani totpena riy ramkek de riy mak inponni ira me ir suksukni de riy ral ir la rekna-waiti la ' a ya'olu-yala ' geni .
and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts , ||| Rler la Yahudi kreini-iskolli ralamni de rtota gen miak kden la gaini me la ' a he ' i-hepru la ' a ya'anlawna-yemunlawna , de rahak geni samomuou totpa riy ra'uli ira , nanpena ramtatna la ' hande .
those who devour widows ' houses , and for a pretense make long prayers . These will receive greater condemnation . ||| Rhi ' aplinu-aplo ' neka palpuallu , ne rwarui-rwate'la hyonni-hyanni honona . Mere rsumbain de plahwani , totpena riy rwarora riy samomuou ira . Hota riy mak emkare ed maka klernan niukum maka reh miemna la riy dom to ' a .
Jesus sat down opposite the treasury and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury . Many who were rich cast in much . ||| Noma Yesus Namtatna pa Napal reria krei ktoparni , pa Namkek de riy rahu rkenia kupan la krei ktoparni . Namkek la mak ktar kupna-kai rala pripan narehi-nalawna .
A poor widow came and she cast in two small brass coins , which equal a quadrans coin . ||| Noma a'na riy patyata ida nmai pia nken wialia sena wor lia ' a ktopar de ralamni .
He called his disciples to himself and said to them , Most certainly I tell you , this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury , ||| Noma Npolga maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re na'nama Nakot la re , Mitlina , patyat di ed mak kenia liawanni la ' a riy honona .
for they all gave out of their abundance , but she , out of her poverty , gave all that she had to live on . ||| Yoma rirahu mak keni olekwa re narehi-nalawna yoma re'eni-tniarnu harahu . Mere patyat di de nakleha-naplara mere mak ha nala re de , eneknek hare to ' a pede nwatul nana pa nal momuoga .
As he went out of the temple , one of his disciples said to him , Teacher , see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings ! ||| La'pa Yesus Nran lakni la Uplerlawna roma kreini noma maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a ida nakot la , Tungkurga , Mumkek tek la Uplerlawna roma kreini de samomuounu , me watgau lawna maka ha rnairia pa rariria roma krei die !
Jesus said to him , Do you see these great buildings ? There will not be left here one stone on another , which will not be thrown down . ||| Noka Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Yowa , Uplerlawna roma kreini de inpona me naruri . Mere hya ' maka mimkeka ri , hota rweyata-rwaniawu momuoga . Wat muaka kapnidara re de hota id mana edonna nalliapar la id wawannu .
As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple , Peter , James , John , and Andrew asked him privately , ||| Nhor nioma Yesus Nla'awa wo'ora Saitun noma Namtatna pa Napal rer lia Uplerlawna roma kreini . Dewade Petrus , Yakowsi , Yohansi me Andarias rmai pia ror Yesus rwahaur rewre'wa pa riwra ,
Tell us , when will these things be ? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled ? ||| Tuna , Mpue'er nohor tek hare , mai ami hota mowen die itamkek mak Omukota re ? Me hota hya ' ed maka tamkek ulga totpena nwagahniort it la hota lera-mela inhatta ?
Jesus , answering , began to tell them , Be careful that no one leads you astray . ||| Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , Mi'ererma ! Yanpa riy rhi ' aklierat miy la ' a A maimia'yu de .
For many will come in my name , saying , ‘ I am he ! ' and will lead many astray . ||| Hota rirahu rmai die rnairia A na'nu pa riwra , Makamori-Kalewna maka Uplerlawna Nano'taru A ' g inhatti ! Hota rirahu rpesiaya ir pa rler la klieratni .
When you hear of wars and rumors of wars , do n't be troubled . For those must happen , but the end is not yet . ||| La'pa mitlina poka hidara yetni warna me mliernana kota-de'eta de rira riwra wunu-ara e nwewr olek la noha-rai , yan mimta'ata . Yoma hota hare honona de plollola pa itamkeka me itatlina , mere noha niatni edon ntutu-nte ' ma'ta .
For nation will rise against nation , and kingdom against kingdom . There will be earthquakes in various places . There will be famines and troubles . These things are the beginning of birth pains . ||| Hota hairi nor hairi rawunu-rawenna , me noha-rai nora noha-rai rawo'ora . Ne hota noha nruru upkarururu lol meni-meni , me rehka-lara nwewar la noha-rai . Hare honona de tamkeka pleinia mere edon rler ma't la noha niatni . Ler maka mimkek la hare de eneknek to'ama mulaliaini , pa emekto'ama patke ' a maka apannu namehra la mulaliaini , mere lerni edon ntu'tu ma'ta pa nayor a'nani .
But watch yourselves , for they will deliver you up to councils . You will be beaten in synagogues . You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake , for a testimony to them . ||| Mi'ererma yoma hota riy mak edon kpesiay re rte'la miy pia rod miy lia mak khudi-kpara gaini . Hota rliwar miy lia ' roma-lewu maka Yahudi re rhi ' kreini-iskolli la . Ne hota ra'it miy lia ' a riy o'ta-mat lalawna me la ' a ray-ray gaini ralamni yoma la ' A rerie'yu . Hota emkade totpena mimliernan talan pa mikot nohor Kot Kalwieda-Paitiota la ira .
The Good News must first be preached to all the nations . ||| Ne Kot Kalwieda-Paitiota de hota rakotkot lola pa nwewar la noheri woru-lyanti nayanni totpena noha-rai honona ratga nhor nianpena noha niata .
When they lead you away and deliver you up , do n't be anxious beforehand or premeditate what you will say , but say whatever will be given you in that hour . For it is not you who speak , but the Holy Spirit . ||| Ne la'pa rtoran nan miy pia rod miy lia watghudi lokarni , de yan memmemna ihrami rteplu yoma mpiarora hya ' maka hota miy mikota ? Mere la'pa ratian miy , mikot neka hya ' ed maka Uplerlawna Nal miy la ' ler de memna pa mikota . Yoma hya ' mak mikota de edon nwatiawua miy wniaror wamuehemi , mere ha nwatiawu Uplerlawna Nhiw Lululli .
Brother will deliver up brother to death , and the father his child . Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death . ||| Hota la ' ler de riy rala inni-narni makpesiay A ' pua rwenna . Emkade wali ama nek de nala a'nani makpesiay pa rwenna . Me upa-a'na nek de hota edon ratlin la inni-amni makpesiay pede rala inni-amni pa riy rwunu-rwenna .
You will be hated by all men for my name 's sake , but he who endures to the end will be saved . ||| Riy la ' meni-meni to ' a hota rahankeran rer tiy miy , yoma miy mliernohor reri A ' u . Mere la'pa he ' ed maka ktorrer pitpitga pesiayni pa la ntutu-nte'ela honi , de hota nlernana mormiori-lewlewna plalahwa pa nodi liarni .
But when you see the abomination of desolation , spoken of by Daniel the prophet , standing where it ought not let the reader understand , then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains , ||| La'pa mimkek nana hya ' mak khi ' akdeha-aktiahlia gen lululi la Uplerlawna roma kreini ralamni narieiniande Uplerlawna Nawenna de napriri-nakded la genia mak yan memmemna ha naprir lia , de miy miaka mpiaik nan hadi de mhioratreria ! Miy mak kden la Yudea miwlar lia ' wo'ora hananni .
and let him who is on the housetop not go down , nor enter in , to take anything out of his house . ||| Me maka kateni anni la likti wawannu plet pa miwlari . Yana mhioratreria hya ' mak kden la roma ralamni pa miodia .
Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak . ||| La'pa miy mak kden la nhyi ' ralma de yana miwali pia miala lawarmi-rayanmi la ' a roma nayanni .
But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days ! ||| Adoh ! La ' ler de de pat mak ka'uhu-ka'apnu , ne la ' a pat mak nuh reria a'nani re rpolpuol inni-rwakwak amni .
Pray that your flight wo n't be in the winter . ||| Msiumbaini totpena yanpa miwlar liola otna-anni ralamni .
For in those days there will be oppression , such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now , and never will be . ||| Yoma lera-mela mak kodi kropna-krieutu , nniahora-nniala ' a , yamuki-yama'ala mak emkade , de it edon tlernan etia la ' a ler maka Uplerlawna Na'ohi-na'ara nohkerna la'pa ntutu-nte'ela ' ler de . Ne la'pa itleretia de , it edon tlernan emkade owa'ana .
Unless the Lord had shortened the days , no flesh would have been saved , but for the sake of the chosen ones , whom he picked out , he shortened the days . ||| La'pa Orgahi-Orha ' a Nala ler de pa naplahwa de hota riy id mana edonna ntuin tar lia noha wawannu yoma rmat miomuou . Mere onnila Orgahi-Orha ' a sniayanni la E mutnu-rahanu maka Nwalir niana re to ' a , maka nhi'nande ler de edonna nodi liarni .
Then if anyone tells you , ‘ Look , here is the Christ ! ' or , ‘ Look , there ! ' do n't believe it . ||| La ' ler de la'pa riy riwra , Mai pia tamkek ee ! Ray Makamori-Kalewna maka Uplerlawna Nano'taru ed olek diwa , onde dom e riwra , Ee , mimkek teka ! Ray Makamori-Kalewan de etla handelloo ! Yan mitlin la lirni re .
For false christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders , that they may lead astray , if possible , even the chosen ones . ||| Yoma hota la lera re de rirahu ralahar pa riwra ir de de Ray Makamori-Kalewna maka Uplerlawna Nano'taru onde rtot inonni emeka makwohorulu-ktatrulu pa rnairia hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona pa rtutga rurni-laini totpa ra ra'ohpa-ralahara rira . Uplerlawna mutnu-rahanu maka Enwalir niana nekane riwra rtot pa rler la klieratni .
But you watch . Behold , I have told you all things beforehand . ||| Hade pede mhioratreria ! Dodo'ondi de A'ukot oleka hari tiy miy totpena hota la'pa hare honona rtutu-rte'ewa de miy edon mlier la klieratni .
But in those days , after that oppression , the sun will be darkened , the moon will not give its light , ||| Mere la'pa ler maka riy rler la kropna-krieutu , nniahora-nniala ' a de rlardoinla dewade , lera nwamuela me wolla mana nakleh lair wa .
the stars will be falling from the sky , and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken . ||| Hota wtiona mana pala tuinia . Ne mak kodi plolli la darta-lyanti mana hota nawniatiri-nawnialiakra .
Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory . ||| La'awa ler de dewade rimormiori ramkek reria Rimormiori A'na Amuai owa'ana pa Adiella kakma wawannu , de Agodia A plo'lu-mneh ' u , A preh ' u-mka'yu mak kamehi-kayona la liplipa-kamka'mani .
Then he will send out his angels , and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds , from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky . ||| Hota Rimormiori A'na A die ghopan pa A hopopnu mak kden la Ilyamou-Watyatoha rawoka-rale'ga A mu'tu-rah ' u maka Uplerlawna Nwalir nian oleka de , mak kdella noha uhunu ewatni-lyanti nayanni .
Now from the fig tree , learn this parable . When the branch has now become tender and produces its leaves , you know that the summer is near , ||| Mia'ala wniatutu-wniaye ' a la kar on de . La'pa mtiamnia olli demade nmor wia , de miatg oleka lerwarnu nwakrian wia .
even so you also , when you see these things coming to pass , know that it is near , at the doors . ||| Hota emkade wal lia mimkeka hare honona mak A'ukot nohor olek diwa , de miatg oleka de lerni-melli nhi ' pa nwakrian wia .
Most certainly I say to you , this generation will not pass away until all these things happen . ||| Totpa miatga ! Riy la ' a tuwu di de edon rmat mia'ta , de hare honona mak ukot nohor oleka di hota rtutu-rte'ewa . A li'ru ri raplola .
Heaven and earth will pass away , but my words will not pass away . ||| Hota lyanti nora nohkeran di mana rmolu-rhelam wa mere A li'ru-tu'nu de ndella pa nodi liarni .
But of that day or that hour no one knows-not even the angels in heaven , nor the Son , but only the Father . ||| Riy id ho'mana hota naplin niohora la ' a hya ' lera-hya ' mela Rimormioria A'na A die maimia'yu owa'ana . Uplerlawna hopopanni nekane raplinga , Uplerlawna A'nani A ' die ho'mana uplinga . Eneknek to'ama , A'mu la Ilyamou-Watyatoha nampena ed mak katga .
Watch , keep alert , and pray , for you do n't know when the time is . ||| Hade pede orahnioratmi ! Yoma miy edonna miat niohora lera-mel maka hota A maimia'yu de ntutu-nte'ewa .
It is like a man traveling to another country , having left his house and given authority to his servants , and to each one his work , and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch . ||| Alia'awa la ' Ilyamou-Watyatoha pa Amuai owa'an de , emolmolla riy id nhopal la olietleta . Nto'or la romni-lewnu ne naltarga la hopopanni-lili'irnu limni ralamni , rima-rima nora kniarni . Ne nano ' taru mak katiaka nhiari totpa natiak samomuou e maimiaini .
Watch therefore , for you do n't know when the lord of the house is coming-whether at evening , or at midnight , or when the rooster crows , or in the morning , ||| Emkade walia orahnioratmi pa mimtiaka yoma miy miplin niohora ler meni pa Matrommi Nati'ila-nawal wia , la'pa lera nmel wa , edonan de mel letgara , edonan de mela nhawulla walli , edonan de yawyawar melmel ma'ta .
lest , coming suddenly , he might find you sleeping . ||| Yanpa plinu-plin pa Amuai die , Aliernana mtieparla yanina .
What I tell you , I tell all , Watch ! ||| Hya ' maka A'ukota tiy miy di , A'ukot targa la riy honona , Orahnioratmi !
It was now two days before the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread , and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception and kill him . ||| Tre ' ma'ta lera woru de lerlalawna Paska de la ' a ler maka Yahudi re rhoratreria ir tuini-wedni la ler maka ralewan la ' a kokohoga la ' a Mesir , me lerlalawna Yahudi maka ra'ana rot miaka edonna rnairia tgo ' a nhi ' pa nrehgor wua . Noma imam-imam o'tani-matni re rora makwatutu-kwaye ' a agama rwahak talan pa rtorna Yesus pa rwenna la ' a wunwunamnu .
For they said , Not during the feast , because there might be a riot among the people . ||| Mere riwra , Yan memmemna rhi ' a la ' a lera maka ha riwra ramuki-rahepur la re , yoma hota lima-rora kokokna-rariarni .
While he was at Bethany , in the house of Simon the leper , as he sat at the table , a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard-very costly . She broke the jar and poured it over his head . ||| La'pa Yesus Nden la leta Betania , pa Na'an rerer lia ' a Simon maka ululu de klernana nnienia ulityata de genni . Noma patke ' ida nmai Yesus de , de nodia potla ida maka ha rhi ' nana la watu-watu mak welli werta , de npenpuen lia wu'ru huwua mikmikri narwastu , mak welli werwerta wali . Noka patke ' de nhi ' wah ' a potal de nurnu na'nama nwalia wu'ru della Yesus o'tani wawannu .
But there were some who were indignant among themselves , saying , Why has this ointment been wasted ? ||| Riy dom mak kden handi rawenna pa idma nakot la ida , riwra , Hya ' ed mak krei piede nhuri-nwaldioinia wu'ru mak kalweli wierwerat dena ? !
For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor . So they grumbled against her . ||| La'pa na'olga wu'ru de ho'mana nlernan kupna nareh dioin kupna-kai gaji la anni ida gahani , pa welli de hota rala la riy mak kakleha-kaplara . Dewade rpolliohor memna patke ' de onnila hihi'ini de .

for it was very big . Looking up , they saw that the stone was rolled back . ||| Mere la ' pa rwakriania hoi die onni dewade ramkek de wat liawan maka ha ra rherit targa hoi die nhiarni ema rwaklol dioin oleka wa .

it seemed good to me also , having traced the course of all things accurately from the first , to write to you in order , most excellent Theophilus , ||| Pa a ' muana awuarora de hota samoga pa aghi ' wali horta pa ga ukot nohor kalwiedweda hare honona la ' Tuna , yoma a'utiana prorowta memna hare honona ndella onni pa la ntut lia hohoni , pede dodo'ondi de agat niohor memna .

according to the custom of the priest 's office , his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense . ||| La ' ler de imam-imam re rhedga patui cabut undi totpa rwalir niana he ' ed mak hota ktutnia ayalin la Orgahi-Orha ' a roma kreini ralamni pa emeknekama nhi'inde ha rhi ' a de . Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me , to take away my reproach among men . ||| Noma niwra , Hota la'awa hohoni di , de Orgahi-Orha ' a Ntutga ralam kalwiedni pa Ntulan la mai a ' u yoma Nhi ' a pua a ' u ' a'na pede a ' g edonna muola-mua ' a owa'an la ' a rira gaini ralamni .

to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph , of David 's house . The virgin 's name was Mary . ||| Nhopan doinia Gabriel nmaiya hararara mak kwawa Maria mak kor Yusup , ray Daud duratni-waitni , de ranyah ' a tar oleka . Ra'an lira-remun waw pa hota rmehlima , mere Maria edon nor muanke ' id mana rawok ma'ta la yaninni .

Tertera-demdema berkat nwewar nana a'na maka ha muor nian de !

Blessed is she who believed , for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord ! ||| Mlier la unut lawna yoma mpiesiay oleka de maka Orgahi-Orha ' a Nakot tiy o ' a hota nayamkeka .

His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him . ||| Tuw nernu-nha'ata , mere Orgahi-Orha ' a O ' a ed mak ktutga ralam kalwiedmu la ' riy maka ka'unni-kamta'ata O ' a .

for my eyes have seen your salvation , ||| Yoma agal memna ma'tu olli rora pa ga umkeka riy maka Omtiutga olek pa Nma Namori-nalewna rimormiori de !

When they had done this , they caught a great multitude of fish , and their net was breaking . ||| La'pa ir Simon rinni tialli , dewade tialli nma nwenna la i'na , pa reiniande tiala natpoini-nahliawra .

Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude , they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus . ||| Mere la ' ler de de riy rahu rehia , pede edonna rlernan talan pa rodia la ' a rialma , pa narieiniande rodia pa rha'at la roma wuwannu na'nama rwaye'er doinia roma ritni . Na'nama ralernu mak kaliu'uta de na'itar neka u'tani totpa nle'era la Yesus gaini raralamni la ' a mutu letgarni .

The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason , saying , Who is this who speaks blasphemies ? Yoma atiaru Uplerlawna nanpena Namou-nawitna rira do'oni-halli .
But Jesus , perceiving their thoughts , answered them , Why are you reasoning so in your hearts ? ||| Mere Yesus Natg oleka hya ' ed maka ha ratiana re pede Nakot la re Niwra , Ee , hya ' ed mak kariei pia mimpiarora-mpialai yatiana rena ? !

Noma Yesus Nakot la mak kaliu'ut de Niwra , Hyalia , mumat doin la pa mpuopna u'tamu de pa mlia'awa rommu .

Amazement took hold on all , and they glorified God . They were filled with fear , saying , We have seen strange things today . ||| Ne riy honona la hande mana rwer rer wiawni , ne ra'uli-rawedia Uplerlawna la ' genni-tienni Ilyamou-Watyatoha . Noma ramta'at pa riwra , It edonna tamkek ma'ta hihi ' a-yapyapi maka itamkeka la ' ler di !
After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office , and said to him , Follow me ! ||| La'pa Yesus Nlergot wa noma Namkek nana mak kawoka blastena id de nanni Lewi .
