Miala de naplola , mere miy edonna mtiutga nhiolia plola-mneha la rimormior wialmi , me edon mtiut walia ralam kalwiedmi la Uplerlawna . Maka plollolli de totpena mhi ' samomuou lia Uplerlawna Nor rimormior wialmi me yana mhioratdoin wal pia miala nhiakra id ralamni la termida sepersepuluh la ' a Uplerlawna .
Woe to you Pharisees ! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces . ||| Riy Parisi miy die , adoh ! Hota mlier la yatyatni-halalli yatlorni-yatra'ani ! La'pa mlier la Yahudi kreini-iskolli de mpiahak gen miak kden la gaini , ne mihepru yoma mak kden la ya'olgeni rhi ' miy lia rekna-waiti .
Woe to you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! For you are like hidden graves , and the men who walk over them do n't know it . ||| Adoh ! Hota yatyatni-halalli yatlorni-yatra'ani e nhortiut nian miy ! Mtiutga inonmi emeka riy kalwiedweda mere miy ralamni de npenpuen lia yatni-halli . Emkade pede miy emeknekama hoi-kietra maka riy raplin niohora etla hande pede rlola wawannu yoma raplin niohora hoi eda de maka kpenpuen nohora hya ' maka kahuwu-kawoini .
One of the lawyers answered him , Teacher , in saying this you insult us also . ||| Noma tungkurga agama ida nakot la Yesus niwra , Tungkurga , la'pa Omukot nohora lir de , de O ' e Mupolu-mulielan wali ami .
He said , Woe to you lawyers also ! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry , and you yourselves wo n't even lift one finger to help carry those burdens . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Hota mlier wal lia yatyatni-halalli yatlorni-yatra'ani , yoma tungkuru miy die nhi'inde miala wniatutu-wniaye ' a emolmolan nekama mkienia kwar werwerat rehi la riy wawannu , mere miy edon mtiulan et miemna la riy totpena rlernohora wniatutmi-wniaye'emi re .
Woe to you ! For you build the tombs of the prophets , and your fathers killed them . ||| Adoh ! Hota mimlier la yatyatni-halalli yatlorni-yatra'ani yoma miy e miwra mtiutga inon wamuehemi samomuounu yoma mpiedia hoi-kietra la ' a makwohorulu-ktatrulu ululu re . Mere miy die mana emolmolan nekama miy upmi-tgarmi maka rwen oleka makwohorulu-ktatrulu la ' ler delloo !
So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers . For they killed them , and you build their tombs . ||| Miy orgahami mtiutga de miy e mpiayow nohora orgahami upmi-tgarmi hihi'ini-yapyapni . Ir er maka kwunu-kwenna makwohorulu-ktatrulu re , pa hota plola miy er mak khi ' a makwohorulu-ktatrulu hoini-kietarni re .
Therefore also the wisdom of God said , ‘ I will send to them prophets and apostles , and some of them they will kill and persecute , ||| La ' hade pede Uplerlawna mak katu hya ' a-hya ' a honona de Niwra , Hota A ' u'enyatga makwohorulu-ktatrulu rora riy makodia A li'ru-tu'nu , ne hota miy mak kmormior lia dodo'ondi mpienna doma , ne la dom de mimuki-mima'ala .
that the blood of all the prophets , which was shed from the foundation of the world , may be required of this generation , ||| Emkade pede hota miy mak kdella nohkerna la ' a lera-mela ri hota er maka kler la niukum werwerat memna yoma miy er mak kakwara riy mak kakot nohora Uplerlawna lirni-tunnu de wniunnu-wnienanni la ' a ler maka Uplerlawna na'nama Nakoki-nayapi nohkeran di pa la'pa ntutu-nte'ela lera-mela ri .
from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah , who perished between the altar and the sanctuary . ' Yes , I tell you , it will be required of this generation . ||| Hota mikwara Habel wniunnu-wnienanni pa nla ntut lia wnienna la makwohorulu-ktatrulu Sakaria , maka ha rwenna la Uplerlawna roma kreini nora katri'ana mesbah letgarni . Mpiesiaya ! Plol toto ' a pa wniunu-wnienna honona re , de hota tuwu di rakwar reria do ' a-hala re honona .
Woe to you lawyers ! For you took away the key of knowledge . You did n't enter in yourselves , and those who were entering in , you hindered . ||| Tungkuru agama miy , hota mimlier la yatyatni-halalli yatlorni-yatra'ani , yoma emeknekama miy er mak ktorreria konsi pa ma mhiaria rira o'tani-kriahlanu la ' a Uplerlawna yala'ani , mere emeknekama miy nek de mhioplial oleka konis de . Miat niohora nhioli-lieta ilu-wniehwa pa rlernohora Uplerlawna mere miy orgahami nek de edonna mliernohora Uplerlawna talanni de . Ne miy orgahami mana ed maka mtierteri-mtiatawa riy dom maka kiwra kat niohora .
As he said these things to them , the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry , and to draw many things out of him , ||| La'pa Yesus Nto'or la ' a gen die dewade tungkurga agama rora riy Parisi re roir reria Yesus . Honona re rtot pa rna'aili-rna'ailia Yesus totpena Nakot momuoga hya ' a-hya ' to ' a .
lying in wait for him , and seeking to catch him in something he might say , that they might accuse him . ||| Ne la ' hade de ir honona rta'wa reria tlinni la Yesus lirni-tunnu re totpena yanpa Yesus Nweta hya ' maka edon kla ' nana ir o'tani-matni ralamni de demade pleta-plet pa rla ' rwaghal Yesus la ' ira .
Meanwhile , when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together , so much so that they trampled on each other , he began to tell his disciples first of all , Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees , which is hypocrisy . ||| La ' ler de wal pia , rimormiori riwnu-halli rmai pia rawoka , de idma mpakdie'da la ida . Noma Yesus Nakot ulga la maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re Niwra , Mierammi la ' temni la ' a riy Parisi re . Yanpa mimliernohora ir wniehwani-liakatni maka rtota inonni samomuou mere plollolli de riy yatyat ira munafik . Ir wniehwani re emeknekama tgo ' a maka oke ' to ' a maka ha rkenia la wetra ' ota tarigu pa nhi'nande nha'at momuou .
But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed , nor hidden that will not be known . ||| Mere hihi'ini-yapyapni maka kayade ' a , hota rayamkek momuou , ne maka kayawunmua hota rat niohora momuou .
Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light . What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops . ||| Ne hota hya ' maka miy mipupua la rira tlinni ralamni me maka ha mpiahaur walia la mel'utni-malienni , de hota repra rauria , de riy rat niohora yoma hota rkakna la lol meni-meni to'owa .
I tell you , my friends , do n't be afraid of those who kill the body , and after that have no more that they can do . ||| A talanwa'lu miy hononmi mhioratreria ! Yan memmemna mimta'ata riy rwunu-rwenan miy inonmi . Yoma hota rwenan to ' a miy inonmi , mere ta'en niana ir rhi ' yawuhi-yawe'et la miy aranmi jiwa pa rla ' Ilyamou-Watyatoha .
But I will warn you whom you should fear . Fear him who after he has killed , has power to cast into Gehenna . Yes , I tell you , fear him . ||| Mai pia ukot nohora hota he ' ed maka mimta'ata . Mimta'at de , mimta'ata Uplerlawna . Yoma la'pa Nwunu-nwenan riy inonni , de Enodi plolli pa Nnaklia aranmi la ai mormiori ralamni naraka . Mpiesiaya A li'ru di . Uplerlawna nanpena mimta'ata .
Are n't five sparrows sold for two assaria coins ? Not one of them is forgotten by God . ||| La'pa ma'nu prowta mak kakleha weli id ho'mana hota Uplerlawna edonna Nhortaplinga de .
But the very hairs of your head are all counted . Therefore do n't be afraid . You are of more value than many sparrows . ||| La'pa mortu lihirmi la ' o'tami ho'mana Uplerlawna Nat niohora momuou . La ' hade pede yan mimta'ata . Yoma Uplerlawna Nsayn miy me Ntera-ndem miy nareh dioin meman la ma'nu prowta re .
I tell you , everyone who confesses me before men , the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God , ||| Mhioratrer samomuoga ! Riy maka kwayow nohor pesiayni mai A ' u la ' a rimormiori gaini ralamni , de hota Rimormior A'na A ' die mana hota wuayow nohor e ' a la ' a Uplerlawna Nora E hopopanni-lili'irnu re gaini ralamni , Agiwra A mu'tu-rah ' u id e ' a .
but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God 's angels . ||| Mere la'pa hameni ed mak kreher pa kiwra e ' edon nlernohora A lia rimormiori gaini ralamni , de hota Rimormiori A'na A ' die mana hota rieher doin walia e ' a la ' a Uplerlawna Nor E hopopanni re gaini ralamni .
Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven , but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven . ||| La'pa he ' ed mak kapolu-kaliella Rimormior A'na A ' die , de hota Uplerlawna Namou-nawitna do'oni-halli de , mere la'pa hameni ed mak kapolu-kaliella Uplerlawna Nhiw Lululli , de hota Uplerlawna edon Namou-nawitna do'oni-halli de .
When they bring you before the synagogues , the rulers , and the authorities , do n't be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say , ||| La'pa rod miy lia ' a geni-tien maka Yahudi rhi ' a kreini-iskolli de , pa rhudi-rpar miy lia , onde rodi miy la ' a o'ta-mat lalawna gaini ralamni onde mak ktorna horta-hairi pa rhudi-rpar miy , de yan memmemna ihrami rteplu la ' a hota mniairia hya ' lir pa mia mhieri-mhielta inonmi .
for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say . ||| Yoma la ' a hya ' ed maka hota ha mikota , de Uplerlawna Nhiw Lululli maka Nkar lia miy ralamni pa mikota hare , la ' ler maka ha rod lia ' a-rod maiya miy lia re !
One of the multitude said to him , Teacher , tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me . ||| Noma riy id la ' a riy mutlialawna re nakot la Yesus niwra , Tungkur Yesus e ! Mtia ' tieka lirmu la hya'lu totpena nal teka amro ' a ina-am mamni re'eni-tniarnu oke ' a mai a ' u .
But he said to him , Man , who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you ? ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Hyalia , he ' ed maka kran A ' pua A lia godi plolli pa ghakra mimrio ' a re'emi-tniarmi ? !
He said to them , Beware ! Keep yourselves from covetousness , for a man 's life does n't consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses . ||| La'pa nhorwua noma Yesus Nwagahniorta riy honona mak kden la hande pa Niwra , Erammi la temmi ! Yan memmemna mpial lia riy maka kapal niana kupna-kai , re ' a-tniaru . Yoma rira mormiorni edonna nawniair la re'eni-tniar wamueheni , kennama re'eni-tniar liawan memna .
He spoke a parable to them , saying , The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot nohora yawalliohora dilla ira , pa Niwra , La ' riy makre ' a-maktaru ida gahani nhyi ' a-tlunni maka kpoti-kaduw nohora yawuli-yatniamni mak kodia pripanni-fa'anni .
He reasoned within himself , saying , ‘ What will I do , because I do n't have room to store my crops ? ' ||| Noma nwarora de , Hota gen mieni owa'an pa akenia noh di wullu-we'elli ? La ' dodo'ondi de aghi ' hya ' o ?
He said , ‘ This is what I will do . I will pull down my barns , build bigger ones , and there I will store all my grain and my goods . ||| Noma nmeh ' a nekpa naltiertier lia orgahi niwra , Dudnu-dudnu honona , aghopan nekpa rweyata-rwaniawua , ne awuatatg owa'ana warwuarnu maka inponni . Totpena la ' honona re de awuatierun tar momuoga metma wetra ' lawna re honona , me re ' a-tniaru re korni re honona wali .
I will tell my soul , Soul , you have many goods laid up for many years . Take your ease , eat , drink , and be merry . ' ||| Nhor nianpena a orgah ' u ukot owa'an la ' a a orgah ' u giwra , Adoh ! Aliernana oleka pripanni-fa'anni la ' a hare honona mak samomuou , pede hota awuatierun targa hare honona . A ' g edon kari owa'ana mere awuei tio ' pa a'una-gegemnu me ghi ' hya ' mak khi ' a ralmu pa nahepru .
But God said to him , ‘ You foolish one , tonight your soul is required of you . The things which you have prepared-whose will they be ? ' ||| Mere Uplerlawna hota Nakot la riy de Niwra , Hoi ! Podkge ! Hota mel di meman pa omuat wia . Ne hota he ' ed maka klernan o re'emu-tniarmu maka ha muwoka totpena orgahamu mu'un lola-muemun lola reno ? !
So is he who lays up treasure for himself , and is not rich toward God . ||| Emkadella la ' a riy maka kmeh ' a kwahak pa nre ' a-ntaru , mere nahmena nwahaka re ' a-tniar inhatta maka samoga la Uplerlawna yamkekni .
He said to his disciples , Therefore I tell you , do n't be anxious for your life , what you will eat , nor yet for your body , what you will wear . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re Niwra , La ' hade pede mhioratreria , yan mimta'at nohora hya ' mak hota ha mi'ina-miemnia , me hota ha mhiewta-mniairia .
Life is more than food , and the body is more than clothing . ||| Yoma mormior die narehia ya'ana-yemnu , ne inonmi de nareh niana hewewta-naniairi .
Consider the ravens , they do n't sow , they do n't reap , they have no warehouse or barn , and God feeds them . How much more valuable are you than birds ! ||| Mimkek teka la ma'nu kakaka . Ir edonna rawuli-ratniamni me edonna rreiki-rwo'ora me rakleh walia dudnu-dudnu pa rwatiernia ya'ana-yemun la . La'pa emkade ho'mana Uplerlawna Ntera-ndem wali ira . Ne Uplerlawna Nsaynia miy die nareh dioin la onu-ma'nu re !
Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height ? ||| Rimormiori maka ralamni worwuorga onde namta'ata matmiatni ho'mana takeni nhaur nan aranni oke ' nmeh ' a totpena edonan nmati .
If then you are n't able to do even the least things , why are you anxious about the rest ? ||| Ne la'pa hade nek de kuku ' ho'mana takeni miy e mhi ' nana , hya ' ed mak karei pia mimta'ata nohora miy mormiormi la ' a hare honona maka mi'ina-miemun me maka mhiewta-mniairi ? !
Consider the lilies , how they grow . They do n't toil , neither do they spin , yet I tell you , even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these . ||| Mimkek la kihir mak kadeutu re mormiorni . Kihir mak kadeutu re , edonna rkari , me edonna ratenni-ramairi . Mere mhioratreria , ray Salomo mak kre ' a-ktar die nek de edonna nhewta-nnairia naniairia samomuounu pa emeknekama kihir mak kadeutu re .
But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field , which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven , how much more will he clothe you , O you of little faith ? ||| Wewna mak kden la rai mtatanni re rmor lia ler di , mere repar dewade rhoklai la . Wewan nek de Uplerlawna ed maka nhi'inde Nahowna-nakgara pede samoga la yamkekni . Mere miy die edon mpiesiaya de wewna nek de Uplerlawna Ntera-ndema ne hota yaho'ma miy ? !
Do n't seek what you will eat or what you will drink , neither be anxious . ||| Yana wniarormi-wnialaimi nod rer tio'ola hya ' maka hota ha mi'ina-miemnia , me yana mimta'at nohora .
For the nations of the world seek after all of these things , but your Father knows that you need these things . ||| Yoma riy mak kaplin niohor ma'ta Uplerlawna , nek de er maka kahakhak nohora hare honona . Mere miy Amlawanmi Nat niohor olekwa de miy e mpiaka perlu hare honona .
But seek God 's Kingdom , and all these things will be added to you . ||| Pede mpiahak ulga totpena Uplerlawna Nodi plolli la ' a miy mormiormi-dardiarmi , ne hota hya ' maka mikleha de hota Enal momuoga tiy miy .
Do n't be afraid , little flock , for it is your Father 's good pleasure to give you the Kingdom . ||| La ' miy mutmi de riy doma rmeh ' a mere emkade ho'mana yan mimta'ata . Yoma miy Amlawanmi ralamni napranrana nahepru pa Nal miy pia mior E ' pa miodi plolli .
Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy . Make for yourselves purses which do n't grow old , a treasure in the heavens that does n't fail , where no thief approaches and no moth destroys . ||| Mi'ol dioini miy re'emi-tniarmi pa mial welli la maka a'na riy kapatyata . Emkade pede miwok wutga re ' a-tniaru plollola la Ilyamou-Watyatoha , mak emolmolan nekama kupna genni mak edonna kyata . Re ' a-tniar die la Ilyamou-Watyatoha , de taken niana rahor doinia la , makamnelu-kamna ' a taken niana rwuri-rgalam nana , ne erieri edonna na'an wal lia .
For where your treasure is , there will your heart be also . ||| Pede miwoka re ' a-tniaru la ' a Ilyamou-Watyatoha yoma hota la meni pa miy re'emi-tniarmi erla de hota miy ralammi et wal lia hande .
Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning . ||| Yan minin matmi mere mpiahi ' pa mkiar lia Uplerlawna kniarni pa emeknekama riy maka raini nden rer lia temni , me wa'duni mana yana nmati .
Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast , that when he comes and knocks , they may immediately open to him . ||| Mhi ' emolmolan nekama hopopna-lili'iru mak edonna kanin matni la rwei-rnara tunni npolan la ' a yawok mehlima . Totpena la'pa tunni de nmai pia nkorkor la nhiari , de nleretniekla rhari nhiari la tunni de .
Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes . Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself , make them recline , and will come and serve them . ||| Eee ! Hopopna-lili'iru re rlernana unut lawna , yoma tunni de nmai die e ramatmat ee ! Mpiesiayo , hota tun de nek de nwahi ' a-nwayod pia nhima-nre ' hopopanni re . Hota nwak pa hopopanni-lili'irnu de ramtatna pa ra'ana ne orgahani nhima-nre ' a re .
They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so . ||| Eee ! Rlernan unut lawn ee ! Yoma ir tunni de nmai die nlernana ir mat lia wniei la ' a mela letgargarni , onde repreparreria ho'mana edonna ranin ma'ta .
But know this , that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming , he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into . ||| Mhioratreria , yawalliohora id owa'an hadi . La'pa orroma nat niohora hya ' a lera-mela mak kamna ' a nma nkamna ' a la e romni , de hota e natiak reri totpena mak kamna ' a yana na'unut nan e ' a .
Therefore be ready also , for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you do n't expect him . ||| Ne hota miy miana emkade walia . Mitiak reria ! Mitlin reri-mitail rer lia Uplerlawna lirni , yoma Rimormiori A'na A ' die hota muai owa'an de emeknekama makwuri-kgalmu la melmela mak riy raplin niohora .
Peter said to him , Lord , are you telling this parable to us , or to everybody ? ||| Noma Petrus natiana la Yesus , Matromlawnu ne , hota wniatut die Matro'mu Nal to ' a ma ' ami , onde la ' riy honona wali ?
The Lord said , Who then is the faithful and wise steward , whom his lord will set over his household , to give them their portion of food at the right times ? ||| Noma Itmatromni Nakot la Niwra , Hota la ' he ' tiy miy , mhi ' inonni pa emeka hopopna-lili'iru maka khu'ru-khelma me natu natlina-nataili ? Hopopna mak emkade upni-matromni mana nran e ' pa nla ' o'tani la ' hopopanni-lili'irnu korni totpena e ' ed mak khakra mutwualli re ya'anni-yemannu la ' a lelera-melmela re .
Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes . ||| Hota hopopan mak kdenrer lia kniarni de hota nlernan unut lawna , yoma matromni nawal pia nmai die nlernan entepartarlia tulla-kniari .
Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has . ||| Mpiesiayo , hota upni-matromni de npesiaya riy de pede nran e ' pa nwal lia mak klina-kmata la e re'eni-tniarnu honona .
But if that servant says in his heart , ‘ My lord delays his coming , ' and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants , and to eat and drink and to be drunken , ||| Mere la'pa hopopna-lili'iru de nwarora la ralamni hota upni-matromni mahneka nanpena nmai . Pede nliwra-nkaklia e kniarwialli re patke ' a rora muanke ' a , ne na'ana-nemun pa npehera-nma'wu .
then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he is n't expecting him and in an hour that he does n't know , and will cut him in two , and place his portion with the unfaithful . ||| Dewade upni-matromni de nawal pia nmai wia la ' a lera-mel maka hopopan de naplin niohora . Pa nhi'nande upni-matromni nukmua werwerta riy de ne nhokar doinia pa nre ' wut lia riy maka edonna ka'unni-kamta'ata Uplerlawna .
That servant who knew his lord 's will , and did n't prepare nor do what he wanted , will be beaten with many stripes , ||| Riy maka kat niohora tunni ralma-riorni , mere edonna nwahi ' a-nwayodi pa nlernohora upni-matromni de ralma-riorni , de hota rliwra mantiarga la genni .
but he who did n't know , and did things worthy of stripes , will be beaten with few stripes . To whomever much is given , of him will much be required , and to whom much was entrusted , of him more will be asked . ||| Mere la ' riy mak kaplin niohora upni-matromni ralma-riorni , nwehwa sal , pa upni-matromni nliwra-nkaklia , hota liwliwarni edonna nwerta . Yoma riy maka Uplerlawna Nala ruri-lai onde Uplerlawna Nal oleka pa nodi plolli la rimormior wialli , de hota la'pa edon natlin la Uplerlawna lirni de , hota Uplerlawna Nto'on reri narehia riy dom to ' a .
I came to throw fire on the earth . I wish it were already kindled . ||| Amuai pia ghakra rimormiori mak khi ' samomuou la ' riy mak khi ' yatyatni pa emeknekama ai mak ka'an ora-au mak edon karuri me mak karuri de edon na'ana . A ralmu edon namtemna yoma A ' g edon ghi ' hade pa nhorwua .
But I have a baptism to be baptized with , and how distressed I am until it is accomplished ! ||| Amueh ' a neka hota lier la yamuki-yama'ala la'pa matmiati-molmuolu . Ne A ih'ru-ralmu teptieplia yoma A ' g edonna Aliernan ma'ta re !
Do you think that I have come to give peace in the earth ? I tell you , no , but rather division . ||| Yanpa miy miatniekame Amuai die Agod niek riy mak kden la nohkeran di wawannu pa rora rimormior wialli re rkalwieda . Hota edon emkade , mere mpiesiaya ! Onnila A rerie'yu pede riy id nor rimormior wialli re rahuri-rawo'ora .
For from now on , there will be five in one house divided , three against two , and two against three . ||| La'pa lera-mela ri de roma ida mniotni riy wolima de hota riy wotelu rpesiay A ' u me korni de edonna , onde riy woru rpesiaya mere korni edonna , nhi'nande la ' rom de rahuri-rawo'ora . Hota emkade pa nodi liarni .
They will be divided , father against son , and son against father , mother against daughter , and daughter against her mother , mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law , and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law . ||| Hota ama nora a'nani muanke ' a rawowo'ora . Ina nora a'nani patke ' a mana rawo'ora . Hota ina nora yananni patke ' a idma nwohora-ntatr ida .
He said to the multitudes also , When you see a cloud rising from the west , immediately you say , ‘ A shower is coming , ' and so it happens . ||| Yesus Nakot wal lia ' rirahu Niwra , La'pa mimkek nana kakma nha ' a la warta , de hota mlieretniekla miwra , Hota otna , ne plola otna nturu .
When a south wind blows , you say , ‘ There will be a scorching heat , ' and it happens . ||| Ne la'pa mieram nana anni nten lia tranna , de miwra , Hota lera nhit panpahna . Ne plola pahna .
You hypocrites ! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky , but how is it that you do n't interpret this time ? ||| Hoi ! Miy die mtiot inonmi emeka riy mak kat niohor Uplerlawna yala'ani de mere plollolli de miplin niohora ! La'pa mimkek la ' a kakam larlara onde mieram nana anni nteni , de miat niohora hota otna onde hota pahna . Ne nihya'pa mimkek nana A hihi ' u-yapya'pu me mitlin la A li'ru-tu'nu mere edonna mnia'erit nana ? !
Why do n't you judge for yourselves what is right ? ||| Nihya'pa miy orgahami edonna mpiaror nohora hya ' mak kaplola totpena mliernohora ? !
For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate , try diligently on the way to be released from him , lest perhaps he drag you to the judge , and the judge deliver you to the officer , and the officer throw you into prison . ||| La'pa he ' ed maka kod miy la ' a watghudi lokarni hakim , de mpiahak talan pa miora riy de mkialwied nohora lira-tun die la ' a talan letgar memna . Yoma la'pa edonan de hota riy de nhed miy lia ' a makhudi-makpara mak hota nal owa'an miy lia hgei mak kodia hapa'pani polisi o'tani ne hota hgei de nho'la miy lia roma nhio'la ralamni .
I tell you , you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny . ||| Mimpiesiayo , hota miy edon mliergot la roma nhio'la ralamni la'pa rwei pia mpiair dioinia papiairmi honona .
Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices . ||| La ' ler de , riy rwahauria la Yesus la ' a riy Galilea dom maka Pilatus nwunu-nwenna , la'pa rtepartarlia rala nhioini-tnianni persembahan la Uplerlawna .
Jesus answered them , Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans , because they suffered such things ? ||| La'pa Natlin samomuoga wniahaur de noma Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , Yoma riy Galilea rlernan yawunu-yawenna mak emkade , de hota mpiarora de hare do'oni-halli re rarehelia riy mutlialawan mak kden la Galilea korni rena ? !
I tell you , no , but unless you repent , you will all perish in the same way . ||| Wniaror de nhala ! Mere mpiahniorta ! La'pa miy edonna mhioitio'or doini-mtiahnei dioinia miy do'omi-halmi , miy hononmi nek de hota mlier wal lia matmiati-molmuolu plalahwa .
Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them-do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem ? ||| Emkade wal lia ' riy termida wehrani wo'awa , maka rom tutulu ida napru'wu pa nutin wenna ir la Siloam , la ' a Yerusalem letni . Hota miatniekame hare do'oni-halli rarehia mak kden la Yerusalem korni pede rom tutul die nutin wenna re ? !
I tell you , no , but , unless you repent , you will all perish in the same way . ||| Wniaror de nhala . A'ukot owa'ana ralamni tiy miy . La'pa miy edonna mhioitio'or doini-mtiahnei dioini do'omi-halmi , miy hononmi nek de hota mlier walia matmiati-molmuolu plalahwa .
He spoke this parable . A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard , and he came seeking fruit on it and found none . ||| Hade nhorwua noma Yesus Nwahaur nohora walia yawalliohor di . Niwra , La ' a nhyi ' a lokrahi ida de ora nhyi ' de ntamin walia kar ona ida . La'pa lera ida noma ora nhyi ' de nla nwahaka kar de wo'oni , mere edonna nlernan et wo'oni ida la .
He said to the vine dresser , ‘ Behold , these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree , and found none . Cut it down ! Why does it waste the soil ? ' ||| Noma nakot la riy mak katiaka nhyi ' de niwra , Tamkek la anni wotel mak klardoini olekwa de amua wuahaka kar de wo'oni . Mere a ' g edonna liernan etia wo'oni ida . Pa mhioi wro'ona la ! Samomuounu de ittamnia onni id owa'an mak hota kmori la tan ihi di !
He answered , ‘ Lord , leave it alone this year also , until I dig around it and fertilize it . ||| Mere mak katiaka nhyi ' de nwak lir la niwra , Yana Tuna , ndena plein la pa tamkek teka la anin dina . Tuna ! Pena a'uwlia ' tani la walli-walli , nanpena akenia pip tie ' la !
If it bears fruit , fine , but if not , after that , you can cut it down . ' ||| Yanpa anin li'ir di nanpena nawo ' a mere la'pa tamkek la pa edonna nadeutu nanpena tuna nhopan pa retan doinia la .
He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day . ||| Lera ida , la ' Sabat lerni maka Yahudi edon rkar lia de de Yesus Ntepartarlia wniatutu la ' a gen miaka nhi'inde Yahudi rhi ' a kreini-iskolli de .
Behold , there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years . She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up . ||| La ' hande de patke ' a ida enado'or nohora mehrani la ' a anni termida wehrani wo'awa yoma hegana nhu ' r ralma . Patke ' de to'orni nkokioili ne taken niana nwalle'era onni pa ntutrieri kdededa .
When Jesus saw her , he called her and said to her , Woman , you are freed from your infirmity . ||| La'pa Yesus Namkek tar lia dewade Npolga pa Niwra , Ina , mmuai ee ! Nmai noma Nakot la Niwra , Dodo'ondi de Aghi ' kalwied o ' a !
He laid his hands on her , and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God . ||| Noma Yesus Nran limni la patke ' de wawannu dewade mtatan de nekpa nnienni-nhienni nmolu , ne pat de mana na'ulia-nawedia Uplerlawna-Mempulwatnu .
The ruler of the synagogue , being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath , said to the multitude , There are six days in which men ought to work . Therefore come on those days and be healed , and not on the Sabbath day ! ||| La ' noma o'ta-mat la gen miak Yahudi rhi ' a kreini-iskolli de nawenan doin la yoma Yesus Nhi ' kalwieda makamehra la ' a Sabat lerni . La hade pede o'ta-mat de nawenan pa nakot la riy honona mak kden la re niwra , Hoi ! Mitlin pa a'ukota . La ' a krei id ralamni de itkar lia lera wonema , pa la ' lera matnemnema re de mai pia mhi ' kalwieda mehra-maumi re ! Mere mitlina ! Yan memmemna mmiai lia ' Sabat lerni emeka ler di . Mhioratreri oo !
Therefore the Lord answered him , You hypocrites ! Does n't each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water ? ||| Noma Itmatromni Yesus Nakot la , Niwra , Hoi ! Miy mtiota inonmi de emeka riy kalwiedweda mere la ' plolli de miy edon pusin nohora hya ' ed mak kaplola munafik ! La ' a Sabat lerni de miy hononmi miewar doinia nhiurmi-wnia'anmi pa miodia pa mlia mtip ger la remnia .
Ought not this woman , being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years , be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day ? ||| Nah , mai handi de Abrahama duratni-waitni patke ' a ida e namehra nan la anni termida wehrani wo'aw memna yoma la ' a wutwutu-kokgohu la hegana amlawanni . Pa emkameni owa'an pa mikota yana twe'er doinia la ' a wutwutu-kokgohonu la ' a Sabat lerni dina ? !
As he said these things , all his adversaries were disappointed , and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him . ||| Yesus lirni de Nhi ' amola-ma ' memna riy maka nhi'inde rora Yesus rwa'eriai mere la riy dom to ' a re rahepur nohora Yesus hihi'ini-yapyapni mak samomuou memna re .
He said , What is God 's Kingdom like ? To what shall I compare it ? ||| Noma Yesus Natiana Niwra , La'pa Uplerlawna tnioranni-riautnu la E rimormiori wawannu de emkameni la yala'ani ? Hota Agala yawalliohora hya ' a pa Aga ukot nohora harena ?
It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden . It grew and became a large tree , and the birds of the sky live in its branches . ||| Hota ha yala'ani emeknekama yawalliohor di . La'pa ha rtamni sasawi ola ida la nhyi'ini , sasawi ol de nmor pia olli-tapalli re rpoti-rkadwu , ne onu-ma'nu rma rapuon la ' a sasaw die tutnu-akni .
Again he said , To what shall I compare God 's Kingdom ? ||| Ralamni owa'an pa Yesus Natiana Niwra , Hota Agala yawalliohora hya ' pa ga ukot nohora Uplerlawna tnioranni-riautnu la E rimormiori wawannu ?
It is like yeast , which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour , until it was all leavened . ||| Uplerlawna rimormiorni yehwani emolmolan nekama tgo ' maka a'na patke ' a ida na ' nana pa la nawotra-nawah ' a wutga la wetra ' ota kilu terampwogata pa nha'ata mneneha .
He went on his way through cities and villages , teaching , and traveling on to Jerusalem . ||| La ' a talla plahwani maka Yesus Nlola pa Nla'awa la ' Yerusalem de Yesus Nwatutu-nwaye ' lolola la ' a leta-ruhun maka Ha Nlolola re !
One said to him , Lord , are they few who are saved ? He said to them , ||| Noma riy ida natiana niwra , Tuna , hota riy doma rmeh ' a mak klernana mormiori-dardiari plalahwa pa nodi liarni ? Noma Yesus Nakot la mak katlina re Niwra ,
Strive to enter in by the narrow door , for many , I tell you , will seek to enter in and will not be able . ||| Mihak totpena dodo'ondi de mpiakdie'da lola nhiar miaka kakmamah ' a , yoma mhioratreria , hota rirahu riwra rlola mere hota edonna rlernana .
When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door , and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door , saying , ‘ Lord , Lord , open to us ! ' then he will answer and tell you , ‘ I do n't know you or where you come from . ' ||| Yoma hota orroma namat pa nkahro'pa nhiarni . Pa hota miy miak edon kla ' ma'ta la rialam de e mtiutrier pia mtiepartarlia mkorkora nhiari pa miwra , Tuna mhuar niana nhiari mai ami ee ! Mere hota tun de niwra , A ' g e uplin miy , me hya ' noh miy ?
Then you will begin to say , ‘ We ate and drank in your presence , and you taught in our streets . ' ||| Noma hota mimpiahla lirni miwra , O e muplin niohora ami ? Ami e mak kor O ' pa ka'ana-kemun wutu , me tuna O ' orgahamu ed maka kwatutu-kwaye ' wali am lia loi-talan mak klola a let mamni ralamni , noma O ' edonna Mhua'wa nan ami ? !
He will say , ‘ I tell you , I do n't know where you come from . Depart from me , all you workers of iniquity . ' ||| Mere hota tun de nakot owa'ana niwra , A ' g e uplin miy di de me miy e mpiatiawu hya ' noha-hya ' rai ? Rhokar doin miy lia handi , miy maka khi ' a yatyatni-halalli !
There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham , Isaac , Jacob , and all the prophets in God 's Kingdom , and yourselves being thrown outside . ||| Ne hota la'pa mimkek tutga Abraham nora Isak me Yakop me la ' walia makwohorulu-ktatrulu re honona ramuki-rahepur la ' a Uplerlawna geni miaka Ntorna-nrautu emeka Ray . Mere miy die mpiolpuol inmi-mpiakwak ammi onnila rnaklia miy lia Uplerlawna genni de walli tio'ora !

and he who invited both of you would come and tell you , ‘ Make room for this person . I will get up and go to my father , and will tell him , Father , I have sinned against heaven and in your sight . ||| A'uwal niek la a a'mu onni wa . Ne pena awuaka lilili-mamuau lia e ' a . Yoma aghal olek la Uplerlawna Nora a'mu e ' a .

for this , my son , was dead and is alive again . He was lost and is found . ' Then they began to celebrate . ||| Yoma a a'nu di de emeknekama ha nmati olekwa mere nmori owa'an , me riwra ha nmolg olekwa mere tlernan owa'ana ! Dewade honona re rlernohora E lirni pa ramuki-rahepur nohora .

But when this your son came , who has devoured your living with prostitutes , you killed the fattened calf for him . ' ||| Mere a'namu de nkalgar doinia kupanmu-kaimu la ' a patke ' yatyata , ne la'pa nmai wia noma muakokan nohora wnienna hayori a'na pepetan lawan de pa mhi ' nohora !
He said to him , ‘ Son , you are always with me , and all that is mine is yours . ||| Noma amni nakot la niwra , Amee ! Hyalmu hade ee ! Kakni o ' de nhi'inde omdien rer lia a o'nu , ne hya ' maka a gah ' u de o gahamu hare ee !
But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad , for this , your brother , was dead , and is alive again . He was lost , and is found . ' ||| Mere mai pia tahepuepur nohora garmu yoma emekneka riy mati oleka hade wa , mere ne ! E nmormiori , me emek mak kmolg olekwa mere ee ! E nawali owa'an pa nma nora ita twatrom owa'ana !
He also said to his disciples , There was a certain rich man who had a manager . An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions . ||| Noma Yesus Nnairia yawalliohora pa Nakot la maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re Niwra , La ' mak kre ' a-ktaru ida nnairia riy id pa nhima-nre ' a la ' a e re'eni-tniarnu . Noma mak ktar die nlernana nur lia rira de riwra , Eh , Mak khima-kre ' de para ' a la kupna-kai .
He called him , and said to him , ‘ What is this that I hear about you ? Give an accounting of your management , for you can no longer be manager . ' ||| Pede npolga mak kar die pa nakot la niwra , A ' g utlina o ' de maka para ' a kupna-kai id o ' a . La ' dodo'ondi de mual momuou tieka puk otna-ara re pa a'umkek teka ! Hota dodo'ondi de ompuair wa la ' a o kniarmu la ' a a re ' u-tnia'ru re .
The manager said within himself , ‘ What will I do , seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me ? I do n't have strength to dig . Hota la dodo'ondi de a tu'nu de nwaliernia a lia knia'ru . La'pa wnial tiani mana a'ukleh oleka rur wia . La'pa aghi ' a mak kmeh ' a kawakwaka ho'mana amuola-mua ' a .
I know what I will do , so that when I am removed from management , they may receive me into their houses . ' ||| Aniair teka akal ida totpa la'pa rwalernia a lia a knia'ru , de hota rirahu edonna rwayotlia a lia ' a ir romni nayanni .
Calling each one of his lord 's debtors to him , he said to the first , ‘ How much do you owe to my lord ? ' ||| Noma mak kar lia kupna genni de npolga riy honona maka khi ' otna-ar la ' a e tunni de . Noma nakot la riy mak kala ' ulu niwra , O otanmu wo'ir la ' a a tu'nu ?
He said , ‘ A hundred batos of oil . ' He said to him , ‘ Take your bill , and sit down quickly and write fifty . ' ||| Noma riy de nwalolla niwra , A otnu wu'ru nora kuhi rahu ida . Noma mak kar die nakot la maka otan de niwra , Muala pukmu di pa ple'etu pa mumtatnu pa mhuorat la pukmu de otanmu de wu'ru nora kuhi terampwolima .
Then he said to another , ‘ How much do you owe ? ' He said , ‘ A hundred cors of wheat . ' He said to him , ‘ Take your bill , and write eighty . Noma mak kar lia kupna genni de nakot la niwra , Muala pukmu di pa mhuorta otanmu de wetra ' lawna kadu rahu wo'awa .
His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely , for the children of this world are , in their own generation , wiser than the children of the light . ||| Dewade nhi ' emkade owa'an la wotellu-wogatni . I tell you , make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon , so that when you fail , they may receive you into the eternal tents . ||| Pa hota mitlina ! Hota miy miana mniairi nohkeran di re'eni-tniarnu pa mtiulan la rimormior wialmi pa ma mpiahaka totpa riy rahu rtelan nana-raut nan miy , totpa la'pa nohkeran di re'eni-tniarnu nhorwua ne mmiati olek wa , de hota ral ralamni tetema pa rreiniana-ra'nan miy lia Ilyamou-Watyatoha .
He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much . He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much . ||| Mhioratreria ! Riy maka ha rpesiay oleka la ha kuku ' id to ' a , de hota rpesiay wialia la ha lalawna . Mere la'pa riy maka edonna rpesiaya la ha kuku ' ida , de hota edonna rpesiay wiali la ha lalawna .
If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon , who will commit to your trust the true riches ? ||| La'pa ta'en nian rpesiay miy lia re ' a-tniar nohkerna wawannu de ta'eni rpesiay wiali miy lia re ' a-tniaru la ' a Ilyamou-Watyatoha .
If you have not been faithful in that which is another 's , who will give you that which is your own ? ||| La'pa ta'en niana rpesiay miy lia ' a yohya ' a maka riy dom to ' gahani de , de hota he ' gaga'anu pa nala miy yohya ' gah wamuehemi rena ? !
No servant can serve two masters , for either he will hate the one and love the other , or else he will hold to one and despise the other . But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall . ||| Mere emkade ho'mana Uplerlawna deullu-tatarni ndella pa nodia liarni . Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery . Ne la ' walia riy maka kmehlimpa kora patke ' a maka kpaletan nohora muanke'eni de nhi ' wali yalira-yaliai lia Uplerlawna yamkekni .
Now there was a certain rich man , and he was clothed in purple and fine linen , living in luxury every day . ||| Noma Yesus Nnairia yawalliohora id owa'an pa Niwra , La ' a makre ' a-maktaru ida , de nnairia hewewta-naniairia mak welli werwerta . and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man 's table . Ne edon emkade to ' a mere ahu-ahu re mana lera-ler nekpa rma rrama Lasarus kerni-ga'arni mak kalui-kawdia ' i de !

Ne riy mak kre ' a-ktar die mana nmat wiali noma rtamnia .
In Hades , he lifted up his eyes , being in torment , and saw Abraham far off , and Lazarus at his bosom . ||| Pede nhiwni pepe'etu-papatla la ai mormiori ralamni naraka pa polpuol inni-wakwak amni . for I have five brothers-that he may testify to them , so they wo n't also come into this place of torment . ' ||| Yoma tre ' ma'ta a hya'lu riy wolima . If he sins against you seven times in the day , and seven times returns , saying , ‘ I repent , ' you shall forgive him . ||| Ne la'pa la ' lera id ho'mana , riy ida e nhi ' nan do ' a-hala re'eni wo'itu tiy miy , de hota mhiur niohora pa mhioratdoinia e do'oni-halli re , yoma e nmaimiai rer pia nwak lilili-mamuau maaf tiy miy .
The apostles said to the Lord , Increase our faith . ||| Noma riy maka Yesus Nhopan pa rodia Uplerlawna lirni-tunnu re rakot la Yesus riwra , Matroma , Mhi ' aruria a pesiay mamni .

But who is there among you , having a servant plowing or keeping sheep , that will say when he comes in from the field , ‘ Come immediately and sit down at the table ' ? ||| Yesus lirni , La'pa miy die mhiopna hopopanmi pa nwal tian lia nhyi ' ralma onde nhi ' makodi nhiuri-wnia'ana . La'pa ntulla-nkar pia nawal wia , de hota mikot hya ' lir la mak ktulla-kar dieno ? Hota miy edonna miwra , Plet pa ma mu'una .
Would n't he rather tell him , ‘ Prepare my supper , clothe yourself properly , and serve me while I eat and drink . Afterward you shall eat and drink ' ? ||| Mere hota miwra , Ple'etu pa mlia ' mpipara , dewade mupola-murainia kalwiedwe'du pa mua mhuoi wra ' u pa a'una , pa nhor nianpena mu'una .
Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded ? I think not . ||| Hopopan de edonna nlernana ya'uli yoma natu nhu'ru-nhelam , natlina-natailla tunni de !
Even so you also , when you have done all the things that are commanded you , say , ‘ We are unworthy servants . We have done our duty . ' ||| Emkade wali miora Uplerlawna . La ' mimliernohora hare honona maka Uplerlawna Nhopan pa mhi ' a , de mikot neka miwra , Am di de hopopna-lili'iru to ' ami pa amlernohora hya ' maka ha rhopan pa amkari .

As they went , they were cleansed . ||| La'pa Yesus Namkek nana re noma Nakot la re Niwra , Mlia ' imam-imam re pa mpiak pa ramkek teka inonmi rena pa emeknekama Musa deullu-tatarni nakot la mak kmou olek la ulityata-temyata ! Dewade honona re rla'awa . Rla ' de , de nnieni-nhiena ulityata re ema rhai dioinia la inonni tetema .
One of them , when he saw that he was healed , turned back , glorifying God with a loud voice . ||| La'pa riy id la ' a riy termida re natga e nkalwied olekwa la ' a nnienni , dewade nawali pia nhaunu pa na'uli-nawedia Uplerlawna , de nahepur nohora .
He fell on his face at Jesus ' feet , giving him thanks , and he was a Samaritan . ||| Ne nmai pia nwaltiora-nwaltieman la Yesus gaini ralamni na'nama na'uli-nawedia . Riy de Yahudi atia ' a e ' a mere mak kden Samaria ida de .

Then he said to him , Get up , and go your way . Your faith has healed you . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la riy de Niwra , Muprir pia mlia'awa ! Yoma ompuesiay olek A wua pa mkialwied wa .
Being asked by the Pharisees when God 's Kingdom would come , he answered them , God 's Kingdom does n't come with observation , ||| Lera ida ne riy Parisi doma ratiana Yesus riwra , Hota mowen nianpena Uplerlawna Nmai pia Na'ala kniarni pa emeka mak ktorna-krautu la nohkerna wawannu ? Noma Yesus Nwalolla Niwra , Uplerlawna Na'ala kniarni de edonna Nalharia pa rimormiori matni ramkek nana .
neither will they say , ‘ Look , here ! ' or , ‘ Look , there ! ' for behold , God 's Kingdom is within you . ||| Ne hota riy raplin niohora rwahauria Uplerlawna lodanni-hairni etla handi onde la ' hande . Yoma Uplerlawna tnioranni-riautnu pa emeka Ray , la dodo'ondi ed olek la ' rira ihranu ralamni .
He said to the disciples , The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man , and you will not see it . ||| La'pa nhorwua noma Yesus Nakot la maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re Niwra , Hota la ' pa nmai wia lerni pa mimpiahak toto ' memna pa mior rewre'wa Rimormior A'na A ' die la ler ho'ke'eni to ' a , mere hota miy edonna mliernana A ' u .
They will tell you , ‘ Look , here ! ' or ‘ Look , there ! ' Do n't go away or follow after them , ||| Ne hota riy riwra , Eee ! Mimkeka la hande onde mimkeka la handi . Rimormiori A'na Nmai oleka dee ! Mere yan memmemna mliergot pa mihaka ha lolola !
for as the lightning , when it flashes out of one part under the sky , shines to another part under the sky , so will the Son of Man be in his day . ||| Yoma hota Rimormiori A'na A maimia'yu , edon emkade . Mere emkameni la nwatlena la lyanti maka ni'it nana lairni la lyanti honi pa nla ntut lia honi de hota riy honona ramkek memna , de hota emkade wal lia Rimormiori A'na A maimia'yu la re'eni wornu .
But first , he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation . ||| Mere Uplerlawna Nror targ oleka pa A'ula ' ul pua Alier nek la kropanni-krieutnu , nniahora-nniala ' a , yamuki-yama'ala me hota riy la ' tuwu di de hota rwayotli A ' u plein nampena la la'pa ntutu-nte'ela lerni Amuai owa'ana .
As it was in the days of Noah , even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man . ||| La'pa Rimormiori A'na A ' die maimia'yu , de hota la ' ler de rimormiori yehwani emolmolan nekama it upni Nuh tuwnu la ' ler ululu .

Emkade nekpa nodi liarni pa la'pa nte ' meman la Nuh nler la aupual liawna batra ralamni , dewade ger wawuau liawna nma nwau dioinia rimormiori re honona .
Likewise , even as it was in the days of Lot , they ate , they drank , they bought , they sold , they planted , they built , ||| Me hota emekwalima la ' a Lota lerni wali . Ler de de riy rtepartarlia ya'ana-yemnu , ya'olu-yala ' a , yanhyi ' a-yatlunni , me rariria roma-lewu .
but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom , it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all . ||| Mere la'pa Lota rlergot la let Sodom , de la ' ler de nekpa ai liali nwatiawu lyanti pa nlomar dodioinia rira honona .
It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed . ||| Hota emkade walia la ' a ler maka Rimormiori A'na A ' die maimia'yu pa riy ramkek meman A ' u . La ' ler de riy edon rwaror nohora A maimia'yu mak Agodia watghudi lokarni .
In that day , he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house , let him not go down to take them away . Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back . ||| Hota la ' ler de de yana miy ralammi nko ' i nana nohkerna gahani . Miy maka kateni anni la likti wawannu , de yana mierun pa mlia mia'ala hyonmi-hyanmi la ' a rommi nayanni . Emkade walia la ' a miy mak kden la nhyi ' ralma de yana miwali owa'an la roma nayanni .
Remember Lot 's wife ! ||| Mhioratreria la ' a wnieyata-wnianiawua maka Lota patke'eni ha nlernan oleka wa yoma ralamni nod rer lia la nohkerna gahani .

They , answering , asked him , Where , Lord ? He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up , ||| La'pa nhorwua noma Yesus Nwahaur nohora yawalliohora id la ' a maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re , totpena rsumbain rer lia Uplerlawna . saying , There was a judge in a certain city who did n't fear God and did n't respect man . ||| Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , La ' leta ida , de mak ktoran reria watghudi ida mak edonna kamta'ata Uplerlawna me edonna nwadana rimormior wialli .
A widow was in that city , and she often came to him , saying , ‘ Defend me from my adversary ! He would n't for a while , but afterward he said to himself , ‘ Though I neither fear God nor respect man , ||| Mere mak ktoran watghudi die nahmena nreiniana pat de wakwakni . yet because this widow bothers me , I will defend her , or else she will wear me out by her continual coming . ' ||| mere lera-ler nekpa patyat di emeka nmai pia nariei mamainia a ' u . Pa emkadella pa aliernohora , yoma hota a'uhmena mere lera-ler nekpa nma nhi ' a ralmu pa wolwo'la .
The Lord said , Listen to what the unrighteous judge says . ||| Noma Itmatromni Nakot la re Niwra , Mitlina samomuoga mak ktoran watghudi mak edon neti rira lirni-tunnu la talan plollola , lirni enakota hya ' a ?
Wo n't God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night , and yet he exercises patience with them ? ||| Nah hota yanpa mimpiarora de Uplerlawna hota edonna Nod niana E upni-a'nani maka Ha Nwalir niana de lirni-tunnu , maka lera-ler nekpa rpolpuolu-rwakwak mamainia la E ' a ? E ' edon Ntot pa Nahe ' niohora ma'ta re . Plol toto ' a Entulan la ' ira !
I tell you that he will avenge them quickly . Nevertheless , when the Son of Man comes , will he find faith on the earth ? ||| Mpiesiaya , hota nleretniekla Nod niana re . Nsumbain pa niwra , Uplerlawnu ne ! A ' u'uli-uwedi O ' a , yoma a ' di de ematia ' a riy dom maka kamnelu-kamna ' a , mak khi ' do ' a-kyap hiala onde mak kalira-kaliai . A ' u'uli-uwedi O ' a yoma a ' g edonna emeknekama riy mak kawoka blasten di .
I fast twice a week . I give tithes of all that I get . ' ||| A di de utahan nana lar la re'eni wor lia ' krei id ralamni , ne agal walia a liwtu-odwu kupanni tiy O ' a , de agal nhiakra id la nhiakarni termida sepersepuluh .
But the tax collector , standing far away , would n't even lift up his eyes to heaven , but beat his chest , saying , ‘ God , be merciful to me , a sinner ! Jesus asked him , Why do you call me good ? No one is good , except one , God . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Hya ' a nrei piede omhuari lirmu mai A die muiwra A ' di de riy kalwied id A ' u ? Riy honona edonna rkalwieda , eneknek to'ama Uplerlawna Nmeh ' a nanpena Nkalwiedweda .

Another came , saying , ‘ Lord , behold , your mina , which I kept laid away in a handkerchief , ||| Nhor nioma mak ka'an kai lia de dom de nmai pia nakot la tun de niwra , Tuna , kupan mina maka muala re a ' g e muanatga apitu la kokanna ralamni pa er tiy !
for I feared you , because you are an exacting man . You take up that which you did n't lay down , and reap that which you did n't sow . ' ||| Yoma a'umta'at la tuna , yoma nhi'inde tuna nhopan pa mak kar lia e ' a de , rkari werwerta . Ne orgahamu nhi'inde mua ' nek la kupan maka riy dom to ' a rkenia la noha luwuau wniatierun lawanni bank . Ne tuna niwra nwokwiok niekpa nawoka noh timni-rai timni maka tuna edonna nodia liwtu-odaw la yatniamanni .
He said to him , ‘ Out of your own mouth I will judge you , you wicked servant ! You knew that I am an exacting man , taking up that which I did n't lay down and reaping that which I did n't sow . ||| Noma ray die nakot la mak ka'an kai lia de niwra , Riy yatya'tu ne ! Hota agukum o ' a nlernohor rer lia o orgahamu lirmu . O e muatga de a ' di de riy maka khopan pa riy mak kar lia a ' u re rkari werwerta ne umatmera-wulkga'ul la'pa uwoka-ule'ga noha timanni-daharni maka a ' g edonna godia a liwtu-odwu .
Then why did n't you deposit my money in the bank , and at my coming , I might have earned interest on it ? ' ||| O ralma-riormu emkade noma nihya'pa o edonna mkien nieka a kupnu della la ' a noha luwuaunu wniatierun lawanni bank totpena amuai emkadi de orgah ' u ga ' nana kupan de nor wutga rehenu-lawanni bunga ? !
He said to those who stood by , ‘ Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas . ' ||| Dewade ray die nakot la riy maka ktutrier wutwut lia hande pa ra'ala kupan de , ne rala la riy maka ka'itar kupan mina la re'eni termida re !
They said to him , ‘ Lord , he has ten minas ! ' ||| Mere mak ktutrieri re rakot la tun de riwra , Tuna , hade nlernan oleka kupna re'eni termida wa .
‘ For I tell you that to everyone who has , will more be given , but from him who does n't have , even that which he has will be taken away from him . ||| Mere ray die nakot la re niwra , Mhioratreria ! He ' mak khima-kre ' a lia kalwiedwedni de ir er maka klernan owa'an pa ra'itar rer lia liawanni . Mere maka edon nhima-nre ' a lia kalwiedwedni hota ha kuku ' id etla limni ralamni ho'mana ra ' momuou lia .
But bring those enemies of mine who did n't want me to reign over them here , and kill them before me . ' ||| Ne miod dodo'on memna a arwa'lu maka kahmena aghi ' a ray lia ira re pa ma mpiakriani ! Mituinia honona re aranni la a ga'yu ralamni .
Having said these things , he went on ahead , going up to Jerusalem . When he came near to Bethsphage and Bethany , at the mountain that is called Olivet , he sent two of his disciples , ||| La'pa Yesus Nakot targa hare honona nhor nia'nama Nden la gaigaini la mutlialawna pa rtawniokria letlawna Yerusalem . La'pa rwakriania leta Betfagi nora leta Betania , mak kdella wo'ora Saitun hananni , noma Nhopan pa maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a riy woru rala ' ulu pua rla ' a let maka ir rwakrian oleka de . Yesus Nano ' a re Niwra ,
saying , Go your way into the village on the other side , in which , as you enter , you will find a colt tied , which no man has ever sat upon . Untie it and bring it . ||| Hota la'pa mimtie'ela hande de hota mimkek nana keledai a'nani ida e nakniohu . Keledai de edonna rwatutu ma'ta nhia'ani . Ne mlieretniekla miewar doinia la pa miodia la handi .
If anyone asks you , ‘ Why are you untying it ? ' say to him , ‘ The Lord needs it . ' ||| La'pa riy ratian miy lia hya ' a nrei pia mimpie'er doinia keledai dena ? De mikot la miwra , Itmatromlawanni e Nwaka perlu de !
Those who were sent went away and found things just as he had told them . ||| Dewade riy maroro ' a re rla'awa . La ' de rlernana emolmolan nekama maka Yesus ha Nakotkota re .
As they were untying the colt , its owners said to them , Why are you untying the colt ? ||| La'pa e rewar rer mia'ta keledai a'na de , noma keledai matromni ratiana re , Hoi ! Hya ' a nrei pia mimpie'er doini keledai a'na dena ?
They said , The Lord needs it . ||| Noma rwahla riwra , Yoma Itmatromni e Nwaka de !
Then they brought it to Jesus . They threw their cloaks on the colt and sat Jesus on them . ||| Nhor nioka rodia keledai della Yesus nhor nia'nama rala ir rain plalahwani ra rwowa keledai de to'orni dewade rhima Yesus pa Nha'ata la keledai a'na de wawannu .
As he went , they spread their cloaks on the road . ||| La'pa Nha ' nana keledai a'na de pa nlola talan lawna , de rirahu rala naniair plalahwa ra rwowa la talla totpena keledai a'na maka Yesus Nha ' nan de nlola wawannu .
As he was now getting near , at the descent of the Mount of Olives , the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen , ||| La'pa tre ' ma't oke ' a pa Yesus Nte'el la ' Yerusalem , la ' a talan maka kwatirierun la wo'or Saitun , dewade mak klernohora Yesus rirahu re honona ralamni re rahepuepru pa emariarin nana la ya'uli-yawedia la Uplerlawna yoma la ' a hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona mujizat honona maka Yesus Nhi ' oleka re pa ir ramkek nana . Riarni-riarin la nhiaunu pa riwra ,
saying , Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord ! Peace in heaven , and glory in the highest ! ||| Ra'yu nee ! Ma'uli-mawedi , mhu'ru-mhelma O mak kmai pia kodia Orgahi-Orha ' a nanni ! Dodo'ondi de Uplerlawna mak kden la Ilyamou-Watyatoha Nora rimormior nohkeran di tkalwied owa'ana . Mai pia ta'uli-tawedia , tlilili-tmamuau Uplerlawna la tutullu-lolo'oni !
Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him , Teacher , rebuke your disciples ! ||| Noma riy Parisi doma mak kden wut lia rirahu re rakot la Yesus riwra , Tungkurga , Mhuopan pa maklernohor reri O ' a re ramolmuolga !
He answered them , I tell you that if these were silent , the stones would cry out . ||| Noma Yesus Nwahla lirni re Niwra , Mpuesiay A'go , hota hare rherier wia mere hota watgau ri rhaur la polpuolu-hawaunu re !
When he came near , he saw the city and wept over it , ||| La'pa Yesus Nwakriarian liol wa la ' a letlawna Yerusalem , dewade Namkek reria let de na'nama Nkakur nohora .
saying , If you , even you , had known today the things which belong to your peace ! But now , they are hidden from your eyes . ||| Noma Nakot la Yerusalem Niwra , A ralmu e ntuin tiy o ' a Yerusalem ee ! Awuak memna totpa o ' nek de , muat nohora he ' mak la ' ler di de kodi plolli pa nodia kalwiedni-paitiotni tiy o ' a . Mere la ' dodo'ondi de loi-talan la kalwieda-paitiot de emeka ha yawunamnu la o matmu yamkekni .
For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you , surround you , hem you in on every side , ||| Pede hota la ' lera ida , hota o arwalmu lol walli-walli pa rariria luturwatu-werantuini pa rle'lu reri o'ola letgara totpena riy mak kden la o ralammu de yana rawlari .
and will dash you and your children within you to the ground . They will not leave in you one stone on another , because you did n't know the time of your visitation . ||| Hota rweyata-rwaniag wutga omuora rimormiormu . Lutur lawanni id mana edonna napniadar la id wawannu . Hota omuora rimormiormu mimliernan hade yoma miy edonna mrieiniana-mia'nan Uplerlawna la ' lera maka Niwra Nma Namori-nalewna miy .
He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it , ||| Yesus Nla'awa Uplerlawna roma kreini herni-gaini na'nama Nhokra-nlaiya mak ka'olu-kala ' a kaweli-kaphar la hande .
saying to them , It is written , ‘ My house is a house of prayer , ' but you have made it a ‘ den of robbers ' ! ||| Yesus Nakot la mak ka'olu-kala ' a re Niwra , E rhorat tar olek la Puka ralamni Uplerlawna lirni de Niwra , Hota A ro'mu de sniumbain genia de , mere miy e mhi ' a la roma kamnelu-kamna ' geni !
He was teaching daily in the temple , but the chief priests , the scribes , and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him . ||| La ' lera-ler nekpa Yesus Nwatutu-nwaye'ela Uplerlawna roma kreini . Mere imam-imam o'tani-matni rora makwatutu-kwaye ' a agama me Yahudi o'tani-matni rwaror pa rwenna Yesus .
They could n't find what they might do , for all the people hung on to every word that he said . ||| Mere edonna rlernan ma'ta talan pa rwenna yoma rirahu rmaimiai rer pia ratlina-ratailia lirni-tunnu , ne lirni-tunnu re rla ' nana rira ihranu ralamni .
On one of those days , as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News , the priests and scribes came to him with the elders . ||| La'awa la ' lera ida , de Yesus Ntepartarlia wniatutu-wniaye ' a me Nakot nohora Kot Kalwieda-Paitiota mak kwatiawu Uplerlawna la ' a riy mak kden la Uplerlawna roma kreini de . Noma imam-imam o'tani-matni re me makwatutu-kwaye ' a agama , ror wutga Yahudi in letni-am letni rmai pia
They asked him , Tell us , by what authority do you do these things ? Or who is giving you this authority ? ||| rakot la Yesus riwra , Tuna , Mukot nohora tek la mai ami , de he ' ed mak ktemna plola-mneh della ' O limmu ralamni pede Omhi ' nan hihi'imu-yapyapmu rena ?
He answered them , I also will ask you one question . Tell me , ||| Noma Yesus Nwahla lirni re Niwra , A ' g e giwra utian tek wali miy . Mikot nohor teka !
the baptism of John , was it from heaven , or from men ? ||| Yohansi makharan die , ha nlernan plol della he ' a ? Uplerlawna onde rimormiori ?
They reasoned with themselves , saying , If we say , ‘ From heaven , ' he will say , ‘ Why did n't you believe him ? ' ||| Dewade honona re rwahu'ru ralma-riora wamueh ' a pa riwra , La'pa itwet la Uplerlawna ed mak kala plolli la Yohansi de hota Eniwra , Ne hya ' a nrei pia miy edonna mpiesiay e ' a ?
But if we say , ‘ From men , ' all the people will stone us , for they are persuaded that John was a prophet . ||| Mere la'pa itiwra rimormiori plolli-mneheni hade de hota riy honona rala watu ra rwatliewur wen ita yoma riy rpesiaya de Yohansi de makwohorulu-ktatrulu id hade !
They answered that they did n't know where it was from . ||| Pede honona rla ' lir id pa rwahla Yesus riwra , Ami e maplinga de ha nlernan plol della he ' a .
Jesus said to them , Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , Hade emkade , de A ' muana edonna ukot wahyaria tiy miy la ' a he ' a mak kala plolli mai A ' pua Aghi ' a hihi ' a-yapyapi re .
He began to tell the people this parable , A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers , and went into another country for a long time . ||| Dewade Yesus Nwahaur nohor la ira , la ' a yawalliohora id la ' a rirahu re Niwra , Ornoha ida nawuli-natniamin anggur wo ' a la nhyi'ini-tlunanni ralamni . Nhor nia'nama nala nhyi'-tlunni anggur della riy rtimnia . Na'nama nla nlaun la riy ornoha pa mahnek meman la hande .
At the proper season , he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard . But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty . ||| La'pa ntutu la lerni-melli pa riwra rreiki-rwo'or wa , noma ora nhyi ' de nhopna e hopopanni-li'irnu id pa nmai pia na'ala ora nhyi ' a nhiakarni la timanni-daharni . Mere mak ktimni-kdahara rwaldioin targho ' pa rwanalga ora nhyi ' a hopopanni-li'irnu de na'nama rhopan pa nawal die nhapirteum nan to ' a .
He sent yet another servant , and they also beat him and treated him shamefully , and sent him away empty . ||| Noma ora nhyi ' de nhopn owa'ana hopopanni id owa'ana . Mere emkade walia rliwra-rkaklia na'nama rahe ' i-ramalia pa rhopan pa nawal die nhapirteum nan to ' a .
He sent yet a third , and they also wounded him and threw him out . ||| Nhor nioma ora nhyi'-tlunni de na'enyatg owa'an hopopanni mak la'pa re'eni wotellu , mere ha nlernan walia liwliwra-kakaklu pa namno ' a-namrara na'nama rte'la la'pa rhopliala la nhyi ' a to'orni .
The lord of the vineyard said , ‘ What shall I do ? I will send my beloved son . It may be that seeing him , they will respect him . ' ||| La ' pa hohoni dewade ora nhyi'-tlunni de nhar lirni pa niwra , Hota a'uhak owa'an hya ' tallo ? Hade emkade de pena A ' u'enyatga a a'nu maka a siayn memna . Meman neka la hota e ' de hare rhu'ru-rhelma .
But when the farmers saw him , they reasoned among themselves , saying , ‘ This is the heir . Come , let 's kill him , that the inheritance may be ours . ' ||| Mere la'pa ramkek tut niana ora nhyi'-tlunni de a'nani de dewade idma nakot la ida , riwra , Maka hota kodi plolli la ononni e inhatti ! Mai pia itatuinia aranni totpena nhyi'ini-tlunanni di , it gahani !
Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him . What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them ? ||| Dewade rnaklia riy de la nhyi ' de to'orni na'nama rwenna . Noma Yesus Natiana la mak katlina re Niwra , Nah ! La'pa ora nhyi ' de nawal pia nmai de hota hya ' ed maka ha nhi ' a la maktimni-makdahara reno ?
He will come and destroy these farmers , and will give the vineyard to others . When they heard that , they said , May that never be ! ||| Hota nma nhapartikil nohora re ne hota nwenna re , totpena nal to ' a la riy doma rtimnia . La'pa riy mak katlin nan hade , de rna'erit nana lir de nnia'eratni , noma rakot la Yesus riwra , Hota emkameni ho'mana hota yana rhi ' emkade !
But he looked at them and said , Then what is this that is written , ‘ The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone ' ? ||| Noma Yesus Namkek tertehra na'nama Nakot la re Niwra , La'pa emek miy lirmi re pa hota edon emkade , de emkameni targho'ola Puka lirni la ' a wat muaka ha rtot nohora la Ray Makamori-Kalewna maka Uplerlawna Nano'tar dena ? Yoma e rakot taru la Puka de , Wat muaka tukna edonna rnair nana pa rhi ' a roma-lewu , mere rhopliala , de Uplerlawna Nnairi oleka pa Nhi ' a la watu liar pianulu .
Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces , but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust . ||| Riy honona mak ktuin pa ktaiya wat die onde riy maka wat die nwaklol niana de hota ramkoha-ramnana pa rwal lia en liu'wu-tan miakmu .
The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour , but they feared the people-for they knew he had spoken this parable against them . ||| Makwatutu-kwaye ' a agama me imam-imam re o'tani-matni rat niohora la yawalliohora maka Yesus Nakota de , de Enakot nohor ira . Pede rwahak talan pa rtorna Yesus la ' ler de memna , mere ramta'at rer lia ' rirahu .
They watched him and sent out spies , who pretended to be righteous , that they might trap him in something he said , so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor . ||| Pede ramkek rer lia Yesus yanpa hota Nhi ' hala . Rhopna riy pa rla ratian la ' a-mai Yesus emeka e riwra rat niohora Yesus lirni-tunnu mere plollolli de e riwra rtot e ' pa Nweta lir maka edonna klola o'ta-mata re wniarorni , nanpena o'ta-mata re rla rwet targa la mak kodi plolli doma maka kden la gubernur tnioranni-riautnu .
They asked him , Teacher , we know that you say and teach what is right , and are n't partial to anyone , but truly teach the way of God . ||| Noma riy maka ha rhopna re rma rakot la Yesus riwra , Tungkurga , ami e matga de O ' di de nanpena maka kakot nohora hya ' ed mak kaplollola . Amatga de riy plele'er id O ' a . O ' e Mpuatut die Mukot nohora plollolli la Uplerlawna ralma-rior kalwiedwedni la ' a rimormiori , de O ' edonna Mhue'du nan etia riy ralma-riorni yoma riy lalawna onde riy kuku'uni ho'mana O ' edonna Mpuadan nohora .
Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar , or not ? ||| La ' hade pede Mukot teka la mai ami , la ' it agamni deullu-tatarni nakot am pia ampairia blastena la ' a mak ktorna horta-hairi Romawi Kaisar onde yana ?
But he perceived their craftiness , and said to them , Why do you test me ? ||| Mere ir ralma riorni mak edon kaplola de Yesus Nat niohor oleka re pede Nakot la re ,
Show me a denarius . Whose image and inscription are on it ? They answered , Caesar 's . ||| Mi'al tek la kupan dinar id pa mtiut tieka mai A ' u , de he ' a herni-gaini me he ' nanni mak kden la kupan de ? Noma rwet la riwra , Ray mak ktorna horta-hairi Romawi Kaisar o'tani inhat ee !
He said to them , Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar 's , and to God the things that are God 's . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la re , Hade emkade , miala kupan maka ray herni-gaini etla de la ' a ray , yoma hanni hade . Ne miala la Uplerlawna hya ' maka Uplerlawna gahani wali .
They were n't able to trap him in his words before the people . They marveled at his answer and were silent . ||| Pede ta'en niana rtot Yesus la hala wawannu la riy mutlialawna gaini ralamni . Honona re mtulu-mtie'el tar momuoga yoma rwer rer wiawni la ' a Yesus lirni-tunnu maka ha ratiana re honona .
Some of the Sadducees came to him , those who deny that there is a resurrection . ||| Noma Saduki riy doma rmai pia ratian nohora Yesus la ' a emkameni la riy mak kmati hota rmori owa'ana , yoma Saduki re er mak edonna kpesiaya riy mak kmati hota rmori owa'ana .
They asked him , Teacher , Moses wrote to us that if a man 's brother dies having a wife , and he is childless , his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother . ||| Riwra , Tungkurga , Musa e nhorat targa mai ita , de emkadilla , La'pa muanke ' ida nmati mere nakleh ma'ta a'na , de muanke ' a mak kmat die hyalli nor owa'an yerni patyat de rmehlima , totpena rlernana hyalli mak kmati olek de duratni-waitni .
There were therefore seven brothers . The first took a wife , and died childless . ||| Mere la ' lera ida , de muanke ' a riy wo'itu rwahyal riaralma . Noma yanulu nmehlima , mere edonna nlernan ma'ta a'na , ne nmat wia .
The second took her as wife , and he died childless . ||| Noma garni mak klernohor hyalli nora yerni rmehlima mere edonna nlernan wal mia'ta a'na noma nmati wali .
The third took her , and likewise the seven all left no children , and died . ||| La'pa emkade wali la ' a hyalli re korni re ror owa'an yerni de rmehlima mere id mana nakleh ma'ta a'na de rmat wia pa emkade mamain pa nodi liarni pa la ntutu mueman la gari hoho ' a .
Afterward the woman also died . ||| La'awa hohoni noma pat de mana nmat wia , mere nakleh etia a'na ida .
Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be ? For the seven had her as a wife . ||| Pede la'pa la'awa lerni pa mak kmati honona rmori owa'ana , de hota he ' hawni patke ' a dena ? Yoma mak kwahyali re wo'itu meman pa rora pat de rmehlima .
Jesus said to them , The children of this age marry and are given in marriage . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , Riy maka kmormior mia'ta la nohkeran di , de e rmehlima .
But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage . ||| Mere riy maka ha rwalir nian pa hota rmori owa'an la matmiatni pa rdella Ilyamou-Watyatoha , de hota edonna rmehlim owa'ana .
For they ca n't die any more , for they are like the angels and are children of God , being children of the resurrection . ||| Yoma yehwani re emeknekama Uplerlawna hopopanni-lili'irnu pa hota edonna rlernan owa'an matmiati la ' a Uplerlawna gen warwuarnu . Rwet olek ir la Uplerlawna upni-a'nani , yoma Uplerlawna Namori-nalewn olek ir la ' matmiati ralamni .
But that the dead are raised , even Moses showed at the bush , when he called the Lord ‘ The God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . ' ||| Nah ! Miy die edon mimpiesiaya de hota mak kmati rmori owa'ana , mere Musa orgahani nek de enakot momuoga de hota riy mak kmati mana rmori owa'ana . Yoma e nhorat taru Orgahi-Orha ' a lirni maka Musa natlin nana la ' ler maka Musa nlernan ai la ' a pu'na-kiarti ralamni de . Orgahi-Orha ' a lirni emkadi , A ' di de Abrahama , Isaka me Yakopa Uplerlawna ma'ta A ' u . Nakot emkade kennama Abraham , Isak me Yakopa rmati olekwa .
Now he is not the God of the dead , but of the living , for all are alive to him . ||| Uplerlawna upni-a'nani honona la'pa rmati oleka ho'mana Uplerlawna Natga hota rmori owa'ana . Uplerlawan de , riy mak kmati Uplerlawanni atia ' a hade . E ' de de , mak kmormiori Uplerlawanni E ' a .
Some of the scribes answered , Teacher , you speak well . ||| Noma makwatutu-kwaye ' a agama dom rakot la Yesus riwra , Am tungkurg ee , mak ompuet la re , id mana edonna nhal eti !
They did n't dare to ask him any more questions . ||| Dewade riy id mana edonna nparan pia nhar lirni pa natiana Yesus .
He said to them , Why do they say that the Christ is David 's son ? ||| Noma Yesus Natiana re , Hya ' a nariei pia riwra Ray Makamori-Kalewan maka Uplerlawna Nano'taru , de Daud duratni-waitni hade ?
David himself says in the book of Psalms , ‘ The Lord said to my Lord , Sit at my right hand , ||| Daud nmeh ' a nek de e nhorat targa la ' a Puka Masmur la ' a Uplerlawna lirni la Ray Makamori-Kalewan de niwra , Orgahi-Orha ' a Nakot la a Matromlawnu Yesus Niwra , Muliwnu Mumtatnu la ' A wa'lu malganna .
until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet . ' ||| La'pa Aghi ' a arwalmu re pa rwaltior la O lakmu nayanni .
David therefore calls him Lord , so how is he his son ? ||| La'pa Ray Daud nwet la Ray Makamori-Kalewna , niwra e Matromlawanni , de nihya'pa mikota ray Daud duratni E ' a ?
In the hearing of all the people , he said to his disciples , ||| La'pa rirahu ertepartarlia ratlin la Yesus lirni-tunnu , noma Yesus Nakot la maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re Niwra ,
Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes , and love greetings in the marketplaces , the best seats in the synagogues , and the best places at feasts , ||| Erammi la ' a tungkurga agama re ! Nhi'inde rala ' nohora raini plalahwani totpena riy ramkek de riy mak inponni ira me ir suksukni de riy ral ir la rekna-waiti la ' a ya'olu-yala ' geni . Rler la Yahudi kreini-iskolli ralamni de rtota gen miak kden la gaini me la ' a he ' i-hepru la ' a ya'anlawna-yemunlawna , de rahak geni samomuou totpa riy ra'uli ira , nanpena ramtatna la ' hande .
who devour widows ' houses , and for a pretense make long prayers . These will receive greater condemnation . ||| Ra'ohpa-ralahara a'na riy patyata me reyahru romni-lewnu . Ne rsumbain de plo ' a-plahwa la rirahu gaini ralamni totpa ra rtutwua ir do'oni-halli . Mere hade mak karei pia rlernana niukum mak hota kwerwerta maka nareh dioin niukum maka riy dom to ' a rlernana .
He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury . ||| La ' a Uplerlawna roma kreini de Yesus Nran matni pa Namkek la mak ktar kupna-kai rkenia kupan la krei ktoparni .
He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins . ||| Yesus Namkek walia a'na riy patyata ida nken wialia sena wor lia ' a ktopar de ralamni .
He said , Truly I tell you , this poor widow put in more than all of them , ||| Noma Yesus Niwra , Mitlina , patyat di ed mak kenia liawanni la ' a riy honona .
for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance , but she , out of her poverty , put in all that she had to live on . ||| Yoma rirahu mak keni olekwa re narehi-nalawna yoma re'eni-tniarnu harahu . Mere patyat di de nakleha-naplara mere mak ha nala re de , eneknek hare to ' a pede nwatul nana pa nal momuoga .
As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts , he said , ||| Noma maka Yesus ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re dom rwahaur nohora Uplerlawna roma kreini samomuounu nee ! Yoma rnairia watgau samomuou pa rariria me rala himima-rere ' a mak samomuou memna totpa rhi ' Uplerlawna roma kreini pa samomuowa . Mere Yesus Nakota la re Niwra ,
As for these things which you see , the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down . ||| Hota la'pa nte'ela lerni de hya ' maka ha mimkeka re de hota rweyata-rwaniawu momuoga . Wat muaka kapnidara re de hota id mana edonna nalliapar id wawannu .
They asked him , Teacher , so when will these things be ? What is the sign that these things are about to happen ? ||| Dewade maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re ratiana Yesus riwra , Tungkuru , hota mowen die itamkeka maka Omukota re ? Ne hota hya ' ed maka tamkek ulga totpena nwagahniort it la hota lera-mela inhatta ?
He said , Watch out that you do n't get led astray , for many will come in my name , saying , ‘ I am he , ' and , ‘ The time is at hand . ' Therefore do n't follow them . ||| Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , Mi'ererma ! Yanpa rhi ' aklierat miy la ' a A maimia'yu de . There will be great earthquakes , famines , and plagues in various places . There will be terrors and great signs from heaven . ||| Ne plinu-plinnianama lol meni-meni to ' pa upkarururu mak karuri . Rehka-lara me nnieni-nhiena mana , nwewra noha-rai . Ne la ' a lyanti mana tamkek neka yamta'ata hya ' mak kamehi-kayona karieiniande riy ramta'at meman la hota hya ' ed mak kmai nieka .
But before all these things , they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you , delivering you up to synagogues and prisons , bringing you before kings and governors for my name 's sake . ||| Mere la'pa hare honona edonan ma'ta de , hota rtoran miy pia rnahora-rnala ' a , ramuki-rama'al miy . Ne hota rnun miy lia ray-ray gaini ralamni , me la ' walia o'ta-mat lalawna re dom pali , yoma mimliernohor reri A ' u .
It will turn out as a testimony for you . ||| Hade ed maka hota mimliernan talan pa mikot nohor Kot Kalwieda-Paitiota la ira .
Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer , ||| Mimpiaror samomuou plein totpa hota yana ihrami rteplu la ' a hya ' a ed maka hota ha miwra mikot pa ma miod niana inonmi .
for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict . ||| Yoma hota A orgah ' u ed mak kala lira mak kodi kirkira-ralma-rior samomuou tiy miy , totpena miy arwalmi id mana , edonna nlernan talan pa namer matni pa nreher doinia ha mikota re .
You will be handed over even by parents , brothers , relatives , and friends . They will cause some of you to be put to death . ||| Hota inmi-ammi inmi-narmi lupmi-rommi me tupwalmi-lawalmi nekane e rehera-rwat dioin miy lia ne rwunu-rwenna riy dom makpesiay .
You will be hated by all men for my name 's sake . ||| Ne riy la ' meni-meni to ' a hota rahankeran rer tiy miy , yoma mimliernohor reri A ' u .

Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains . Let those who are in the middle of her depart . Let those who are in the country not enter therein . ||| A'ukot tiy miy totpena la ' ler de hota miy mak kden la Yudea miwlar lia ' wo'ora hananni . Mak kden la leta ralamni , de rawlar dioinia leta , ne mak kden la leta to'orni yana rler la leta ralamni .
For these are days of vengeance , that all things which are written may be fulfilled . ||| Yoma la ' lera-mela re de hota niukum lawna nmai wia , totpena la ' hade pa mak ha rakot targa la Puka ralamni de ntutu-nte'ewa

that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom . but I prayed for you , that your faith would n't fail . You , when once you have turned again , establish your brothers . ||| Mere Asiumbaini olek o'owa Simona totpa pesiaymu yana nmadwuri . Ne la'pa omuwali owa'an mai A ' die mhi ' arur miemna hyalmu re .

La ' ler maka miy edon miodi hare , de mikleha hadomdoma ? Honona riwra , Edonna , Matroma !

Whoever has none , let him sell his cloak , and buy a sword . ||| Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , Mere la ' dodo'ondi de he ' a kupan genni onde tangkunu etla de miodia re , me he ' mak kakleha wehla plalahwa de mi'ol dioinia raini plalahwami re pa ma miwelia wehla plalahwa .

Ne hota Alier la hare honona maka e rhorat targa . Meman nek la hya ' ed maka ha rhorat tar lia ' Puka ralamni pa rakot nohor A ' u , de hota itamkek memna la dodo'ondi .

and said to them , Why do you sleep ? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation . ||| Noma Npol lia re pa Nakot la , Nihya'pa mininmi ? ! Mimat pa msiumbaini totpena yana hegana amlawanni nreh nian miy pia mlier la do ' a-hala ralamni !
While he was still speaking , a crowd appeared . He who was called Judas , one of the twelve , was leading them . He came near to Jesus to kiss him . ||| La'pa Yesus entepartar mua'ta la yaltieri , dewade plinu-plinnianama riy lidan lawna ida nmai wia .
