Rmai pia rwakrian wia noma Yudas la ' pa nkinnia Yesus .
But Jesus said to him , Judas , do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss ? ||| Mere Yesus Nakot la Yudas Niwra , O e mniairia kinin de pa mu'olga Rimormior A'na A ' dina , Yudasa ? !
When those who were around him saw what was about to happen , they said to him , Lord , shall we strike with the sword ? ||| La'pa maka Yesus ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re ramkek memna hihi ' a-yapyap miaka hota ha rhi ' a re noma rakot la Yesus riwra , Matroma , amtemna wehla rilla pa amdawar wen ira ?
A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest , and cut off his right ear . ||| Noma maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a ida nleh dioinia wehlani pa ndawar doinia riy ida tlinni walli malganna . Riy de nhi ' hopopna la imam-imam re o'ta lawanni .
But Jesus answered , Let me at least do this-and he touched his ear and healed him . ||| Mere Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , Hadewa la hihi ' a-yapyap miak emkade ! Noma Nteman la hopopan de tlinni dewade tlinni nkalwiedweda la ' genni .
Jesus said to the chief priests , captains of the temple , and elders , who had come against him , Have you come out as against a robber , with swords and clubs ? ||| La'pa nhor nioma Yesus Nakot la imam-imam re o'tani-matni re rora mak katiaka roma krei o'tani-matni me Yahudi in letni-am letni mak kmai pia riwra rtorna Yesus la hande , Niwra , Hoi ! Hya ' nrei pia miodia wehla ara me kakaklu ma mtiorn A ' u ? ! Yanpa la ' miy wniarormi de A ' di de riy yatyata-halala id A ' u ? !
When I was with you in the temple daily , you did n't stretch out your hands against me . But this is your hour , and the power of darkness . ||| La ' lera-ler nek de A ' g e gor miy pia it rewre'wa la ' a Uplerlawna roma kreini , mere miy edonna mtiorn A ' u . Mere la ' dodo'ondi de Uplerlawna Nhur niohor miy pa mliernohora miy ralma-rior yatyatmi de , yoma ler di ed maka Uplerlawna Nhur niohora hegana amlawanni mak kar lia melmelli-kalkalamni pa nodi plolli .
They seized him and led him away , and brought him into the high priest 's house . But Peter followed from a distance . ||| Dewade rtorna Yesus pa rodia la imam-imam o'ta lawanni romni . Ne Petrus nlernohor reria mere edon nwakrian lia .
When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together , Peter sat among them . ||| La'pa rte'ela hande noma rhokla ai lia rom de herni-gaini letgarni noma ramtatna pa ramriri ai , noma Petrus nla ' pa namtatan wutga pa nre'ela namrir wutga ai lia riy mak kden la hande .
A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light , and looking intently at him , said , This man also was with him . ||| Edon nalo'on wali ne pat mak khoi-ktani ida namkek nana Petrus namtatan la ' ai onni noma namkek tertehra na'nama nakot la niwra , Riy di nhi'inde nor Yesus rala ' wutu !
He denied Jesus , saying , Woman , I do n't know him . ||| Mere Petrus nrehera , niwra , Eee ! A ' niek de uplinu-uplo ' nohora riy de !
After a little while someone else saw him and said , You also are one of them ! But Peter answered , Man , I am not ! ||| La'pa edon nalo'on wali ne riy id owa'ana namkek nan Petrus na'nama nakot la Petrus niwra , Emeknekama dodo'ona o e muor walia Yesus talla . Mere Petrus nwalolla niwra , Edonna , A ' g edonna !
After about one hour passed , another confidently affirmed , saying , Truly this man also was with him , for he is a Galilean ! ||| Edonna nhal de jama id owa'an ne riy id owa'an nakot la niwra , Plol toto ' a riy di de ed maka nhi'inde kora Yesus talla , yoma riy Galilea eda de .
But Peter said , Man , I do n't know what you are talking about ! Immediately , while he was still speaking , a rooster crowed . ||| Mere Petrus nwalolla niwra , A ' g e uplin niohora hya ' a maka mukota re ! Pa la'pa Petrusa naltiertier mia'ta , de edon nalo'on wali ne hiwi lallu nkukule'ewa .
The Lord turned and looked at Peter . Then Peter remembered the Lord 's word , how he said to him , Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times . ||| Noma Yesus mana Nakillia Petrus handedena . Noma Petrus nhioratni nko ' i nana Itmatromni lirni la e ' a , Niwra , Hota hiwi lallu edonna nkukule ' ma'ta , la ler di de o ' e mrieher nan olek A lia re'eni wotel wua .
He went out , and wept bitterly . ||| Noma Petrus nlergot la gen die na'nama nahedge'du la kniakru .
The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him . ||| Riy maka katiaka Yesus , rahe ' i-ramali Yesus me ramuki-rama'ala .
Having blindfolded him , they struck him on the face and asked him , Prophesy ! Who is the one who struck you ? ||| Rtutwu apitga Yesus matni na'nama rakot la riwra , Makwohorulu-ktatrulu O ' a , pa Mpuet tek la he ' ed maka kdupla O ' a dena !
They spoke many other things against him , insulting him . ||| Ral neka lira-tunu yahe ' i-yamali pa ra rwohora-rtatra Yesus .
As soon as it was day , the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together , both chief priests and scribes , and they led him away into their council , saying , ||| La'pa yawyawar ma'ta de Yahudi in letni-am letni rora imam-imam o'tani-matni me makwatutu-kwaye ' a agama re rawok pa retlia Yesus lirni-tunnu . Noma mak katiaka Yesus rlidan nana E ' pa rodia la maketlia agama lira-tunu re gaini ralamni .
If you are the Christ , tell us . But he said to them , If I tell you , you wo n't believe , ||| Rakot la Yesus riwra , Mpualol tek la mai ami . Hota O ' di de Ray Makamori-Kalewna O ' a maka Uplerlawna Nano'taru ? Noma Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , La'pa A'ukot ho ' a mana hota miy edonna mpiesiay A ' u .
and if I ask , you will in no way answer me or let me go . ||| Ne la'pa A'utian miy ho'mana , hota miy edonna mpiet nana .
From now on , the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God . ||| Mere hota edon nalo'on wali ne Rimormiori A'na A ' die hota umtatan la ' a Uplerlawna-Mempulwatnu mak kodi plolli la haneknek wawannu , de walli malganna pa Agor Uplerlawna Modi plolli .
They all said , Are you then the Son of God ? He said to them , You say it , because I am . ||| Noma honona ratian Yesus riwra , Hade emkade O ' di de Uplerlawna A'nani toto ' O ' a ? Noma Yesus Nwalolla Niwra , Inhatta ! Mimpiet nan oleka wa .
They said , Why do we need any more witness ? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth ! ||| Dewade riwra , Yana itwahak owa'an mak ktutrier saksi niohora lira-tunu ri . E lirni nek de nwaghal olek E inon wamueheni !
The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate . ||| Noma mak kdena re honona raprir pia rodia Yesus la Pilatus de .
They began to accuse him , saying , We found this man perverting the nation , forbidding paying taxes to Caesar , and saying that he himself is Christ , a king . ||| La'pa rte'ela Pilatus gaini na'nama honona rto'on reria Yesus pa rakot la riwra , Ama , amlernan oleka la ' riy di de Nodia lima-rora masyarakat la talla klierta ralamni yoma Entot ir pa rmalawna hairi Romawi . E ' ed maka khi ' a rira pa yana rpairia blasten la ' a mak ktorna horta-hairi Romawi me Eniwra E ' de ray ida E ' a , maka Uplerlawna Nano'taru pa Namori-nalewna E rimormiorni .
Pilate asked him , Are you the King of the Jews ? He answered him , So you say . ||| Noma Pilatus natiana Yesus niwra , Plola O ' di de ray Yahudi id O ' a ? Noma Yesus Nwalolla Niwra , Emek lir mak omukot de !
Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes , I find no basis for a charge against this man . ||| Dewade Pilatus nakot la imam-imam o'tani-matni re rora riy mak kden la hande honona niwra , A ' g edonna liernan etia hala kuku ' la ' a riy di totpena nlernana niukmu .
But they insisted , saying , He stirs up the people , teaching throughout all Judea , beginning from Galilee even to this place . ||| Mere riy rariahu re edonna rwadura ne ramera-ramer matni pa riwra , Wniatutnu-wniaye'eni de e nwewr olek la ' a Yudea pa nareiniande riy kokokna-rariarni . Enwag ulga la Galilea dewade Nhi ' owa'ana la Yudea pa dodo'ondi Nmai meman la handi !
But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned , he asked if the man was a Galilean . ||| La'pa Pilatus natlin nan Yesus Nwatiawu Galilea , noma natiana niwra , O ! Hota riy di de makden Galilea eda di ?
When he found out that he was in Herod 's jurisdiction , he sent him to Herod , who was also in Jerusalem during those days . ||| La'pa rakota riwra Yesus de ha Nwatiawua leta-ruhuna maka Herodes nodi plolli la , dewade Pilatus nhopan pa rodia la Herodes de . La ' lera de mana Herodes ed walia la Yerusalem .
Now when Herod saw Jesus , he was exceedingly glad , for he had wanted to see him for a long time , because he had heard many things about him . He hoped to see some miracle done by him . ||| Noma Herodes la'pa matni namkek nana Yesus dewade nahepur wenna yoma la ' mahnek memna ralamni nwakwak de pa enor rwatroma . E wakwakni de totpena Yesus Ntutga hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona pa enamkek memna , yoma enatlin olek la ' a hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona maka nhi'inde Ha Nhi ' nan de .
He questioned him with many words , but he gave no answers . ||| Noma Herodes natian la ' a-maiya . Mere Yesus Nherieri tio'owa .
The chief priests and the scribes stood , vehemently accusing him . ||| Imam-imam re o'tani-matni rora makwatutu-kwaye ' a agama re , pa honona rewre'wa rtutrier lia hande pa rotil reria hala la Yesus de rkamota-rkama'ara .
Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him . Dressing him in luxurious clothing , they sent him back to Pilate . ||| Dewade Herodes nora makodi keki-rautu mak katiak Herodes rod lia ' a-rod miai Yesus la yahe ' i-yamali . Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day , for before that they were enemies with each other . ||| La ululu de Herodes nora Pilatus emeknekama pat eriariai mere la ' ler de meman pa rwali owa'an la emeknekama am nora hyalli .
Pilate called together the chief priests , the rulers , and the people , ||| Pilatus nawoka-nale'ga imam-imam o'tani-matni , in letni-am letni ror wut nieka lima-rora honona .
and said to them , You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people , and behold , having examined him before you , I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him . ||| Na'nama nakot la re niwra , Mimiottiarga Hadi pa Nmai a ' die me miwra E ' ed maka khi ' pa rirahu rmalawna horta-hairi Roma . Pa la'pa dodo'ondi de a'utian momuog olekwa la miy gaimi ralamni . Mere hala id mana a ' g edonna liernana emeka mikot olek la mai a ' u .
Neither has Herod , for I sent you to him , and see , nothing worthy of death has been done by him . ||| Hade emekwalima Herodes ralma-riorni , yoma Herodes nek de na'enyat owa'an pa nmai it di . Tamkek nan memna la ' riy di , de edonna nhi ' nana hadom de npa'eini-npahala totpena rukum penna .
I will therefore chastise him and release him . ||| La ' hade pede hota aliwra nanpena agolin doinia la .
Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast . ||| Yoma nhi'inde la ' a lerlalawna Paska Pilatus nollia riy Yahudi maka ha rukmu re id la la ' pa nler la lima-rora .
But they all cried out together , saying , Away with this man ! Release to us Barabbas ! - ||| Dewade riy honona maka kden la hande riarin tar lia nhiaunu riwra , Rwenna Yesus de ! Ne muolin doin Barabas la !
one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city , and for murder . ||| Barabas di de ed maka e rho'la taru la roma nhio'la yoma narieiniande riy rmalawna horta-hairi Romawi la ' a kokokna-rariarni la leta ralamni la'pa nwunu-nwenna rimormiori .
Then Pilate spoke to them again , wanting to release Jesus , ||| Mere Pilatus niwra nolin doinia Yesus . La hade pede nakot owa'an hade la riy honona re .
but they shouted , saying , Crucify ! Crucify him ! ||| Mere rhaun-rhaun pa riwra , Rla rwair neka wa ! Rla rwairia la auwlakra hananni !
He said to them the third time , Why ? What evil has this man done ? I have found no capital crime in him . I will therefore chastise him and release him . ||| Pilatus nakot lira re'eni wotellu de niwra , Mere halli hya ' a pede ? A ' g edonna liernana do ' a-hal maka kariei pia totpena rukum penna di ! Pede hota aliwar nek wa nanpena agolin doinia la .
But they were urgent with loud voices , asking that he might be crucified . Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed . ||| Mere honona edonna rwayow o'tani . Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done . ||| Pede Pilatus natrernia niukum matmiati la Yesus , yoma riy honona wakwakni inhatta .
He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder , for whom they asked , but he delivered Jesus up to their will . ||| Ne Pilatus nolin doinia Barabas maka ha rwaka , kennama e ' ed maka ha rho'la taru yoma nhi ' kokokna-rariarni ne nwunu-nwenna rimormiori . Mere Pilatus nala Yesus la ira totpa rodia la'pa plolli nek la ira wniahi'ini wa .
When they led him away , they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene , coming from the country , and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus . ||| Noma ra'ala Yesus pa rodi rla'awa . Rla ' noma rwatrom nana riy Kirene ida , nwawa Simona la ' talan letgara pa niwa nla'awa la ' letlawna Yerusalem . Dewade rte'la la Simon na'nama rtekua pa nre'ela nakwara auwlakar de pa nlernohor reri Yesus .
A great multitude of the people followed him , including women who also mourned and lamented him . ||| Rirahu rlernohor reria Yesus pa rala ' wutu . Me la ' lidan lawan de , patke ' a doma e ror wali pa koko ' a-herer nohora Yesus .
But Jesus , turning to them , said , Daughters of Jerusalem , do n't weep for me , but weep for yourselves and for your children . ||| Mere Yesus Nkillia na'nama Nakot la re Niwra , Pat Yerusalem miy re yana mkiakur nohora A ' u . Mkiakur nohor neka miora upmi-a'nami .
For behold , the days are coming in which they will say , ‘ Blessed are the barren , the wombs that never bore , and the breasts that never nursed . ' ||| Yoma hota nte'ela la ' lerni de riy riwra , Adoh ! Patke ' mak kakleha upa-a'na re ra'unut matmiati ee !
Then they will begin to tell the mountains , ‘ Fall on us ! ' and tell the hills , ‘ Cover us . ' ||| La ' ler de mana hota riy rakot la wo'ora re riwra , Wo'ormi re mtiuin pa miutin wen ami , me rakot wali la ' a wo'or kuke ' a re riwra , Mia mpiupun wen ami ee !
For if they do these things in the green tree , what will be done in the dry ? ||| Yoma la'pa riy rhi ' emkadi mai A ' u mak kakleha do ' a-hala de , hya ' ho ' a ha rhi ' a la ' riy dodo ' a-halal miy re ! A ' die nek de emeknekama ora-au muaka kmormior mia'ta pa ai edon na'an doinia la . Mere miy miaka khi ' a-kyapi do ' a-hal miy re hota emolannekama ora-au muaka kerna-khag olekwa pa rhoplial walia la ai mormiori ralamni de nram doin momuoga la !
There were also others , two criminals , led with him to be put to death . ||| La hande mana hota rod wialia riy yatyata worg maka e riwra rla rukum penna nohor wali Yesus .
When they came to the place that is called The Skull , they crucified him there with the criminals , one on the right and the other on the left . ||| La'pa rte'ela gen miaka ha rweta la Riy Ruri-Kliaklu Genni , dewade rla rwairia Yesus la auwlakar hananni me rla rwairia riy maroro ' a re , id la malganna , id la malwiru ne Yesus Nden la letgara .
Jesus said , Father , forgive them , for they do n't know what they are doing . Dividing his garments among them , they cast lots . ||| Noma Yesus Nsumbain la Niwra , Amee ! Yana mtio'ona harilla ' do'oni-halli wawannu , yoma hari e raplin niohor ma'ta hya ' maka ha rhi ' a re ee ! Noma rdurmu-rhakra Yesus naniayarni de rnairia patui undi .
The people stood watching . The rulers with them also scoffed at him , saying , He saved others . Let him save himself , if this is the Christ of God , his chosen one ! ||| Rirahu mak ktutrier lia hande ramkek momuoga . Yahudi o'tani-matni nek de mana ertepartarlia rwali-rwalliohora Yesus pa riwra , Hota la'pa plola la Enhi ' a Ray Makamori-Kalewna , maka Uplerlawna orgahani Nwalir niana , de tamkek teka hota Nodi plolli pa Nalewna E inon wamueheni pa emeknekama Enamori-nalewn oleka riy meheni ?
The soldiers also mocked him , coming to him and offering him vinegar , ||| Makodi keki-rautu re mana rre ' wal pia rwali-rwalliohora Yesus . Rmai pia riwra rala anggur turnu mak milmilu la Yesus .
and saying , If you are the King of the Jews , save yourself ! ||| Noma rakot la , La'pa O ' di de riy Yahudi Rayni id O ' a , de Mulewan teka inon wamuehemu .
An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek , Latin , and Hebrew , THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS . ||| La ' a auwlakra walli heyanna , la Yesus o'tani de e rhorat targa , Yahudi Rayni inhatti .
One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him , saying , If you are the Christ , save yourself and us ! ||| Riy yatyat id mak kden la auwlakra hananni de nre ' wal pia napolu-naliella Yesus pa niwra , O ' di de Ray Makamori-Kalewn id O ' a , pa Mulewan teka O muor ami !
But the other answered , and rebuking him said , Do n't you even fear God , seeing you are under the same condemnation ? ||| Mere riy yatyat mak handina de npolliohora mutwualli de niwra , Hoi ! O ' nek de e rukum temna la E ' a ne hota o ' mana muati wial wia . Ne o ' edonna mumta'ata Uplerlawna niukamnu ? !
And we indeed justly , for we receive the due reward for our deeds , but this man has done nothing wrong . ||| Itro ' a tlernana niukum di mak lol talanni yoma la ' a itro ' a do'oni-halli mak kariei . Mere E ' de Nakleh do ' a-hala kuku ' a .
He said to Jesus , Lord , remember me when you come into your Kingdom . ||| Noma nakot la Yesus niwra , Yesus , Mhuoratreri a ' u la'pa Omhi ' a Ray mak ktorna-krautu lodanmu-hairmu .
Jesus said to him , Assuredly I tell you , today you will be with me in Paradise . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la , Mpuesiayo , ler di meman pa omuor rewre'wa A lia Firdaus .
It was now about the sixth hour , and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour . ||| Edonna nhal de la'pa lera nwawuau ro'onni jam termida wehrani woru mere la ' a noh de tetema nekpa mel'uta-maliena nodia pa lera nher miemna jam wotellu
The sun was darkened , and the veil of the temple was torn in two . ||| yoma lera edonna nhita-nrepra . Noma plin-plinnianamde kok lawna maka ha ra rahew tiarga liolgeni la ' a gen mak kmou-kwitna la Uplerlawna roma kreini ralamni totpa riy edon rler la rialma , de ema rlihirwah ' a la woru .
Jesus , crying with a loud voice , said , Father , into your hands I commit my spirit ! Having said this , he breathed his last . ||| Dewade Yesus Nhaun matmiat pia Niwra , Am ee ! Aghoiya A ino'nu pa Mkienia la limmu rora ralamni ! La'pa Naltier pia nhorwua noma Nmat wia .
When the centurion saw what was done , he glorified God , saying , Certainly this was a righteous man . ||| La'pa makhi ' o'tani la lidna makodi keki-rautu , mak katiak reri Yesus de , namkek memna hare honona dewade na'uli-nawedia Uplerlawna pa niwra , Plol toto ' a la Ha Nakleh do ' a-hala !
All the multitudes that came together to see this , when they saw the things that were done , returned home beating their chests . ||| La'pa rirahu mak kawok la hande ramkek momuoga hare honona dewade honona rla'awa de ralamni rmolu-rhelam doin la .
All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance , watching these things . ||| Mere Yesus loiwialli-talanwalli re honona , me la ' walia a'na pat maka kwatiawua Galilea pa klernohor E ' a , rtutrier niek la oliet pa ramkek momuoga hare honona .
Behold , there was a man named Joseph , who was a member of the council , a good and righteous man he had not consented to their counsel and deed , from Arimathaea , a city of the Jews , who was also waiting for God 's Kingdom . ||| Noma riy id la hande de nanni Yusup . E ' de riy mak kwatiawua leta Arimatea la ' a Yudea . E ' de riy samomuou ida , mak kden la plol wawna la Uplerlawna yamkekni . Ne nhi'inde ralamni nod rer lia wniei la Uplerlawna hota Nwalia Ray id pa Nma Ntorna lodna-hairi . E ' mana nhi'inde nre ' wal pia nla ' a riy maketlia lira-tunu la agama hanni , mere la ' ler de e edonna nre ' pa nwayow nohora maketlia lira-tunu re lirni pa rwenna Yesus .
This man went to Pilate , and asked for Jesus ' body . ||| Noma Yusup di nla ' pa nwak la Pilatus totpena na'ala Yesus inonni mak kmati olek de .
He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth , and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone , where no one had ever been laid . ||| Nhor nia'nama nla nalernia Yesus mak kmati olek della la ' a auwlakra hananni . Na'nama nala kok lawan wawahra mak kamnurnuhru na ntomna . Nhor nia'nama nla nle'er targa la ' a ketar maka ha rawte'ta nana . Hoi-kietar de edonna rnairi et mia'ta la ' a mati doma .
It was the day of the Preparation , and the Sabbath was drawing near . ||| La ler de , ler maka rwahi ' targa hare honona pa rwei-rnara Sabat lerni ler maka Yahudi re edon rkar lia , yoma nhi ' kuku ' owa'an de Sabat de ntutu-nte'ewa .
The women who had come with him out of Galilee followed after , and saw the tomb and how his body was laid . ||| La ' ler de de a'na pat mak kwatiawua Galilea pa klernohora Yesus rmai pia rlernohora Yusup totpena ramkek memna hota nle'er targa Yesus la ' hoi-kietra meni ralamni .
They returned and prepared spices and ointments . On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment . ||| Nhorwua noma rla'awa pa rwahi ' a-rwayod tiarga wu'ru mak kahuwu mikmikri totpena rma rawu'ru-ragania Yesus mak kmati olek de wa . Mere la'pa nte'ela la ' a Sabat lerni maka Yahudi edon rkar lia , dewade honona re rrena pleini , yoma rlernohora agama deullu-tatarni lirni .
But on the first day of the week , at early dawn , they and some others came to the tomb , bringing the spices which they had prepared . ||| La'pa yawyawar ma'ta la krei lerni dewade a'na patke ' a re rodia wu'ru mak kahuwu mikmikri re pa rla ' a lien maka ha rkenia Yesus inonni , totpena riwra rla rawu'ru-ragania Yesus maka nietra olek la ' a hoi ralamni de .
They found the stone rolled away from the tomb . ||| Rla pa rwakriania hoi die onni dewade ramkek de wat liawan maka ha ra rherit targa hoi die nhiarni ema rwaklol dioin oleka wa .
They entered in , and did n't find the Lord Jesus ' body . ||| Dewade rodi liarni pa rler la tiamin mat gen die ralamni , mere edonna ramkek nana Itmatromlawanni Yesus inonni , mak kmati olek de wa la ' hande .
