Again , the next day , John was standing with two of his disciples , ||| La'pa repar wa , noma Yohansi nora riy woru maklernohor reri e ' a re rawali owa'an la gen die .
and he looked at Jesus as he walked , and said , Behold , the Lamb of God ! ||| Noma Yohansi namkek nana Yesus nwehweti dewade nakot la re niwra , Mimkeka Uplerlawna Dum A'nani inhatta !
The two disciples heard him speak , and they followed Jesus . ||| La'pa riy maroro ' mak klernohor reria Yohansi ratlin nana ed lir de noma rora rla ' pa rlernohora Yesus .
Jesus turned and saw them following , and said to them , What are you looking for ? They said to him , Rabbi which is to say , being interpreted , Teacher , where are you staying ? ||| Noma Yesus Nkillia to'orni , de Namkek nana rrora e rlernohor reria E ' a . Noma Yesus Natiana re Niwra , Miy e mihaka hya ' a ? Noma rrora riwra , Rabi Tungkurga , O genmu etla hanmeni ?
He said to them , Come and see . They came and saw where he was staying , and they stayed with him that day . It was about the tenth hour . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Ma mieh ' a mimkeka . Noma rlernohora pa rla ramkeka Yesus genni . La ' lera lia'ani jam 4 de , noma ror rewre'wa Yesus pa rden wutu pa la'pa mela ndamit wa .
One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew , Simon Peter 's brother . ||| La ' riy id la ' a riy maroro ' a ri , de Andarias , Simon Petrus hyalli .
He first found his own brother , Simon , and said to him , We have found the Messiah ! which is , being interpreted , Christ . ||| La ' pa nora Yesus rwahaur la genni nhorwua noma Andarias pleta-plet pa nla owa'an pa nla nwahaka hyalli Simon pa nakot la niwra , Hyalia , ami e mpatrom nan oleka Mesias ! Mak ha nwet la Mesias de yawala Ibrani , mere la ' a yawala Yunani de riwra Kristus , de nnia'eratni de Ray maka Uplerlawna Nano'taru pa Namori-nalewna rimormiori .
He brought him to Jesus . Jesus looked at him and said , You are Simon the son of Jonah . You shall be called Cephas which is by interpretation , Peter . ||| Noma Andarias nodia Simon la ' Yesus de . Noma Yesus Nkillia Simon na'nama Nakot la Niwra , O ' di de Simon , Yonas a'nani . Pena rwet o la Kefas maka la ' yawal Yunani de rweta la Petrus , de nnia'eratni de watu muetam kerna .
On the next day , he was determined to go out into Galilee , and he found Philip . Jesus said to him , Follow me . ||| La'pa repar wa noma Yesus Nwaror pa Nla'awa Galilea . Noma Nwahak pa la'pa Nwatrom nana Pilipsu noma Nakot la Niwra , Pilipsu , mua mliernohor A ' u !
Now Philip was from Bethsaida , the city of Andrew and Peter . ||| Pilipus di de riy Betsaida ida di , ne Andarias nora Petrus mana rwatiawu wali hande .
Philip found Nathanael , and said to him , We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets , wrote , Jesus of Nazareth , the son of Joseph . ||| Noma Pilipsu nla nwatrom nana Nataniel pa nakot walia niwra , Eh , ampatrom nan oleka Ray Makamori-Kalewna maka Musa nakot nohora la Puk maka ha rhorat targa Uplerlawna deullu-tatarni me la ' walia maka makwohorulu-ktatrulu ha rhorat tar walia . Hade de Yesus mak kwatiawua Nasaret , Yusup a'nani !
Nathanael said to him , Can any good thing come out of Nazareth ? Philip said to him , Come and see . ||| Mere Nataniel nwahla lir de niwra , Ah , Nasaret de kuku ' nekane , Ray Makamori-Kalewna de Nwatiawu handena ? ! Noma Pilipsu nakot la , Mai pia mueh ' a mumkek memna .
Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him , and said about him , Behold , an Israelite indeed , in whom is no deceit ! ||| La'pa Yesus Namkek de Nataniel nmai wia , noma Nakot nohor Nataniel Niwra , Mimkek la , makden Israel plollolli inhatta id nmai wiee ! E ' de maka ka'ohpa-kalahar atia ' e ' a .
Nathanael said to him , How do you know me ? Jesus answered him , Before Philip called you , when you were under the fig tree , I saw you . ||| Noma Nataniel natiana la Yesus niwra , Tuna , la emkameni pede omuat niohor a yeh'wu ? Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Eh , Pilipsu edonna npol mua't o ' a , de A ' g e umkek nan o la ' kar on id nayanni .
Nathanael answered him , Rabbi , you are the Son of God ! You are King of Israel ! ||| Noma Nataniel nakot la niwra , Tungkurga , O ' di de Uplerlawna A'nani O ' a . O ' ed mak khi ' Ray lia Israel luwnu-a'nani .
Jesus answered him , Because I told you , ‘ I saw you underneath the fig tree , ' do you believe ? You will see greater things than these ! ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , O e mpuesiay yoma dodo'ondi de A'ukotiwra A'umkek olek o ' a la ' a kar on id nayanni ? ! Hya ' maka kareh dioin memna A hihi ' u-yapya'pu de , hota mumkek memna .
He said to him , Most certainly , I tell you all , hereafter you will see heaven opened , and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man . ||| Plola mpiesiayo , hota mimkek nana lyanti naphyariari ne Uplerlawna hopopanni malaikat re hota rernu-rha'ata pa rmai lia Rimormiori A'nani A ' die !
The third day , there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee . Jesus ' mother was there . ||| La'pa lera woru rtaw dioinia pa lera wotell wua noma e rhi ' a he ' i-hepur la mak kmehlima la ' a leta Kana , de Galilea letni ida . Ne Yesus inni ed wal lia hande .
Jesus also was invited , with his disciples , to the wedding . ||| Yesus Nora maklernohor reria re , rlernan walia polpuolu la ' a he ' i-hepur de .
When the wine ran out , Jesus ' mother said to him , They have no wine . ||| La'pa anggur turnu maka ha remnia la he ' i-hepur de nhorwua , noma Yesus inni nakot la niwra , Yesus ! Hare anggur turnu nhorwua .
Jesus said to her , Woman , what does that have to do with you and me ? My hour has not yet come . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Yan mukot mai a ' u , ina . Edonna nte ' ma'ta la Uplerlawna lerni pa Agharia ino'nu .
His mother said to the servants , Whatever he says to you , do it . ||| Mere Yesus inni nakot la mak ktulla-kari re , Mliernohor neka hya ' mak Ha Nakota tiy miy .
Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews ' way of purifying , containing two or three metretes apiece . ||| La hande de e rwahi ' targa kuhi wonema , maka ha rhi ' a la ' watu , maka nhi'inde rken ger la pa rlernohora agama Yahudi deullu-tatarni pa ra rwuri-rohma . Kuhi re mniotni de edonna nhal de , ida , de na'nana potla rahu rehenu 100 liter .
Jesus said to them , Fill the water pots with water . So they filled them up to the brim . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la mak ktulla-kari re , Niwra , Mhiur ger la ' kuhi re . Dewade rhur ger la kuhi re wonema pa rpenpuenu .
He said to them , Now draw some out , and take it to the ruler of the feast . So they took it . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la re , Mia'ala ger de oke ' la dodo'ondi wa pa miala la mak khi ' o'tani la ' a he ' i-hepru . Noma rodia ger della la ' a mak khi ' o'tani la he ' i-hepur de .
When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine , and did n't know where it came from but the servants who had drawn the water knew , the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom ||| La'pa nto ' targa nurnu la ger maka kwali olek la anggur de , de naplin niohora anggur de nwatiawua hanmeni , atiaru mak ktulla-kari mak khuri-kwalia gera la kuhi re nanpena rat niohora re . Noma mak khi ' o'tani la he ' i-hepur de npolu a'na muanke ' a mak kmehlim de pa nmai .
and said to him , Everyone serves the good wine first , and when the guests have drunk freely , then that which is worse . You have kept the good wine until now ! ||| Na'nama nakot la , Nhi'inde la ' a kniari emkari , de ral ulga anggur tur mikmikri , la'pa remun pa rmah wenna nanpena rala maka niemannu namnapnapla . Mere hadi de miy e mide ' targa anggur tur mikmikir di pa na'nama milgota .
This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee , and revealed his glory , and his disciples believed in him . ||| Hadi ed maka Yesus Nhi ' a hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona mujizat mulaliaini mak ktutga Uplerlawna rurni-laini , ne Nhi ' nan hade la ' a leta Kana , Galilea letni de . La ' hade totpena Entutga E preheni-mkaini la nohkerna wawannu . Dewade mak klernohor reri re rpesiay tioto ' memna E ' a .
After this , he went down to Capernaum , he , and his mother , his brothers , and his disciples , and they stayed there a few days . ||| Nhorwua noma Yesus Nora inni , amni-hyalli , me la ' walia maklernohor reri E ' a re rla'awa la ' a leta Kapernaum . Rden nek la ' hande pa lera ida-woru .
The Passover of the Jews was at hand , and Jesus went up to Jerusalem . ||| La'pa Paska lerni nwakrian wia de la ' ler maka Yahudi rhoratreria tuini-wedni la ' ler maka rwe'er doin la wutwutu-kokgohu la ' Mesir noma Yesus Nla'awa la Yerusalem .
He found in the temple those who sold oxen , sheep , and doves , and the changers of money sitting . ||| La ' a Uplerlawna roma kreini mak kden la Yerusalem de walli-walli , de Yesus Nhortiut niana rimormiori mak ranie'er la krei die herni-gaini pa ramtatna pa ra'olu-rala ' a pipi-duma , hayori-orpau me onu-ma'nu me rwahernu-rwahala kupna-kai .
He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple , both the sheep and the oxen , and he poured out the changers ' money and overthrew their tables . ||| Dewade Yesus Ntal niana tali id pa na Nhokra-nlai mak ka'olu-kala ' a ror wutga nhiuri-wnia'an mak kden la hande , ne Nliwra pa kurna-kiatra re . Mei-kader no ' hande maka rnairia ra rwahernu-rwahala kupna , de Nte'la rpa Nkowa-nwalia re pa nhi'nande kupna-kai re knunu-knera .
To those who sold the doves , he said , Take these things out of here ! Do n't make my Father 's house a marketplace ! ||| Noma Nakot la mak ka'olu-kala ' a ma'nu lmo'ma maru re Niwra , Hoi ! Mrian doinia harella handi . Yan memmemna mhi ' a A A'mu romni dilla ya'olu-yala ' a geni !
His disciples remembered that it was written , Zeal for your house will eat me up . ||| Noma maklernohor reri re rhoratnana la ' Puka lirni niwra , Mak A ralmu ha nko ' i reria de totpena O rommu ed mak rimormiori rnairia pa rkola tieru-rawur nehla nek tiy O ' a Uplerlawnu ne ! Ne maka A ralmu nko ' i reria de hota nod A lia matmiati-molmuolu ralamni .
The Jews therefore answered him , What sign do you show us , seeing that you do these things ? ||| Noma ina-ama ror wutga o'ta-mat let Yahudi re rapal lia Yesus pa rawowo'ora . Rakot la Yesus riwra , Omhi ' teka hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona mujizat la am di , totpena amatga de O hihi'imu-yapyapmu ri de e lol talanni .
Jesus answered them , Destroy this temple , and in three days I will raise it up . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , Hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona maka Atiutg tiy miy die de emkadi , hota mpieye'era Uplerlawna romni di , ne la ' pena A'uriri owa'an la lera wotellu .
The Jews therefore said , It took forty-six years to build this temple ! Will you raise it up in three days ? ||| Noma riwra , It upni-tgarni rkaria Uplerlawna roma kreini di la ' a anni terampwogata wehrani wonema , ne Omiwra hota Omuriri tio ' a la lera wotellu ? !
But he spoke of the temple of his body . ||| Mere e raplin niohora la Uplerlawna romni maka Yesus Nakot de , de E inon wamueheni inhatta .
When therefore he was raised from the dead , his disciples remembered that he said this , and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said . ||| Hade pede la'pa Yesus Nmori owa'an la matmiatni ralamni , de maklernohor reria re nhioratni e ndawar nana hya ' a maka Nakot taru ri . Pede la ' ler de meman pa rpesiay tioto ' memna hya ' ed maka Puka ha nakota , me la ' walia maka Yesus Nakota de .
Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover , during the feast , many believed in his name , observing his signs which he did . ||| La'pa Yesus ed ma'ta la ' a Yerusalem yoma Yahudi lerlalawanni Paska de edonna nhor mua'ta , de riy harahu rpesiaya Yesus , yoma la ' a hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona maka Nhi ' nana re pa Ntutga Uplerlawna rurni-laini .
But Jesus did n't entrust himself to them , because he knew everyone , ||| Mere Yesus Nmeh ' a nekane edonna Npesiay ma't hare , yoma Enat niohor oleka rimormiori yehwani .
and because he did n't need for anyone to testify concerning man , for he himself knew what was in man . ||| E ' edonna Nwahaka lira yano ' a-ya'atu la ' a rimormiori yehwani la ' a riy meni-meni to ' a yoma E ' nek de e Nat niohora rimormiori ihranu ralamni .
Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus , a ruler of the Jews . ||| Noma riy ida nanni Nikodemus , de riy Parisi ida mak kre ' teman la mak ktorna watghudi la agama Yahudi .
He came to Jesus by night and said to him , Rabbi , we know that you are a teacher come from God , for no one can do these signs that you do , unless God is with him . ||| La ' mela ida de enmaiya Yesus pa nakot la niwra , Am tungkurga , ami e matg oleka de Uplerlawna ed mak khopn O ' pa Omua Mpuatutu-mpuaye ' a rimormiori . Yoma riy meni ho'mana edon nhi ' a hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona mak ktutga Uplerlawna rurni-laini emeka Omhi ' nana re , atiaru me nodia Uplerlawna plolli .
Jesus answered him , Most certainly I tell you , unless one is born anew , he ca n't see God 's Kingdom . ||| Mere Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Mpuesiaya , hota riy id mana edon rler wut et mieman la Uplerlawna mutnu-rahanu , maka Uplerlawna Nodi plolli la pa emeka ir Rayni , atiaru me , rmori owa'an e ' a .
Nicodemus said to him , How can a man be born when he is old ? Can he enter a second time into his mother 's womb and be born ? ||| Nikodemus nwahla , Tuna , hota emkameni owa'an pa rmori owa'an rimormiori ida mak khamto ' a-khape'ew olekwa re ? Plollola pa ta'en niana nla ' owa'an la inni puhunni apannu ralamni pa rmori owa'an la re'eni wornu toh ? !
Jesus answered , Most certainly I tell you , unless one is born of water and Spirit , he ca n't enter into God 's Kingdom . ||| Yesus Nwahla Niwra , Mpuesiaya , eneknek to'ama riy rmor niana la re'eni wornu , maka rnairia gera ra ramou-rawitna me la ' a Uplerlawna Nhiwni Narialmua , demade nre ' wut lia Uplerlawna mutnu-rahanu , mak Uplerlawna Nodi plolli la pa emeka ir Rayni .
That which is born of the flesh is flesh . That which is born of the Spirit is spirit . ||| Yoma rimormiori inonni de it inni ed maka nmor niana , mere mormiori-dardiari plalahwa de nwatiawua Uplerlawna Nhiwni .
Do n't marvel that I said to you , ‘ You must be born anew . ' ||| Yana mpuer rer wiapmu la'pa Agiwra rayori owa'an miy hononmi nanpena mlier wut lia Uplerlawna mutnu .
The wind blows where it wants to , and you hear its sound , but do n't know where it comes from and where it is going . So is everyone who is born of the Spirit . ||| Itala anni pa tsi ' a la yawalliohora , La'pa anni nten liol meni-meni de plolli nek la et nnieni . Hota itatlina anni tnienni , mere itaplin niohora anin de nwatiawua hanmeni pa nla hanmeni . Hota emkade wal lia riy maka riwra Uplerlawna Nhiwni Nayor niana . Yoma it edon todi plolli la Nhiwni de onde tat niohora E yala'ani mere itamkek memna E limni enni la ' a rimormiori nhiolli-lietni .
Nicodemus answered him , How can these things be ? ||| Noma Nikodemus nakot la niwra , Hota hade emkameni totpena naplol la O ltiermu dena ?
Jesus answered him , Are you the teacher of Israel , and do n't understand these things ? ||| Yesus Nakot la Niwra , O ' di de tungkurga Israel id o ' a maka riy rhu'ru-rhelma . Ne hya ' nrei pia omuplin niohora di ?
Most certainly I tell you , we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen , and you do n't receive our witness . ||| Mpuesiayo ! Amaltier di de amakot nohora hya ' maka ami e mat niohora , ne amakot nohora hadoma de la ' a hya ' maka amamkek walia la a mat mamni . Mere miy e mihmena mrieiniana hya ' maka amakot nohora .
If I told you earthly things and you do n't believe , how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things ? ||| Miy edonna mpiesiaya la ' a hya ' maka A'ukot nohora tiy miy la ' a hya ' mak kwatiawua nohkeran di . Ne hota emkameni targho'ola A'ukot nohora la Ilyamou-Watyatoha yala'ani ? !
No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven , the Son of Man , who is in heaven . ||| La ' riy id mana edonna nha'at ma'ta la Ilyamou-Watyatoha pa nerun olek la noha wawannu di pa rakot nohora Ilyamou-Watyatoha gahani . Enekneka Rimormiori A'nani A ' die mak kerun pa kakot nohora re .
As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness , even so must the Son of Man be lifted up , ||| Ne hota emekwalima Musa nwairia niy pi'ra la ' a ai lioha id la wo'orletna-kawurloini totpena he ' ed mak kwatniar reria niy pi'ra de , hota rler la yamori-yalewna la ' a niy mak kihi ira , de hota emkade wal lia , Uplerlawna Nror targ oleka de rla rwairia Rimormiori A'nani A ' u la au hananni .
that whoever believes in him should not perish , but have eternal life . ||| Totpena riy honona mak kpesiay A ' die rlernana mormiori-dardiari pa nodi liarni .
For God so loved the world , that he gave his only born Son , that whoever believes in him should not perish , but have eternal life . ||| De yoma Uplerlawna sniayanni la ' a rimormiori nohkeran di inponni memna , pede Enala Wutmueheni-Laimieheni A ' die , totpena ha meni mak kpesiay A ' die hota edonna nler la matmiati-molmuolu pa rrinnia la ai mormiori ralamni mere nlernana mormiori plalahwa pa nodi liarni .
For God did n't send his Son into the world to judge the world , but that the world should be saved through him . ||| Yoma Uplerlawna Nalernia A'nani A ' die , de edonna muai pia tiorna watghudi la nohkeran di . Mere Amuai die totpena A'umori-ulewna rimormiori .
He who believes in him is not judged . He who does n't believe has been judged already , because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God . ||| Riy maka kpesiay A ' die hota edonna rukmua . Mere riy mak edonna kpesiay Uplerlawna Wutmueheni-Laimieheni A ' u de rto'on reria oleka yoma edonna npesiay Uplerlawna Wutmueheni-Laimieheni .
This is the judgment , that the light has come into the world , and men loved the darkness rather than the light , for their works were evil . ||| Rto'on reria , yoma A ' u maka rweta la Lelerni de muai olek la nohkerna wawannu , mere rimormiori rreiniana-ra'nana ma'ta ha melmelli de . Ha rreiniana-ra'nana melmelli de yoma hihi'ini-yapyapni re lola yatyatni-halalli ralamni .
For everyone who does evil hates the light and does n't come to the light , lest his works would be exposed . ||| Rimormior miaka khi ' yatyatni-halalli , rahankeran rer lia Lelerni de , pa rahmena rma rrehgorga Lelerni , yanhi'pa riy ramkek nana ir yatni-halli .
But he who does the truth comes to the light , that his works may be revealed , that they have been done in God . ||| Mere mak kden la plol wawna , de nma nrehgorg Lelerni de , totpena riy ramkek nan memna de hya ' mak ha nhi ' nana re , de e nlernohora Uplerlawna ralma-riorni .
After these things , Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea . He stayed there with them and baptized . ||| La'pa nhorwua noma Yesus Nora maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re rla'awa la Yudea liewnu . Enden nek la hande pa Nalera-namel nohora re , me la ' hande de Enharan wialia riy .
John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim , because there was much water there . They came and were baptized , for John was not yet thrown into prison . ||| La ' ler de wal pia Yohansi edonna nla ma'ta roma nhio'la ralamni . Mere enharan wali riy la ' a leta Anon mak edon olieta la ' a leta Salim , yoma la ' hande de ger lawna etla . Ne rirahu rma rod niohor e ' a totpena rlernana nhiarani .
Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John 's disciples with some Jews about purification . ||| Noma maklernohor reri Yohansi re dom rora riy Yahudi dom to ' a , de rahuri-rawo'or la ' a deulu-tatra mak kakot nohora ramou-rawitna .
They came to John and said to him , Rabbi , he who was with you beyond the Jordan , to whom you have testified , behold , he baptizes , and everyone is coming to him . ||| Noma rla rakot la Yohansi riwra , Tungkurga , o ' e mhuoratrer mia'ta riy maka kora o ' pa kden la gerlawna Yordan walli dena , maka omukot nohora la rira . Riy de ed mak omtiutga mai ami me la ' walia la ' riy dom to ' a , la ler ululu toh ! La ' dodo'ondi de Enharan wiali riy , ne riy liawanni e rla ' E ' de , me edon rmai owa'an o ' a !
John answered , A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven . ||| Noma Yohansi nakot la re niwra , Emkadella wa . Yoma rimormior id ho'mana ta'en niana rhi ' hadomdoma , eneknek to ' pa la'pa rlernana ra ' a-palu karunia la Uplerlawna , nanpena rwo'la-rlekur la hare honona .
You yourselves testify that I said , ‘ I am not the Christ , ' but , ‘ I have been sent before him . ' ||| Miy orgahami nek de mitlin oleka la mak a'ukota re agiwra a ' di de Ray miak kamori-kalewna atia ' a ' u toh ! Rhopan nek a ' pua a lia ulga E ' a .
He who has the bride is the bridegroom , but the friend of the bridegroom , who stands and hears him , rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom 's voice . Therefore my joy is made full . ||| Ne la ' dodo'ondi de A ralmu nahepuepur reri yoma Mak awuahi ' targa talla la E ' de Enmai olekwa di . A ' niek de emolmolannek to'ama muanke ' a pliolioini . Ne E ' de emolmolan nekama muanke ' a mak kiwra kmehlima . A ' g wuahi ' targa hare honona la ' a muanke ' a mak kmehlima de mehlimni-marya'ani . Ne la'pa lerni ntu'tu pa muanke ' de nor hawni rler la ihyida-ralmida de a'uhepuepur nohora .
He must increase , but I must decrease . ||| Uplerlawna ralma-riorni de totpa rimormiori ya'ulli-yawedni la E ' a na'ititar rer lia , mere totpa yeher to ' pa A ' die Adien la li'iru .
He who comes from above is above all . He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth . He who comes from heaven is above all . ||| E ' ed mak kwatiawu heyanna , pa ed maka kareh momuou lia riy honona . Mak kwatiawu nohkerna wawannu de riy nohkerna , pede naltier die nakot nohora nohkerna gahani . Mere E mak kmai die Nwatiawua heyanan pa tullu nareh dioinia hare honona .
What he has seen and heard , of that he testifies , and no one receives his witness . ||| Pede Naltier die Nakot nohora maka Namkeka me maka Natlina , mere rimormiori nohkeran di edonna rpesiaya hya ' ed maka Ha Nakota re .
He who has received his witness has set his seal to this , that God is true . ||| Mere riy meni mak pesiaya maka Ha Nakot nohora re de , hare er mak kwayow nana Uplerlawna lirni re er mak kaplola .
For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God , for God gives the Spirit without measure . ||| Yoma Yesus , maka Uplerlawna Nhopan pa Nmai die ed mak kakot nohora Uplerlawna lirni-tunnu , yoma Uplerlawna Nal oleka E Nhiwni pa Napenga ihranu ralamni .
The Father loves the Son , and has given all things into his hand . ||| Ne Uplerlawna , Amlawanni de Nhi ' kalwiedweda A'nani de , ne Nal oleka plola-mneha pa Ntorna-nrautia hare honona .
One who believes in the Son has eternal life , but one who disobeys the Son wo n't see life , but the wrath of God remains on him . ||| Pede riy maka kpesiaya Uplerlawna A'nani de , de hota nlernan mormiori plalahwa pa nodi liarni . Mere la'pa riy maka edonna klernohora A'na de hota edonna nlernana mormiori-dardiari pa nodi liarni , mere hota la ' lera-mela ri de Uplerlawna Nto'on olek ir la hala pa rden rer niek la Uplerlawna niukamnu pa nodi liarni .
Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John although Jesus himself did n't baptize , but his disciples , he left Judea and departed into Galilee . ||| Noma riy Parisi re ratlin nan de riy liawanni rlernohor reria Yesus me rwak pa Nharania , de liawanni reh dioinia la mak klernohor Yohansi . Mere la ' a plollolli de Yesus edonna Nharani , mak kharani de riy maka Yesus ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re . Mere la'pa Itmatromni Natga de riy Parisi ratlin oleka hya ' ed maka Enora E limni-rorni rhi ' oleka re , noma Nwatitin la Yudea pa Nawali owa'an la ' a Galilea yanpa Parisi re rhi ' yatyat la E ' a .
He needed to pass through Samaria . ||| La ' yala'ani plahwani de hota Enlol wal lia Samaria .
So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar , near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph . ||| Noma la'pa nte'ela Samaria letni mak kwawa Sikhar . Let de edonna olieta la ' gen miaka Yahudi re upni-tgarni Yakop nala la a'nani Yusup pa nhi ' a la gahani la ' ler ululu .
Jacob 's well was there . Jesus therefore , being tired from his journey , sat down by the well . It was about the sixth hour . ||| La ' hande , de Yakop gera tnipnu etla . Pa Yesus Nala ' nan de nmah wenna , noma Namtatna pa Nrena la ' a gera tnipu die onni . La'pa edonna nhal de lera nwawuau ro'onni .
A woman of Samaria came to draw water . Jesus said to her , Give me a drink . For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food . ||| Dewade maka Yesus ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re rodi liarni la leta ralamni pa rla rawelia ya'ana-yemnu . Edon nalo'on wali ne pat Samaria ida nma tip gera . Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Ina , mtiulan pa muala ger de oke ' pa Agemnio ?
The Samaritan woman therefore said to him , How is it that you , being a Jew , ask for a drink from me , a Samaritan woman ? For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans . ||| Noma pat Samari ' de nakot la niwra , Tuna O ' de riy Yahudi id O ' a , ne a ' di de Samaria id a ' u . Ne emkameni owa'an pa Mpuak ger la mai a ' u ? Enakot emkade yoma nhi'inde makden Yahudi rmakriarnia makden Samaria pa edon rora pa rwatamputu .
Jesus answered her , If you knew the gift of God , and who it is who says to you , ‘ Give me a drink , ' you would have asked him , and he would have given you living water . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Ine , la'pa omuatga de he ' to ' a A ' di me muat niohora Uplerlawna ra'ani-pallu maka Enala rimormiori , de hota omueh ' a neka ed mak kwaka la A ' pua omuemnia . Ne hota A ' g ed mak kala ger mormiori-laliahu della ' o ' a .
The woman said to him , Sir , you have nothing to draw with , and the well is deep . So where do you get that living water ? ||| Noma pat Samari ' de nakot la niwra , Hota Tuna nakleh kewtu ne ger di mana kdielma pa hota Tuna Nlernan ger mormior dilla hanme ?
Are you greater than our father Jacob , who gave us the well and drank from it himself , as did his children and his livestock ? ||| Yakop , a upa-tgar mamni de ed mak kala gera tnip dilla mai ami . E ' nek de nma nala ger di pa nemnia me la ' walia upni-a'nani ror wutga nhiurni-wnia'anni mana remnu ger di . Pa Tuna yanpa Natniekame Tuna inpona narehia Yakopa ? !
Jesus answered her , Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again , ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la , Hota he ' ed mak kemun ger di de hota nahekru tiernu tiernu nkern owa'ana .
but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again , but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life . ||| Mere la'pa he ' a nemnia ger mak hota Agala , de edon nwahak owa'an ger pa nemnia . Yoma ger mak hota Agal di , de nwal lia ger ormata la inonni tetema , ne nwahi'da pa nwau liora , totpena riy de nlernana mormiori-dardiari plalahwa pa nodi liarni .
The woman said to him , Sir , give me this water , so that I do n't get thirsty , neither come all the way here to draw . ||| Noma pat de nakot la niwra , Tuna , emkade de , Muala ger de mai a ' u , totpena yana a tie'ru nkern owa'ana . Ne totpena yana uprehen nek la mua tipua ger di wa .
Jesus said to her , Go , call your husband , and come here . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Mlia ' pa mpuolga muanke'emu pa mrio ' a mmiai .
The woman answered , I have no husband . Jesus said to her , You said well , ‘ I have no husband , ' ||| A'ukleha muanke ' a tune ! Yesus Nakot la , Plola la o lirmu .
for you have had five husbands , and he whom you now have is not your husband . This you have said truly . ||| Yoma omuehlim nan oleka re'eni wolim pa. Ne muanke ' maka omuora mhiol wiut lia dodo'ondi , de o muanke'emu atia ' hade .
The woman said to him , Sir , I perceive that you are a prophet . ||| Noma pat de nakot la Yesus niwra , Na'nama agatga Tuna de makwohorulu-ktatrulu id O ' a .
Our fathers worshiped in this mountain , and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship . ||| Makden Samari ' ami , up mamni-tgar mamni rhoi lima-rtan riora la Uplerlawna la wo'or di . Mere Tuna luwnu-a'nani Yahudi riwra atiaru la ' to ' a Yerusalem nanpena rira rpolu-rwak la Uplerlawna .
Jesus said to her , Woman , believe me , the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father . ||| Yesus Niwra , Mpuesiay A'uo , la ' lera ida de hota riy rpolu-rwak la it Amlawanni de edonna rmai lia wo'or di , me Yerusalem nek de edonan wali .
You worship that which you do n't know . We worship that which we know , for salvation is from the Jews . ||| Riy Samaria miy die mpiolu-mpiak la ' a Uplerlawna maka miplin niohora onni-ga'arni talanni . Mere riy Yahudi am die ampolu-mpak la Uplerlawna mak ami e mat niohora yala'ani , yoma hota mori-lewan de ha nwatiawua riy Yahudi ami .
But the hour comes , and now is , when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth , for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers . ||| Mere la'pa nte'ela lerni-melli mak kmai , me plollolli de ed olekwa di , de riy rpolu-rwak la it Amlawanni Uplerlawna rnair talan mak kaplollola , yoma Uplerlawna Nhiwni Ntulan la ira totpena ratu rpolu-rwak la it Amlawanni . Yoma riy mak kola tieru-kawur nehla la Uplerlawna rnair talan emkade , de ir er maka Uplerlawna Nwahaka inhatta .
God is spirit , and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth . ||| Yoma Uplerlawan de Nhiw to ' hade ne he ' ed mak kiwra kola tieru-kawur nehla la E ' a , de Nlernohora E Nhiwni me la ' a hya ' ed mak kaplola .
The woman said to him , I know that Messiah is coming , he who is called Christ . When he has come , he will declare to us all things . ||| Noma pat Samaria de nakot la Yesus niwra , A ' g e gat niohora Ray Makamori-Kalewna mak riwra Kristus hota Nmai . La'pa Enmai die hota Enod kiot la mai it la ' hare honona .
Jesus said to her , I am he , the one who speaks to you . ||| Yesus Niwra , A ' di de E inhatta . Mak kaltiertier rieri A ' g inhatti pa gor o ' pa maltieri .
Just then , his disciples came . They marveled that he was speaking with a woman , yet no one said , What are you looking for ? or , Why do you speak with her ? ||| La'pa rwahagaur reri dewade maka Yesus ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re rmai wia , ne rwer rer wiawni , yoma Yesus nora pat Samaria ida e rwahauru . Mere riy id mana edonna nkokan nohor patke ' de la ' a ratiana hya ' ed maka ha nwahaka ? Onde nihya'pa Yesus Nor pat Samari ' de raltieri ?
So the woman left her water pot , went away into the city , and said to the people , ||| Dewade patke ' Samaria de naltarga kewatnu pa nawal lia letni pa la nakot nohora hya ' maka ha natlin nana la gera wawannu de , la ' a letlawan de ralamni . Nakot la mak kden la leta ralamni niwra ,
Come , see a man who told me everything that I have done . Can this be the Christ ? ||| Ee ! Mai pia tla pa mimkeka riy mak kakot nohora a nhio'lu-lie'tu honona . Matialo'onama riy de Ray Makamori-Kalewna inhatta ?
They went out of the city , and were coming to him . ||| Dewade mak ha nakot la re rawlar pia rla rod tiemna Yesus la ' a leta to'orni .
In the meanwhile , the disciples urged him , saying , Rabbi , eat . ||| Mere la'pa edon rte ' ma'ta la Yesus , de maka Yesus ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re rwahi ' pa rora Yesus ra'ana-remnu . Rakot la Yesus riwra , Tungkurga , it ta'an wa .
But he said to them , I have food to eat that you do n't know about . ||| Mere Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , A wareheru etla , mere miy e miplin niohora de !
The disciples therefore said to one another , Has anyone brought him something to eat ? ||| Noma maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re idma natian ida niwra , Yanpa riy dom rodia wareher la E ' a ?
Jesus said to them , My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , La'pa Aliernohora Uplerlawna mak khopn A ' u de ralma-riorni , me ghi ' ahorga kniar mak Enala mai A ' u , hade nhi ' A ralmu pa uhepru , emeknekama riy mak kaplar de na'an yamanna pa npeher wa .
Do n't you say , ‘ There are yet four months until the harvest ' ? Behold , I tell you , lift up your eyes and look at the fields , that they are white for harvest already . ||| Nhi'inde miy e mikota miwra , Hota tre ' ma'ta wolla wogat pa noha reiki-wo'ora . Mere A'ukot tiy miy . Mimkek la Samaria re mak kmai nieka yoma riwra rpesiay A ' u ! Ir emolmolan nekama nhyi ' a-tlunni mak kwahi ' pa rreikia wa yoma rwahi ' pa rpesiay A ' u !
He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life , that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together . ||| Dodo'ondi meman pa emeka reiki-wo'ora lerni . Ler di meman pa Uplerlawna Nala riy pa rpesiaya pa emeknekama kniarmi wniahlani . Ne hota riy mak kpesiaya re rler la mormiori-dardiari plalahwa pa nodi liarni . Totpa hota emeknekama la ' a riy mak ktamni nhyi ' a , rora mak kreiki-kwo'ora de ralamni rahepru yoma rler rewre'wa la kalwiedweda la ' a pripanni-fa'anni .
For in this the saying is true , ‘ One sows , and another reaps . ' ||| Pa hota naplol la yawalliohor de mak kiwra , Ida ntamni , ida nreiki .
I sent you to reap that for which you have n't labored . Others have labored , and you have entered into their labor . ||| Yoma Aghopan pa mlia ' a nhyi ' a-tlunan mak miy edonna miprehen la , totpa hota mliernana pripanni-fa'anni . Riy dom to ' a rala ' ulu pua raprehen olek la hare wa . Mere miy er mak klernana pripanni-fa'anni la ' ira kniarni .
From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman , who testified , He told me everything that I have done . ||| Mak kden la Samaria liawanni rpesiaya Yesus yoma la ' a pat de lirni niwra Yesus Nakot momuoga hya ' maka nhi'inde pat de nhi ' nan oleka re .
So when the Samaritans came to him , they begged him to stay with them . He stayed there two days . ||| Pede la'pa riy Samaria re rma rwatrom nana Yesus noma rwak la Yesus pa Ntulan pa Nora ir pa rhol wiutu . Pede Enor ir pa rhol wiut lia ' lera woru .
Many more believed because of his word . ||| Ne la ' a lira-tunu maka orgahi Nmeh ' a Nwatutga la ira , pede rirahu rpesiay walia Yesus .
They said to the woman , Now we believe , not because of your speaking , for we have heard for ourselves , and know that this is indeed the Christ , the Savior of the world . ||| Noma rakot la pat de , riwra , La ' a ler di de ampesiaya , de ami edonna mhapar rer tio'ola hya ' ed mak omukota mai ami , yoma ameh ' a matlin memna la E ' a , ne amatg olek walia la E ' de , de plola Makamori-Kalewna rimormiori nohkerna inhatta .
After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee . ||| La'pa Yesus Ndella leta Sikhar la ' ler woru , noma Nla'awa la Galilea , de E let wamueheni .
For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country . ||| Yesus Nmeh ' a nek de Enakot oleka Niwra , La ' makwohorulu-ktatrulu id nek de hota edonna rhu'ru-rhelam la let wamueheni .
So when he came into Galilee , the Galileans received him , having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast , for they also went to the feast . ||| Mere la'pa Yesus e Nte ' tar lia Galilea de mak kden la hande rala ralamni rapranran pa rreiniana-ra'nana Yesus , yoma la ' ler ululu de e rawok tar lia Yerusalem , la ' a Yahudi lerlalawanni Paska , noma ramkek oleka hare honona maka Yesus Nhi ' nana re .
Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee , where he made the water into wine . There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum . ||| Nhor nioma Yesus Nawal lia ' leta Kana la Galilea , la ' gen miaka Nhi ' oleka gera pa nwal lia anggur turnu de . Mere la ' leta Kapernaum de riy ida mak kla ' ray tniutnu-nhianni-nhielli-liarni ida , maka a'nani ida temni nhi ' a .
When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee , he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son , for he was at the point of death . ||| La'pa natlin nana Yesus Nwatiawua Yudea pa etla ' Galilea dewade nla'awa Yesus pa nwakwak la totpena Yesus Nla ' a Kapernaum totpena Nhi ' a'nani de pa nkalwieda , yoma nhi'pa nmat wia .
Jesus therefore said to him , Unless you see signs and wonders , you will in no way believe . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la mak temni nhi ' de amni niwra , La'pa miy edonna mimkek ma'ta hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona , mak ktutga Uplerlawna rurni-laini pede riy ema rtaplelleltarga , de hota miy edonna mpiesiaya .
The nobleman said to him , Sir , come down before my child dies . ||| Keke'enku ' de amni niwra , Tuna , plet pa itla ' a , yanpa a a'nu nmati .
Jesus said to him , Go your way . Your son lives . The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him , and he went his way . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Hyalia , mlia ' nek wa , o a'namu nkalwied olekwa . Noma riy de npesiay Yesus lirni de pede nla'awa .
As he was going down , his servants met him and reported , saying Your child lives ! ||| La'pa riy de ed ma'ta la talan letgara , dewade riy mak ktulla-kar lia e romni rma rwatroma pa rodia kot la riwra , Tuna a'nani nkalwied olekwa .
So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better . They said therefore to him , Yesterday at the seventh hour , the fever left him . ||| Noma riy de natiana re niwra , Lera emkameni de a a'nu nkalwied wa ? Noma rwahla riwra , Wonyira la ' lera nwawuau ro'onni pukul satu .
So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him , Your son lives . He believed , as did his whole house . ||| Noma keke'en mak temni nhi ' de amni , nwahniorat nana la ' a ler de meman pa ed maka Yesus Nakot la e ' a Niwra , A'namu nkalwied olekwa . Dewade la ler de pa riy de nora romni mniotni honona rpesiay Yesus .
This is again the second sign that Jesus did , having come out of Judea into Galilee . ||| Hade ed maka Yesus Nhi ' hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona mak ktutga Uplerlawna rurni-laini la ' re'eni wornu , la ' a Galilea , la ' ler maka Nwatiawua Yudea pa Nmai die .
After these things , there was a feast of the Jews , and Jesus went up to Jerusalem . ||| La'pa nhorwua noma la'pa nte'ela riy Yahudi lerlalawanni , noma Yesus Nla'awa la ' Yerusalem totpena Namuki-nahepur nohora ler kalwied de la ' hande .
Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate , there is a pool , which is called in Hebrew , Bethesda , having five porches . ||| La ' Yerusalem nhiarni mak ha rweta la Duma Nhiarni , de gera tliwu kolam id etla hande . Ger de , ed maka ha rweta la ' a yawala Ibrani de riwra Betesda . La hande de roma nhieunu teras rumah wolima .
In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick , blind , lame , or paralyzed , waiting for the moving of the water , ||| La hande de riy harahu mak kamehra-kamau , de mak matni kyata , mak limni-lakni kloi , me mak kaliu'uta de nhi'inde e rdudu-rdera . Honona re e rwei ger mak katliw die nwo'la .
for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water . Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had . ||| Yoma la ' lera dom de Orgahi-Orha ' a hopopanni nerun la gera tliw die nanpena nawo'la gerni . Ne la'pa mak kamehra mak kala ' ulu pa kler la gera tliw die , la'pa ger de nwo'la , hota riy nnienni hya ' to ' a mana , nmolu .
A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years . ||| Noma la ' gen die de muanke ' ida e naliu'ut nohora nnienni la ' a anni terampwotelu wehrani wo'awa .
When Jesus saw him lying there , and knew that he had been sick for a long time , he asked him , Do you want to be made well ? ||| Noma la'pa Yesus Namkek nana e nanina , ne Natga de e naliu'ut nohora nnienni la ' a mahnek memna , noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Oi , omuiwra mkialwieda me edonna ?
The sick man answered him , Sir , I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up , but while I 'm coming , another steps down before me . ||| Noma mak kamehra de nwalolla niwra , Amee ! La ' handi de a rimormio'ru hadamonna pa ntitni a lia gera tliw die ralamni totpena liernana ger de wnio'lani . Ne la'pa a ' g e uwrik pa giwra lier la gera tliw de , de ta'en nian meman pa aliernana , yoma rira rala ' ul muamaini a ' u .
Jesus said to him , Arise , take up your mat , and walk . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Emkade de mumat wa pa mpuopna u'tamu pa mula'awa !
Immediately , the man was made well , and took up his mat and walked . Now that day was a Sabbath . ||| Pa mtatan de nekpa nnienni de nmolu . Na'nama npopn u'tani pa nala'awa . La ' ler de ntai miemna la Sabat lerni maka Yahudi re edonna rkar lia de .
So the Jews said to him who was cured , It is the Sabbath . It is not lawful for you to carry the mat . ||| La ' hade pede o'ta-mata makden la Yahudi e rakot la mak nnienni na'nama kalwied de riwra , Oi ! Yana pleta-plet pa mpuopna u'tamu de pa mriana . O e muplinga de ler di de Sabat lerni pa yana riy rkar lia ? !
He answered them , He who made me well said to me , ‘ Take up your mat and walk . ' ||| Noma riy de nwalolla re niwra , Mere riy maka khi ' kalwieda a nnie'nu de , ed mak khopan pa apuopna u'tu pa a'ula'awa .
Then they asked him , Who is the man who said to you , ‘ Take up your mat and walk ' ? ||| He ' ed mak kparan pia khopna omriana o u'tamu pa mula ' a wa ?
But he who was healed did n't know who it was , for Jesus had withdrawn , a crowd being in the place . ||| Mere riy mak kalwied la nnienni de , e naplin niohor ma'ta riy maka khi ' kalwied e ' a nanni . Yoma Yesus edonna Nayamkek olek la ' riy mutlialawna re wa .
Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him , Behold , you are made well . Sin no more , so that nothing worse happens to you . ||| Nhor nioma edon nalo'on wali ne Yesus Nwatrom nan riy della ' Uplerlawna roma kreini na'nama Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Mutlin rerio ! La ' dodo'ondi de omkialwied olekwa . Mere yan memmemna mhi ' do ' a-hal la inonmu . Yanhi'pa hota mlier la yatyatni-halalli yatlorni-yatra'ani pa hota nareh dioin nnienmu mak kala ' ulu die .
The man went away , and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well . ||| Noma riy de la ' meman wa , pa nla nakot nohor harella ' o'ta-mata Yahudi re niwra Yesus nanpena ed mak khi ' e ' pa kalwied la e nnienni-nhienni .
For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him , because he did these things on the Sabbath . ||| Pede Yahudi re o'tani-matni rhi ' yatyatni la Yesus , yoma ratga Yesus Nhi ' kalwieda riy nnienni la ' a ler maka riy Yahudi re yana rkar lia .
But Jesus answered them , My Father is still working , so I am working , too . ||| Mere Yesus Nakot la Yahudi re Niwra , A A'mu e Nkar pia nodi liarni me edonna Nrena . Ne A ' muana emkade wali .
For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him , because he not only broke the Sabbath , but also called God his own Father , making himself equal with God . ||| La'pa Yesus Nakot emkade wa de yeher to ' a pa o'ta-mat Yahudi re riwra rwenna Yesus . Riwra rwenna Yesus , de edonan to'ola Nkar lia Sabat lerni , mere la walia yoma Yesus Niwra Uplerlawan de E Amni . Nnia'eratni de hota Eniwra E ' mana emekwalima Uplerlawna .
Jesus therefore answered them , Most certainly , I tell you , the Son can do nothing of himself , but what he sees the Father doing . For whatever things he does , these the Son also does likewise . ||| Yesus Nakot emkarilla ira niwra , Mpiesiayo ! Hota Uplerlawna A'nani A ' di , de edonna godi plolli pa ghi ' mak Agiwra ghi ' a . La'pa hya ' ed maka Aghi ' a de , de A'umkek nohora A A'mu Nhi ' hare . Yoma la'pa hya ' maka A A'mu Nhi ' a , de hota A ' muana tiolliohora re .
For the Father has affection for the Son , and shows him all things that he himself does . He will show him greater works than these , that you may marvel . ||| Yoma A A'mu Nhi ' kalwied mai A ' u , ne Ntut wualia hya ' to ' mak E Nhi ' reria mai A ' u . Me hota Entut wualia tulla-kniar mak kareh dioin la hihi ' a-yapyap miak kamehi-kayona mak Aghi ' a ri , pa hota yeher to ' pa mpier reria wapmi .
For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life , even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires . ||| Tulla-kniar mak kareh dioin de , de emkadi , de A A'mu de Namoria riy mak kmati ne Nala mormiori-dardiari plalahwa la ira . Ne hota emkade wal lia E A'nani A ' die , de gala mormiori plalahwa la ' he ' to ' a mak Agiwra gala la .
For the Father judges no one , but he has given all judgment to the Son , ||| A A'mu de nek de edonna Ntorna watghudi la rimormiori ida yoma plola-mneha honona de , Enal oleka la E A'nani A ' u .
that all may honor the Son , even as they honor the Father . He who does n't honor the Son does n't honor the Father who sent him . ||| A A'mu de Nhi ' hare honona totpena riy honona ratu rhu'ru-rhelam la A ' pua emekwalima ratu rhu'ru-rhelma la E ' a . Riy mak edonna khu'ru-khelam la A ' u , de hota edonna nhu'ru-nhelam pal lia A A'mu mak khopn A ' pua Amuai .
Most certainly I tell you , he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life , and does n't come into judgment , but has passed out of death into life . ||| A li'ru-tu'nu ri raplola , de la'pa riy mak katu katlina-katailla A li'ru , ne npesiaya A A'mu , mak khopn Amuai , de hota nmormiori plalahwa pa nodi liarni . Hota edonna nlernana niukmu yoma matmiati edon nodi plolli owa'an la e ' a , mere enlernan oleka mormiori plalahwa .
Most certainly I tell you , the hour comes , and now is , when the dead will hear the Son of God 's voice , and those who hear will live . ||| Mpiesiaya ! Hota lerni-melli rwakrian wia me plollolli de ed olek di wa , de riy mak emeknekama rmati olekwa yoma edon rpesiay mia'ta , hota ratlin nana Uplerlawna A'nani A li'ru ne hota mak katlin la re rmormiori .
For as the Father has life in himself , even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself . ||| Yoma A A'mu de mormiori onni-ga'arni inhatta pede Nhi ' walia A ' pua emkade wali , pa Alia ' walia mormiori onni-ga'arni inhatta .
He also gave him authority to execute judgment , because he is a son of man . ||| A A'mu de Nal A ' pua tiorna watghudi la rimormiori wawannu , yoma A ' die de maka ha rweta la Rimormiori A'na A ' u .
Do n't marvel at this , for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice ||| Yana mpier rer wiapmi la A li'ru-tu'nu ri . Hota lerni-melli rmai wia de riy mak kmati oleka re ratlina A li'ru
and will come out , those who have done good , to the resurrection of life , and those who have done evil , to the resurrection of judgment . ||| dewade rlergot la hoini-kietarni ralamni . Ne la'pa riy meni mak khi ' samomuounu de hota ramat pa rmormior pia nodi liarni . Mere la'pa mak khi ' a yatyata-halala hota ramat pa rlernana niukamnu .
I can of myself do nothing . As I hear , I judge , and my judgment is righteous , because I do n't seek my own will , but the will of my Father who sent me . ||| Hya ' to ' maka Aghi ' a de , A ' g edonna liernohora A ralma-rior wamueh ' u . Atioran watghudi de A ' g e liernohor to ' a hya ' maka Uplerlawna Nakota . Ne Agetlia plol toto ' a la tatiaili pniarni me watghudi lokarni , yoma A ' g edonna liernohora a ralma-rior wamueh ' u mere Aliernohora A A'mu , mak khopn A ' u , ralma-riorni .
If I testify about myself , my witness is not valid . ||| Hota la'pa A orgah ' u ukot nohora A inon wamueh ' u , de hota mak ukota re riy id mana edonna npesiaya .
It is another who testifies about me . I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true . ||| Mere la'pa Uplerlawna Enakot nohora A ' u pua rira ratlin nana , de Agatga de maka Nakot nohora la mai A die ha rpesiaya re .
You have sent to John , and he has testified to the truth . ||| Mere miy die mi'enyat wualia riy pa rla ratlin la Yohansi makharani lirni , ne Yohansi ed mak kakot nakot nohor olek A plolo'lu .
But the testimony which I receive is not from man . However , I say these things that you may be saved . ||| Mere mai A ' die , de A ' g edonna wuahaka rimormiori id pa rakot nohora mak Aghi ' a-yapi re , mere A'ukot nohora Yohansi lirni de tiy miy totpena miy er mak katlina , me mpiesiaya de , totpa hota Uplerlawna Namori-nalewan miy .
He was the burning and shining lamp , and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light . ||| Yohanis de emeknekama wa'du mak kmor pia morni nlipa-nka'ma la ' a Uplerlawna talanni mak kaplola , ne miy mieh ' a nek de ralammi kalwieda la mimkeka morni lipni-kailli de la ' ler ho'ke'eni .
But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John , for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish , the very works that I do , testify about me , that the Father has sent me . ||| Mere kniar maka A A'mu Nhopan pa A mua ghi ' ahorga di nareh dioinia Yohansi lirni maka enakot nohora A ' die . Ne kniar die entutga de A A'mu ed mak khopn A ' u .
The Father himself , who sent me , has testified about me . You have neither heard his voice at any time , nor seen his form . ||| Ne A A'mu mak khopna A ' mana Enakot nohora wali A ' u . Miy edonna mitlin ma'ta E lirni onde mimkeka E inonni .
You do n't have his word living in you , because you do n't believe him whom he sent . ||| Lirni-tunnu re mana edonna nawniatierun la miy ihrami ralamni , yoma miy edonna mpiesiay A ' u maka E orgahani Nhopan de .
You search the Scriptures , because you think that in them you have eternal life , and these are they which testify about me . ||| Miy mpial lia ' a-mpial miaiya Puka , yoma miy e miatniekame mhi ' emkade totpena mliernan talan mak kod miy lia mormiori plalahwa pa nodi liarni . Ne Puk de ho'mana e nakot nohor wali A ' u .
Yet you will not come to me , that you may have life . ||| Mere miy edonna mpiakriania A ' u , totpena mliernan mormiori plalahwa de .
I do n't receive glory from men . ||| A ' g edonna wuahaka ya'uli-yawedi la rimormiori nohkerna .
But I know you , that you do n't have God 's love in yourselves . ||| Mere Agat niohora miy . Agatga de mimikleha nhiol kalwied la ' Uplerlawna .
I have come in my Father 's name , and you do n't receive me . If another comes in his own name , you will receive him . ||| Amuai die agodia A A'mu plolli-mneheni , mere la ' hade ho'mana miy edonna mrieiniana A ' u . Mere la'pa riy meheni rmai pia rodia plol wamueheni demade miy miwa mrieiniana .
How can you believe , who receive glory from one another , and you do n't seek the glory that comes from the only God ? ||| La'pa mihak to ' a ya'uli-yawedmi mak kwatiawua mutwualmi , mere miy edonna mihak pa mliernan nan kalwieda la Uplerlawna memeh ' a inhatta , ta'en nian hota mpiesiay wali A ' u .
Do n't think that I will accuse you to the Father . There is one who accuses you , even Moses , on whom you have set your hope . ||| Mere yana mpiarora hota la ' lera id de A ' g ed mak kwaghal miy lia A A'mu gaini ralamni . Mere Musa maka miy mhia'ara aranmi la de , nanpena hota ed mak kwaghal miy .
For if you believed Moses , you would believe me , for he wrote about me . ||| Yoma Mus de nhorat tar wali A lia Puka ralamni . Hade emkade pede la'pa miy mpiesiay Musa lirni-tunnu de hota mpiesiay walia A li'ru-tu'nu .
But if you do n't believe his writings , how will you believe my words ? ||| Mere miy edonna mpiesiaya mak Musa ha nhorat taru re , pede hota emkameni la mpiesiaya A li'ru-tu'nu mak A'ukota ?
After these things , Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee , which is also called the Sea of Tiberias . ||| Noma la ' lera ida de Yesus Nleretia danau Galilea , maka nhi'inde ha rwet walia la danau Tiberias . Yesus Nte'ela danau de walli ,
A great multitude followed him , because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick . ||| ne rirahu rlernohor reria , yoma ramkek lola hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona maka Enhi ' kalwied la riy mak kamehra-kamau totpa Ntutga Uplerlawna rurni-laini .
Jesus went up into the mountain , and he sat there with his disciples . ||| Noma Yesus Nha'at la wo'ora hananni na'nama Nor wutga maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re ramtatan wut lia hande .
Now the Passover , the feast of the Jews , was at hand . ||| La ' ler de , de nhi'pa nte'ela riy Yahudi lerlalawanni maka rweta la Paska .
Jesus therefore , lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him , said to Philip , Where are we to buy bread , that these may eat ? ||| Noma Yesus Nkillia walli-walli to ' de rirahu ema rlidan nan pa rmai wia . Noma Nakot la Pilipsu Niwra , Pilips ee ! Hota itawelia ya'ana-yemun la hanmeni totpena rimormior mutlialawna ri rre'ela ra'ana-remnu ?
He said this to test him , for he himself knew what he would do . ||| Yesus Nat oleka hota hya ' ed maka Niwa Nhi ' a mere Nakot emkade totpena Niwa na Nta'ga Pilipsu .
Philip answered him , Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them , that every one of them may receive a little . ||| Noma Pilipsu nakot la niwra , Ita'ala kupna-kai lia wolla wo'awa gahan memna pa itaweli roti demade itnakutla ho'mana , edonna ntu'tu !
One of his disciples , Andrew , Simon Peter 's brother , said to him , ||| Noma maka Yesus ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a id wali de mak kwawa Andarias , Simon Petrus hyalli , nakot la niwra ,
There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish , but what are these among so many ? ||| Tuna , mai handi de tuwari id enodia roti meha wolima , me i'na woru . Mere hare ho'mana edonna ntu'tu la riy mutlialawna re !
Jesus said , Have the people sit down . Now there was much grass in that place . So the men sat down , in number about five thousand . ||| Noma Yesus Niwra , Mikot la hare honona pa ramtatna . Yoma la ' gen die de wewna kpauga harahu , pede rirahu rakperna la wewna wawannu . Rhor rrekan nana muanke ' a honona mak kden la hande de edonna nhal de a'na muanke ' a riy riwnu wolima , mere edon rhor wutga patke ' a rora upni-a'nani .
Jesus took the loaves , and having given thanks , he distributed to the disciples , and the disciples to those who were sitting down , likewise also of the fish as much as they desired . ||| Noma Yesus Na'ala rot die na'nama Na'uli-nawedia Uplerlawna , na'nama nhawi-nhawia rot diella ' riy mutlialawna re , na'nama Nal owa'an la i'n de pa nhakre'era la riy rahu re . Riy honona re ra'an pa rlernohora ir sukni .
When they were filled , he said to his disciples , Gather up the broken pieces which are left over , that nothing be lost . ||| La'pa ra'an pa rpeher wa na'nama Yesus Nakot la maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re Niwra , Miwoka ya'ana-yemnu maka ha ra'ana atre ' a re , yanpa rhi ' a la gera niaini .
So they gathered them up , and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves , which were left over by those who had eaten . ||| La'pa rawok nana roti mak ha ra'an atre ' a re de rlernana kriou termida wehrani woru .
When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did , they said , This is truly the prophet who comes into the world . ||| La'pa riy mutlialawna re ramkek tutga Yesus hihi'ini-yapyapni mak kamehi-kayona , mak ktutga Uplerlawna rurni-laini de , noma riwra , Plola hadi de Makwohorulu-ktatrulu ida maka Uplerlawna Nano'taru !
Jesus therefore , perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king , withdrew again to the mountain by himself . ||| Yesus Nat niohora iriwra rmai pia rtekua E ' pa Nla ' Ray lia ira , pede Yesus Nwatitin pa Nla'awa wo'ora hananni pa Nmemeh ' taru lia ' hande .
When evening came , his disciples went down to the sea . ||| La'pa lera niwa nmel wa , noma maka Yesus ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re rerun la danau de .
They entered into the boat , and were going over the sea to Capernaum . It was now dark , and Jesus had not come to them . ||| Pa la'pa rha'at la puounu pa rleretia danau de pa rokria leta Kapernaum . Lera ntuinia wa , mere Yesus edonna Nden ma'ta la ira .
The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing . ||| Edon nalo'on wali ne danau de nayo'ora yoma anin lawna nteni .
When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia , they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat , and they were afraid . ||| La'pa rhopal pa olietni edonna nhal de kilu wolima onde wonema , pa rler la danau de letgarni dewade ramkek de Yesus Nma Nharan nana ir puounu de Nlola tah ' i ulti wawannu . Honona ramta'at wenna .
But he said to them , It is I . Do n't be afraid . ||| Mere Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , Ee ! Yan mimta'ata ! A ' g eda di !
They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat . Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going . ||| Noma rahepur pa rreiniana Yesus pa ror wutga la puou noma plin-plinnianama ira puounu de nton la leta maka rharan reria pnialgenni .
On the next day , the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there , except the one in which his disciples had embarked , and that Jesus had n't entered with his disciples into the boat , but his disciples had gone away alone . ||| La'pa repar wa dewade riy harahu mak kden ma'ta la danau walli de rma rwahaka Yesus yoma e rat niohora la ' a wonyir de puou ida nmeh ' a napnial lia hande . Ne ir ratga de maka Yesus ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re er mak kodia puou die , mere Yesus edon Ndella puou die wawannu pa hota emkade de Yesus etla meni ?
However , boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks . ||| Nhor nioma riy dom rodi puou rwatiawua leta Tiberias pa rma rapniali de edon olieta la gen miaka wonyir de Itmatromni Yesus Na'uli-nawedia Uplerlawna nhor diewade Nal roti la riy mutlialawna re ra'ana .
When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus was n't there , nor his disciples , they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum , seeking Jesus . ||| La'pa riy mutlialawna re ramkek de Yesus Nora maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re edonna rdella gen die , noma ir mana rha'at wal lia riy mak kwatiawua leta Tiberias puounu re pa rleretia danau de pa rla rahaka Yesus la leta Kapernaum .
When they found him on the other side of the sea , they asked him , Rabbi , when did you come here ? ||| La'pa irwatrom nana Yesus la ' a danau walli noma rakot la Yesus riwra , Am Tungkurga , mowenia omtie'ela handina ?
Jesus answered them , Most certainly I tell you , you seek me , not because you saw signs , but because you ate of the loaves and were filled . ||| Mere Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Toto ' a ne , miy mihak A ' die de edonna riwra yoma miy mnia'erit nana hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona mak ktutga Uplerlawna rurni-laini maka Aghi ' a re , mere mpiahak A ' die yoma mhiorat la ya'ana-yemnu mak kapeher miy .
Do n't work for the food which perishes , but for the food which remains to eternal life , which the Son of Man will give to you . For God the Father has sealed him . ||| Mere yana mipepe'el pa mpiahak to ' a yamanan maka plet pa nhor pua ngehpa . Mipepe'el pa mihaka ya'ana-yemnia mak edonna kgehpa , mak kodia mormiori-dardiar pa nodi liarni . Yamanan de , hota Rimormiori A'nani A ' die , de ed mak kal hade tiy miy . A A'mu Uplerlawna ed mak kala plola-mneha mai A ' u pa Aghi ' hade .
They said therefore to him , What must we do , that we may work the works of God ? ||| Noma rakot la Yesus riwra , Hota amhi ' a hya ' totpena nla ' nana Uplerlawna ralma-riorni ?
Jesus answered them , This is the work of God , that you believe in him whom he has sent . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Hadi ed mak Uplerlawna Nwahaka tiy miy , de totpena mpiesiay tioto ' memna A ' u maka Uplerlawna Nhopn Amuai die !
They said therefore to him , What then do you do for a sign , that we may see and believe you ? What work do you do ? ||| Noma riwra , La ' hade emkade de hota O ' nek de Mhi ' hya ' a pa amamkeka totpena ampesiay O ' a ?
Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness . As it is written , ‘ He gave them bread out of heaven to eat . ' ||| A up mamni-tgar mamni ra'ana yamanna maka ha rweta la manna , la ' a wo'orletna-kawurloini . E rhorat tar muemna la ' a hade la ' Puka ralamni riwra , Enala yamanan mak kwatiawua Ilyamou-Watyatoha pa ira'ana .
Jesus therefore said to them , Most certainly , I tell you , it was n't Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven , but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la ira Niwra , Mpiesiaya ! Musa edonna nala yamanan de , mere A A'mu . Ne E ' wal pia ed mak kala Yamanna inhatti mak kwatiawua Ilyamou-Watyatoha tiy miy .
For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world . ||| Yoma Yamanna inhatta maka Uplerlawna Nal de , ed mak kwatiawua Ilyamou-Watyatoha de , ne Nerun totpa Nodia mormiori-dardiari plalahwa la mak kden la nohkerna wawannu .
They said therefore to him , Lord , always give us this bread . ||| Rakot la , Tuna , demade Mual mamain neka yamanan de mai am pia !
Jesus said to them , I am the bread of life . Whoever comes to me will not be hungry , and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , A ' di de Yamanan de mak kodia mormiori-dardiari pa nodi liarni . Riy mak kmai A ' die de edonna rlernan yaplara pa nodi liarni . Ne mak kpesiay A ' die , hota tiernu edonna nkerna pa nodi liarni .
But I told you that you have seen me , and yet you do n't believe . ||| Mere emeknekama A'ukot oleka tiy miy wia , de miy e mimkek olek A ' u ho'mana miy edonna mpiesiaya .
All those whom the Father gives me will come to me . He who comes to me I will in no way throw out . ||| Mere riy honona mak A A'mu Nala mai A ' u , de hota plol toto ' pa rmai A ' die . Ne hota A ' g edonna wuayotlia riy meni to ' a mak kiwra kmai A ' die .
For I have come down from heaven , not to do my own will , but the will of him who sent me . ||| Yoma A ' di de Awuatiawua Ilyamou-Watyatoha pa Agernu de A ' g edonna ghi ' hadom de Agodia A ralma-rior wamueh ' u . Mere Aliernohora Mak khopna A ' die ralma-riorni .
This is the will of my Father who sent me , that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing , but should raise him up at the last day . ||| Ne Mak khopn A ' die wniarorni , de totpena riy honona maka Nala mai A ' die , id mana hota edonna nler la matmiati-molmuolu pa nodi liarni , mere totpena A ' g ed mak kamori owa'an ir la ' a lera-mela noha niatni .
This is the will of the one who sent me , that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life , and I will raise him up at the last day . ||| Yoma hota plola la ' A'mu ralamni Nwahaka totpena la riy meni ed mak kna'erit nana A ' die E A'nani A ' u , me npesiaya , de hota nlernan mormiori-dardiari plalahwa ne hota A ' g ed maka kamori owa'an e ' la ' a ler noha niatni .
The Jews therefore murmured concerning him , because he said , I am the bread which came down out of heaven . ||| Dewade riy Yahudi kukunu-mamatia la Yesus yoma lirni Niwra , A ' die Yamanan mak kwatiawua Ilyamou-Watyatoha pa Agernu .
They said , Is n't this Jesus , the son of Joseph , whose father and mother we know ? How then does he say , ‘ I have come down out of heaven ' ? ||| Pa idma nakot la ida riwra , Hota hadi de Yesus maka Yusup a'nani inhatta toh ? ! Inni-amni de itatga , ne hya ' nariei pia Eniwra Enwatiawua Ilyamou-Watyatoha pa Nernu ? !
Therefore Jesus answered them , Do n't murmur among yourselves . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Yana kukunu-mamatmi !
No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him , and I will raise him up in the last day . ||| Riy id mana hota edonna nmai A ' die la'pa A A'mu mak khopna Amuai edonna Nottiar hadella mai A ' u . Ne la'pa he ' ed mak kmai die hota A ' g ed mak kamoria hadella ' lera noha niatni .
It is written in the prophets , ‘ They will all be taught by God . ' Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned , comes to me . ||| Etla la Puka makwohorulu-ktatrulu lirni de e niwra , Uplerlawna hota Nwatutu-nwaye ' a ir honona . Ne riy honona maka A A'mu Nwatutu-nwaye ' a me iratlina-ratailla E lirni de hota rmai wiali A ' die .
Not that anyone has seen the Father , except he who is from God . He has seen the Father . ||| Mere wniatut die edonna ntutga riy de namkek oleka Uplerlawna . Eneknek to'ama A ' u mak kwatiawu Uplerlawan de ed mak kamkek oleka A A'mu de wa .
Most certainly , I tell you , he who believes in me has eternal life . ||| Mpiesiayo ! Riy makpesiay A ' die ed mak klernana mormiori plalahwa pa nodi liarni .
I am the bread of life . ||| A ' di de Yamanan mak kodia mormiori .
Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died . ||| Miy upmi-tgarmi ra'ana yamanna maka rweta la manna la ' a wo'orletna-kawurloini , mere emkade ho'mana rmat wiali .
This is the bread which comes down out of heaven , that anyone may eat of it and not die . ||| Mere la ' miy gaimi ralamni de Yamanan mak kwatiawua Ilyamou-Watyatoha inhatta eda di , ne he ' na'ana hade de hota edonna nmati .
I am the living bread which came down out of heaven . If anyone eats of this bread , he will live forever . Yes , the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh . ||| A ' di de Yamanan maka kwatiawua Ilyamou-Watyatoha , Yamanan mak kodia mormiori inhatta . Riy meni mak ka'an nana Yamanan di , de hota nmormiori plalahwa pa nodi liarni . Yamanan mak A'ukota di de A ih ' u-ra'ru inhatti , mak hota Agala la rimormiori nohkeran di rerieini totpa hota rlernana mormiori-dardiari .
The Jews therefore contended with one another , saying , How can this man give us his flesh to eat ? ||| La'pa ratlin tutga lir de , dewade riy Yahudi re idma nahuri-nawo'or la id wa . Pa idma nakot la ida riwra , Hota emkameni la riy di Nala ihini-rarni de pa ita'ana ?
Jesus therefore said to them , Most certainly I tell you , unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood , you do n't have life in yourselves . ||| Noma Yesus Niwra , Pena mpiesiayo , la'pa miy edonna mi'ina Rimormiori A'na A ' die A ih ' u , ne miemn A ra'ru , de hota miy edonna mliernana mormiori plalahwa .
He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life , and I will raise him up at the last day . ||| Riy mak ka'ana A ih ' u me kemnia A ra'ru de hota nlernan mormiori plalahwa , ne A ' g ed mak kamoria la ' a lera noha niatni .
For my flesh is food indeed , and my blood is drink indeed . ||| Yoma a ih'ru-ra'ru de ya'ana-yemnu toto ' memna .
He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me , and I in him . ||| Riy mak ka'ana A ih ' u me kemni A ra'ru , de hota nor A die ihru ida-ralm ida .
As the living Father sent me , and I live because of the Father , so he who feeds on me will also live because of me . ||| A A'mu mak mormiori onni-ga'arni inhatta , hade ed mak khopna A ' u , ne A ' muana Amuori onnila E ' a . Emkade wal lia riy mak ka'ana A ih ' u me kemni A ra'ru , de hota Agala mormiori-dardiari plalahwa la ira .
This is the bread which came down out of heaven-not as our fathers ate the manna and died . He who eats this bread will live forever . ||| A ' die , de ed makla ' Yamanan mak kwatiawua Ilyamou-Watyatoha , mak ematia ' a yamanan manna maka upmi-tgarmi ha ra'ana re . Yoma la'pa ra'an nana ir yamananni de ho'mana , rmat wiali . Mere riy mak ka'an Yamanan di de hota nmormior plalahwa pa nodi liarni .
He said these things in the synagogue , as he taught in Capernaum . ||| Hare honona de Yesus Nwatutu-nwaye ' a momuoga , la ' a gen miaka Yahudi re rhi ' kreini-iskolli la ' leta Kapernaum .
Therefore many of his disciples , when they heard this , said , This is a hard saying ! Who can listen to it ? ||| La'pa ratlin nana Yesus lirni-tunnu re noma mak klernohor reri Yesus re harahu idma nakot la ida riwra , Wniatutu-wniaye ' di werat rehia ! Hota he ' ed maka kreiniana wniatutu rina ?
