Yet no one arrested him , because his hour had not yet come . ||| Yesus Nwatut niohora hare honona de la ' a kah kupan genni onni la ' a Uplerlawna roma kreini . Mere la ' riy id mana edonna ntorna Yesus yoma edonna nte ' ma'ta la lerni-melli .
Jesus said therefore again to them , I am going away , and you will seek me , and you will die in your sins . Where I go , you ca n't come . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot owa'an la ' ira , Hota Alia'awa , ne mihaka A ' u ho'mana hota miy edonna mliernana A ge'nu , mere hota mmiat lia do'omi-halmi ralamni .
The Jews therefore said , Will he kill himself , because he says , ‘ Where I am going , you ca n't come ' ? ||| Pede makla ' a o'ta-mat la Yahudi idma ratian ida , Yanpa Ha Niwra Nwen inonni yoma Eniwra la ' a gen miaka Enla ' de it edonna tlernohora .
He said to them , You are from beneath . I am from above . You are of this world . I am not of this world . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot owa'an la ira Niwra , Mimpiatiaw yawa , de la ' a nohkeran di wawannu . Mere A ' die edonna . Awuatiawua heyanna .
I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins , for unless you believe that I am he , you will die in your sins . ||| La ' hade pede A'ukot olek tiy miy , hota miy mmiat lia do'omi-halmi ralamni . Yoma la'pa miy edonna mpiesiay A ' die E ' inhatta maka A'ukot oleka tiy miy , hota plol toto ' a pa mmiat lia do'omi-halmi ralamni .
They said therefore to him , Who are you ? Jesus said to them , Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning . ||| Noma ratiana Yesus riwra , Hota plollolli de he ' O ' a ? Noma Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , A ' g ed maka nhi'inde A'ukot oleka tiy miy wia !
I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you . However , he who sent me is true , and the things which I heard from him , these I say to the world . ||| Harahu maka Agiwra ukota tiy miy totpa Agetlia halmi re . Mere hota A ' g edon liernohora A ralma-rior wamueh ' u . Mak khopan pa Amuai die lirni-tunnu ed maka kden la plol wawna . Ne A'ukot nohora la ' a nohkerna mniotni re , la ' a hya ' mak A'utlin nana la E ' a .
They did n't understand that he spoke to them about the Father . ||| Makden Yahudi re raplin niohora ma'ta E yaltierni della ira , de Enakot nohora Amni Uplerlawna .
Jesus therefore said to them , When you have lifted up the Son of Man , then you will know that I am he , and I do nothing of myself , but as my Father taught me , I say these things . ||| La hade pede Yesus Nakot la ira , Niwra , Hota la ' miy er mak kariei piede Rimormiori A'na A ' die urian la heyanna . Ne la ' ler de nanpena miatga de A ' g inhatta , maka ukot olek tiy miy , ne hota miat wualia de hya ' mak Aghi ' a re , de A ralma-rior wamueh ' u atia ' a . Hya ' maka ukota re de A A'mu e Nwatut niana noma Aliernohora .
He who sent me is with me . The Father has n't left me alone , for I always do the things that are pleasing to him . ||| Ne E ' ed mak khopn A ' u . E edonna Naltarga Amueh ' a mere Nor A ' tialla yoma nhi'inde Aliernohora E ralma-riorni .
As he spoke these things , many believed in him . ||| La'pa Yesus Nakot hare honona de nek de rirahu rpesiaya .
Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him , If you remain in my word , then you are truly my disciples . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la riy Yahudi mak kpesiay E ' a re Niwra , La'pa mliernohor reria A wniatu'tu-wniaye ' u , de hota plol toto ' pa mpiali olek la maklernohor reri A ' u inhatta .
You will know the truth , and the truth will make you free . ||| Ne la'pa emkade de hota miat niohor hya ' ed mak kaplola pa narieiniande rwe'er doin miy lia wutwutu-kokgohomi .
They answered him , We are Abraham 's offspring , and have never been in bondage to anyone . How do you say , ‘ You will be made free ' ? ||| Noma rakot la Yesus riwra , Am di de Abraham duratni ami . La ' ululu meman pa la'pa ntutu-nte'ela dodo'ondi , de riy edonna rodi plolli mai ami ! Pa hota emkameni pa Omukota Miwra hota rwe'er doin am lia wutwutu-kokgoh mamni ?
Jesus answered them , Most certainly I tell you , everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin . ||| Noma Yesus Nwahla Niwra , Plola la ' a A li'ru ri . La'pa riy mak khi ' do ' a-kyap hiala de nwal lia do ' a-hala atni-wa'arni .
A bondservant does n't live in the house forever . A son remains forever . ||| Pede mak khi ' do ' a-kyap hiala ida de emeknekama ata-wa'ara ida mak kakleha gen temtemna . Mere la'pa nwal lia a'na raralma ida , de namtemteman la genni pa nodi liarni .
If therefore the Son makes you free , you will be free indeed . ||| La hade pede la'pa Uplerlawna A'nani A ' die Awue'er doin olek miy lia do ' a-hala , de hota toto ' meman pa rwe'er doin olek miy wia .
I know that you are Abraham 's offspring , yet you seek to kill me , because my word finds no place in you . ||| Plola , Agat niohora miy di de Abrahama duratni-waitni . Mere miy miwra mpien A ' u , yoma mihmena mrieiniana A wniatu'tu-wniaye ' u .
I say the things which I have seen with my Father , and you also do the things which you have seen with your father . ||| Hya ' maka A'umkeka la A A'mu , de hade ed mak A'ukota . Mere miy di de mliernana wniatutu-wniaye ' a la miy ammi .
They answered him , Our father is Abraham . Jesus said to them , If you were Abraham 's children , you would do the works of Abraham . ||| Noma rwahla Yesus lirni riwra , A am mamni de Abrahama . Mere Yesus Nwahla , La'pa miy ammi toto ' a Abraham , de hota mtiolliohora hya ' maka Abraham ha nhi ' a .
But now you seek to kill me , a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God . Abraham did n't do this . ||| Mere A'uno ' miy lia hya ' mak kaplola maka A'utlina la Uplerlawna , mere miy miwra mpien A ' u . Abraham edonna nhi ' mak emkare .
You do the works of your father . They said to him , We were not born of sexual immorality . We have one Father , God . ||| Mere miy nhiolmi-lietmi hihi'imi-yapyapmi rlernohora miy ammi dom to ' a . Noma rwahla Yesus lirni riwra , Am di de a'na let atia ' ami . A am mamni de Uplerlawna Nmeh ' a .
Therefore Jesus said to them , If God were your father , you would love me , for I came out and have come from God . For I have n't come of myself , but he sent me . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la re , La'pa plola la miy ammi Uplerlawna , de hota miy mhi ' kalwiedwed A ' u yoma A ' di de Awuatiawu E ' a . A ' g edonna godia A ralma-rior wamueh ' u pa Amuai . Mere E ' ed maka khopan pa Amuai .
Why do n't you understand my speech ? Because you ca n't hear my word . ||| Hya ' a nariei piede miy edonna mnia'erit nana A'ukotkota ? Yoma mihmena mrieiniana A wniatu'tu-wniaye ' u .
You are of your father the devil , and you want to do the desires of your father . He was a murderer from the beginning , and does n't stand in the truth , because there is no truth in him . When he speaks a lie , he speaks on his own , for he is a liar , and the father of lies . ||| Miy ammi de hegana amlawanni , ne hota mliernohora ha ralma-riorni . Yoma hegan de yehwani de la ' ululu meman pa ntutu-nte'ela lera-mela ri , nwunu-nwenan mamaini . Ne la ' walia Enputra-npalka , na'ohpa-nalahara yoma edon nden etia la plol wawna . Ohpa-lahara re honona rwatiawua e ' a pede la'pa ena'ohpa-nalahara de nlernohor neka e yehwa wamueheni inhatta .
But because I tell the truth , you do n't believe me . ||| Mere A ' di de ukot nohora mak kaplola , hade pede miy edonna mpiesiay A ' u .
Which of you convicts me of sin ? If I tell the truth , why do you not believe me ? ||| La ' miy hononmi de riy id mana ta'en niana nakot nohor A do ' a-ha'lu . Ne la'pa A'ukot nohora mak kaplola , de hya ' nrei piede miy edonna mpiesiay A ' u ?
He who is of God hears the words of God . For this cause you do n't hear , because you are not of God . ||| Riy mak kwatiawua Uplerlawna , de natlin la Uplerlawna lirni-tunnu . Mere miy di de edonna mpiatiawua Uplerlawna pede mihmena mitlina-mitailla .
Then the Jews answered him , Do n't we say well that you are a Samaritan , and have a demon ? ||| Noma riy Yahudi re rakot la Yesus riwra , Hoi ! Maka amakot oleka de O ' de makdena Samaria id O ' a , ne hegana e nhu'ru ralm O ' a , a lir mamni re naplollola !
Jesus answered , I do n't have a demon , but I honor my Father and you dishonor me . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , Hegana edonna rhu'ru ralm A ' u . Mere A ' g ghu'ru-ghelam la A A'mu mere miy e mipolu-miliell A ' u .
But I do n't seek my own glory . There is one who seeks and judges . ||| A ' g edonna uhaka riy pa ra'uli-rawedi A ' u . Mere Riy id ed ma'ta la mak kwahak pa ra'uli-rawedi A ' u , ne E ' ed mak ktorna watghudi .
Most certainly , I tell you , if a person keeps my word , he will never see death . ||| A li'ru ri plola , de la'pa riy mak katlin mai A ' u , de hota edonna nmati ne nmormior pia nodi liarni !
Then the Jews said to him , Now we know that you have a demon . Abraham died , as did the prophets , and you say , ‘ If a man keeps my word , he will never taste of death . ' ||| Noma riy Yahudi re rakot la Yesus riwra , Ami e matlina O lirmu ri la ' dodo'ondi , de amatga de plol toto ' a la hegana e nhu'ru ralm O ' a . Abraham nek de nmati , emkade walia makwohorulu-ktatrulu re honona . Mere O lirmu niwra riy mak klernohora O lirmu , de hota edonna nmati .
Are you greater than our father Abraham , who died ? The prophets died . Who do you make yourself out to be ? ||| La'pa Abrahama , nek de nmati olekwa , ne makwohorulu-ktatrulu mana rmati olekwa , ne hota hya ' owa'an O ' a ? Ah , O ' di de taken niana inponmu narehia a am mamni Abrahama !
Jesus answered , If I glorify myself , my glory is nothing . It is my Father who glorifies me , of whom you say that he is our God . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , La'pa A orgah ' u uhaka riy rhu'ru-rhelm A ' u de hota nhiu'ru-nhielam de nakleh weli . Mere A A'mu maka miy miwra miy Uplerlawanmi nek de ed mak kwak pa rimormiori rhu'ru-rhelm A ' u .
You have not known him , but I know him . If I said , ‘ I do n't know him , ' I would be like you , a liar . But I know him and keep his word . ||| Mere plollolli de miy niek de edonna miatga E ' a . Mere A ' di nanpena ed mak kat niohora E ' a . La'pa Agiwra A ' g edonna gatg E ' a , nnia'eratni A ' g ulahara , pa emekwali miy e mhi ' nana . Mere plollolli de Agat niohora memna E ' a me Aliernohora E lirni-tunnu .
Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day . He saw it and was glad . ||| Ne la ' walia miy ammi Abraham niwra namkek memna A le'ru-me'lu me ralamni nahepuepur nohora . Meman neka de enamkek oleka A ' wua ne ralamni kalwieda !
The Jews therefore said to him , You are not yet fifty years old ! Have you seen Abraham ? ||| Noma riy Yahudi rakot la Yesus riwra , Omhuol niana nohkerna wawannu de edonna nla ' ma'ta anni terampwolima , ne omumkek oleka Abrahama ? !
Jesus said to them , Most certainly , I tell you , before Abraham came into existence , I AM . ||| Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , Plola la A li'ru ri . La ' ler Abraham inni edonna ntor ma'ta Abrahama la nohkerna wawannu di de A ' inhatti A ' g ed olek la wa .
Therefore they took up stones to throw at him , but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple , having gone through the middle of them , and so passed by . ||| Dewade riy Yahudi re ra'ala watu pa riwra ra rwa'ala yoma la ' E lirni emkade de emeknekama Niwra Uplerlawna E ' a , mere Yesus Nade ' a pa Nhoitio'or la Uplerlawna roma kreini pa Nla'awa .
As he passed by , he saw a man blind from birth . ||| La'pa Yesus Nalala ' reri ne Namkek nana muanke ' ida mak matni kyat meman la apun ralma .
His disciples asked him , Rabbi , who sinned , this man or his parents , that he was born blind ? ||| Noma maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re ratiana riwra , Tungkurga , nihya'pa ha inni ntor hade de matni niat memna ? Yanpa e do'oni-halli onde inni-amni do'oni-halli ?
Jesus answered , This man did n't sin , nor did his parents , but that the works of God might be revealed in him . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , Ha matni niat de , ha do'oni-halli edon nariei , onde inni-amni do'oni-halli , mere hade emkade totpena riy ramkek memna Uplerlawna plolli-mneheni la e inonni .
I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day . The night is coming , when no one can work . ||| La'pa Amuormior mia'ta , de emeknekama lera ed ma'ta pa it tkarkiar reria Mak khopn A ' die kniarni . Yoma hota mela nma ndamt ita , pa nhi'nande riy id mana edonna nkari .
While I am in the world , I am the light of the world . ||| Pa la'pa A ' g e muormior mia'ta la nohkeran di wawannu , de Aghi ' hitita-reprepar la noh di wawannu .
When he had said this , he spat on the ground , made mud with the saliva , anointed the blind man 's eyes with the mud , ||| La'pa Nakot emkade noma Nakrui lia tani , na'nama Nkoiri-nwalia pa Noha la riy de matni .
and said to him , Go , wash in the pool of Siloam which means Sent . So he went away , washed , and came back seeing . ||| Noma Nakot la riy de Niwra , Mlia ' pa mura'ru la gera tliwu kolam Siloam . Yoma Siloam de nnia'eratni de Mak Ha Nhopan pa Nmai . Pede riy de la'pa nararga gaini . Noma nawal lia romni de matni namkek olek wa .
Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said , Is n't this he who sat and begged ? ||| Noma e rom heiwialli re rora riy mak nhi'inde ramkek nande nmeh ' a nawakwaka re riwra , Yanpa hade ed mak nhi'inde kawiatur targa pa nmeh ' a nawakwak dena ?
Others were saying , It is he . Still others were saying , He looks like him . He said , I am he . ||| Ne la ' dom de riwra , Riy de inhatta . Mere la ' dom de riwra , Hade edonna . Mere gaini nhi'pa ramneh wa . Mere orgahani niwra , A ' g inhatta !
They therefore were asking him , How were your eyes opened ? ||| La ' emkameni pede o matmu de namkeka ?
He answered , A man called Jesus made mud , anointed my eyes , and said to me , ‘ Go to the pool of Siloam and wash. ' So I went away and washed , and I received sight . ||| Noma nakot la re niwra , Riy maka nanni Yesus de ed mak Nkoiri-nwalia tani pa noha la ma'tu na'nama Nhopan pa a lia urarga a ga'yu la gera tliwu Siloam . Noma alia'awa pa a'urarga a ga'yu pa a ma'tu naphyar wia .
Then they asked him , Where is he ? He said , I do n't know . ||| Noma ratiana riwra , Riy de etla meni ? Noma nwalolla niwra , A'uplinga .
They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees . It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes . ||| La ' ler maka Yesus Nala kruini na Nawoh ' a tani pa Nhi ' kalwieda riy mak matni kyat de , ntai mdududga Sabat lerni maka Yahudi re yana rkar lia de . Dewade irodia riy mak dodo'ona matni kyat de la riy Parisi .
Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight . He said to them , He put mud on my eyes , I washed , and I see . ||| La ' noma Parisi re ratian nohora mak matni kalwied olek de riwra , La'pa emkameni pede o matmu naphyar wia ? Noma nwalolla niwra , Riy ida Na'ala tani mak Nkoiri-nwal die na'nama Noha la ma'tu me nhor nioma a lia urar dioinia a ga'yu dewade a ma'tu ramkek meman wa .
Some therefore of the Pharisees said , This man is not from God , because he does n't keep the Sabbath . Others said , How can a man who is a sinner do such signs ? So there was division among them . ||| Mere riy Parisi re dom riwra , Mak khi ' kalwieda ha matni di , hade edonna Nwatiawua Uplerlawna yoma edonna Nhu'ru-nhelma la ' a Sabat lerni . Mere dom de riwra , Mere taken niana riy mak khi ' do ' a-hala rhi ' a-ryapia hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona mak ktutga Uplerlawna rurni-laini , mak emkade ! Noma honona re hururi-wowo'ora .
Therefore they asked the blind man again , What do you say about him , because he opened your eyes ? He said , He is a prophet . ||| Noma riy Parisi re ratian owa'ana riy de riwra , O ' nek de ed mak kler la kalwiedni . Pede mukot teka , hota emkameni la o wniarormu la riy mak khi ' o matmu pa kalwied dena ? Noma niwra , Agatga de makwohorulu-ktatrulu id hade .
The Jews therefore did n't believe concerning him , that he had been blind and had received his sight , until they called the parents of him who had received his sight , ||| Mere makhi ' a o'ta-mat la Yahudi re rahmena rpesiaya de ululu de riy de matni niata mere dodo'ondi de namkek olekwa . La ' hade pede la'pa rhopan pa rla rpolga riy de inni-amni .
and asked them , Is this your son , whom you say was born blind ? How then does he now see ? ||| Noma ratian nohora , Plola a'nami di de mak miwra ha nmor niohora mat yatni ? Ne emkameni pede dodo'ondi de matni nkalwied wa ?
His parents answered them , We know that this is our son , and that he was born blind , ||| Noma inni-amni riwra , Plola a a'na mamni hadi , ne ha matni niat la ' a apun ralam memna .
but how he now sees , we do n't know , or who opened his eyes , we do n't know . He is of age . Ask him . He will speak for himself . ||| Mere la ' a hya ' a nrei piede dodo'ondi de matni nkalwied wa , ami e maplinga . Ne he ' ed mak khi ' kalwieda ha matni pa namkek wa , hade nek de ami e maplinga . Mitian neka e orgahi wa . Ha tuwnu nkern olekwa pa hota orgahi pen neka nwahauria .
His parents said these things because they feared the Jews , for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ , he would be put out of the synagogue . ||| Inni-amni rakot emkade yoma ratga de he ' to ' a maka kwayow nohora Yesus Niwra Yesus de Ray Makamori-Kalewna , hota Yahudi o'tani-matni rlarn ir pa rler owa'an la roma-lewu miaka nhi'inde Yahudi rhi ' kreini-iskolli .
Therefore his parents said , He is of age . Ask him . ||| La ' hade pede riy de inni-amni riwra , Ha nlawn olekwa pa mitian nek orgahi wa .
So they called the man who was blind a second time , and said to him , Give glory to God . We know that this man is a sinner . ||| Noma rpolg owa'ana riy maka dodo'ona matni kyat de pa ratian owa'ana riwra , Mliokar memna , totpena yana mulahara , yoma amatga mak kaphyaria o matmu de , mak khi ' do ' a-hala hade .
He therefore answered , I do n't know if he is a sinner . One thing I do know , that though I was blind , now I see . ||| Ha Nhi ' a do ' a-hala me edonna , de a'uplinga . Mere maka agatga de , de ululu de a ma'tu yata mere dodo'ondi de a ' g e umkek olekwa !
They said to him again , What did he do to you ? How did he open your eyes ? ||| Noma rakot owa'an la riwra , Enhi ' a hya ' tiy o ' a pede o matmu re raphyari ?
He answered them , I told you already , and you did n't listen . Why do you want to hear it again ? You do n't also want to become his disciples , do you ? ||| Noma riy de nakot la re niwra , A'ukot oleka honona tiy miy wia mere mihmena mitlina . Hya ' nariei pia miwra mitlin owa'ana ? Yanpa miwra mliernohor wali E ' a ?
They insulted him and said , You are his disciple , but we are disciples of Moses . ||| Dewade honona rapolu-raliella riy de pa rakot la , Hoi ! O ' ed mak klernohora E ' a . Am die edonna . Amlernohor to ' Musa .
We know that God has spoken to Moses . But as for this man , we do n't know where he comes from . ||| Amatga de Uplerlawna Naltieri olek la Mus wa . Mere la riy de , ami e maplin niohora Ha Nwatiawu meni pa Nmai !
The man answered them , How amazing ! You do n't know where he comes from , yet he opened my eyes . ||| Noma riy de nakot la re , Ah ! A ' g edon nia'erit nan miy ralma-riormi ! Yoma plollolli de mimkek oleka Enhi ' a ma'tu pa rkalwieda mere mitian nohor ma'ta Ha Nwatiawu hameni pa Nmai ? !
We know that God does n't listen to sinners , but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will , he listens to him . ||| Itatga de Uplerlawna edonna ntail nohora mak khi ' do ' a-hala , eneknek to'ama riy mak khu'ru-khelam la Uplerlawna pa nlernohora E ralma-riorni .
Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind . ||| La ' ululu ma'ta la ' noha knieranni , de edonna ratlin ma'ta riy maka matni kyat la apun ralma de riy rhi ' a pa nkalwieda .
If this man were not from God , he could do nothing . ||| La'pa riy de edonna Nwatiawu Uplerlawna , de taken niana Nhi ' hare honona .
They answered him , You were altogether born in sins , and do you teach us ? Then they threw him out . ||| Noma Parisi riwra , O ' di de mak penpuen lia do ' a-hala la ' lera inmu ha nayoria o ' de , pa hota emkameni pa omuiwra mpuatutg ami ? ! Dewade la ' ler de meman pa rlarna e ' pa yana nmai owa'an la gen miaka Yahudi re rhi ' kreini-iskolli .
Jesus heard that they had thrown him out , and finding him , he said , Do you believe in the Son of God ? ||| La'pa Yesus Natlin nande rlarn oleka riy della gen miaka Yahudi re rhi ' kreini-iskolli . Noma Yesus Nwahaka riy de pa Nakot la Niwra , O e mpuesiaya Rimormiori A'nani de me edonna ?
He answered , Who is he , Lord , that I may believe in him ? ||| Noma riy de niwra , Tuna , he ' hade pede ? Mtiulan pa Mukot a ' u totpena apuesiaya .
Jesus said to him , You have both seen him , and it is he who speaks with you . ||| Omumkek olek E'ewa . E ed mak e Nor o pa kaltier di !
He said , Lord , I believe ! and he worshiped him . ||| Apuesiay O ' a Matroma ! Dewade nru ' pua ntuk lia Yesus gaini ralamni .
Jesus said , I came into this world for judgment , that those who do n't see may see , and that those who see may become blind . ||| Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Amuai lia nohkeran di wawannu totpena Atiutga he ' ed mak kaplola me he ' ed mak khala . Atiutga talan la riy mak kaplin niohora Uplerlawna , pa emolmolan nekama Aghi ' mak matni kyata pa ramkek memna . Mere riy mak kiwra ir inon wamueheni rat niohora oleka Uplerlawna , de hota yeher to ' pa rler la melmelli-kalkalamni pa emeknekama mak matni kamkeka de mak kwaldioinia pa rwaho ' a-rwahai .
Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things , and said to him , Are we also blind ? ||| La'pa riy Parisi mak kden la hande doma ratlin nana Yesus Nakot emkade noma ratiana Yesus riwra , La ' O ralma-riormu de ami e maplin niohora Uplerlawna pa emekwalima mak matni yat wali ? !
Jesus said to them , If you were blind , you would have no sin , but now you say , ‘ We see . ' Therefore your sin remains . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , La'pa mpiayow nohora de miy matmi niata , de Uplerlawna edon Nwaghal miy . Mere yoma mikot la miwra mimkeka me miatga , hade nnia'eratni de miy er ma'ta la do ' a-hala wawannu .
Most certainly , I tell you , one who does n't enter by the door into the sheep fold , but climbs up some other way , is a thief and a robber . But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep . ||| Mitlin rer lia A li'ru mak kaplollola ri ! La'pa riy meni mak klola lutru ktema pa kler la duma riokni ralamni , de makwuri-makgalmua hade . Mere riy maka kmai pia klola nhiari , de makodi duma inhatta .
The gatekeeper opens the gate for him , and the sheep listen to his voice . He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out . ||| Mak katiaka riokni nhiarni , nhari nhiari la makodi duma inhat de , ne pipni-dumni re rlernohora makodi duma die yoma ir rakniau reria matromni lirni . Enpolu nenenna nanni pa nodgiota re .
Whenever he brings out his own sheep , he goes before them , and the sheep follow him , for they know his voice . ||| La'pa rodgiota pipni-dumni dewade makodi duma inhat de nala ' ulu nampena pipni-dumni rlernohor reria , yoma duma re rakniau reria lirni .
They will by no means follow a stranger , but will flee from him , for they do n't know the voice of strangers . ||| Hota ir edonna rlernohora riy meheni , mere rawlar dioin la la'pa edon rakniau reria riy de lirni .
Jesus spoke this parable to them , but they did n't understand what he was telling them . ||| Yesus Nakot nohora lira yawalliohor de , mere ir edonna rna'erit nana Yesus ha nakotkota .
Jesus therefore said to them again , Most certainly , I tell you , I am the sheep 's door . ||| La ' hade pede Yesus Nakot lira ralamni owa'an la ira niwra , Plola la A li'ru ri . A ' di de emeknekama duma riokni nhiarni .
All who came before me are thieves and robbers , but the sheep did n't listen to them . ||| He ' to ' a mak kala ' ul A ' u totpa rwal lia makodi duma mere edon raplola re , de emeknekama makwuri-kgalmu irhatta . Mere hota pipi-duma re edon rlernohora et miemna ir lirni-tunnu .
I am the door . If anyone enters in by me , he will be saved , and will go in and go out and will find pasture . ||| A ' die emeknekama nhiari . He ' a nmai pia nlol A ' die hota nlernana yamori-yalewna . Hota e ' de emolmolan nekama pipi-duma mak edon kamta'ata mere nhu'ru rlol nhiar die pa nla ' a-nmai die nlernan ya'ana-yemnu , tertera-laliahu .
The thief only comes to steal , kill , and destroy . I came that they may have life , and may have it abundantly . ||| Makamnelu-kamna ' a , de nma nkamna ' to ' a ne nma nwunu-nwenna , onde nma nweyata-nwaniawu . Mere Amuai die , totpena rimormiori rlernana mormiori-dardiari maka penpuen niohora Uplerlawna ra'ani-pallu .
I am the good shepherd . The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep . ||| A ' di de makodi duma kalwiedweda inhatti . Makodi duma kalwiedwed de nhur dioinia inonni pa ntuwu-nhaiya pipni-dumni .
He who is a hired hand , and not a shepherd , who does n't own the sheep , sees the wolf coming , leaves the sheep , and flees . The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them . ||| Mere riy mak kodi duma yoma na'an kai lia pipi-duma re matromni de , la'pa namkek tutga hapora-hadawra mak klihir matmata-khaw riarara nmai wia de hota makodi duma die nawlar wia , yoma pipi-duma re e gahani atia ' ira . Ne hota pipni-dumni re kurna-kiatra pa hapora-hadawra nma nlihira-nnaiya .
The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and does n't care for the sheep . ||| Mak ka'ana siewa-kai re nawlar wia yoma na'an to ' siewa-kai , ne e ' edonna nwo'la nohora pipi-duma re .
I am the good shepherd . I know my own , and I 'm known by my own , ||| Mere A ' di de makodi duma kalwiedwed A ' g inhatti . Agat niohora A pi'pu-du'mu , ne A pi'pu-du'mu ho'mana rat niohora A ' u ,
even as the Father knows me , and I know the Father . I lay down my life for the sheep . ||| pa hota emekwalima A A'mu Natg olek A ' wua , ne Agat niohora A A'mu . Ne hota Agala A ino'nu ga tiuwu-ghai niana A pi'pu-du'mu re .
I have other sheep which are not of this fold . I must bring them also , and they will hear my voice . They will become one flock with one shepherd . ||| A pi'pu-du'mu er walia mak edon ror ma'ta dum wok di pa rawok wutu . Hota Agodia re pa ror wutga A du'mu ri . Ne hota ratlin la A li'ru pa ir rora wokni di rla ' a liewr id pa rler la rioka ida , me A ' g ed mak kla ' makhuri-makwa'ana mak ktorna re .
Therefore the Father loves me , because I lay down my life , that I may take it again . ||| A A'mu Nsayni A ' u , yoma Agala ino'nu pa rwunu-rwenna , totpena hota Amuori owa'ana .
No one takes it away from me , but I lay it down by myself . I have power to lay it down , and I have power to take it again . I received this commandment from my Father . ||| Riy id mana hota edonna nwunu-nwen A ' u . Mere Awuayow nohora Agal A ino'nu di , de plolli nek la A orgah ' u wa . A ' g ed mak kodi plolli pa Agala A ino'nu pa rwunu-rwenna , ne Agodi plolli pa hota Amuori owa'ana , yoma kniar die ed mak A A'mu Nala mai A ' u .
Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words . ||| La'pa Yesus Nakota lir de dewade riy Yahudi re rawo'or owa'ana .
Many of them said , He has a demon and is insane ! Why do you listen to him ? ||| Rirahu riwra , Hade e nga ' u yoma hegana nhu'ru ralma , pa yan tatlin la !
Others said , These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon . It is n't possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind , is it ? ||| Mere la ' riy dom de e riwra , Riy mak hegana nhu'ru ralma de edonna raltier die emkade . Taken niana hegana nhi ' kalwieda riy mak matni yata .
It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem . ||| Noma la'pa nte'ela lerlalawna maka riy Yahudi rtepartarlia yamuki-yahepur nohora ir tuini-wedni maka rhoratreria Uplerlawna roma kreini yamounu-yawitanni la ' a Yerusalem . La ' ler de wal pia tah ' i muti lerni .
It was winter , and Jesus was walking in the temple , in Solomon 's porch . ||| Noma Yesus Nla'-nmai lia Uplerlawna roma kreini nhieunu teras rumah maka rweta la Salomo Genni .
The Jews therefore came around him and said to him , How long will you hold us in suspense ? If you are the Christ , tell us plainly . ||| La ' ler de riy Yahudi rma rawok la Yesus onni pa rpepan reria na'nama ratiana riwra , Mowen nianpena Mukot nohora he ' O ' a totpena yana amparor nohor reri O ' a ? Mukot doin memna la'pa plol toto ' a de Ray Makamori-Kalewna id O ' a !
Jesus answered them , I told you , and you do n't believe . The works that I do in my Father 's name , these testify about me . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , A ' g e ukot olek miy wia mere miy die edonna mpiesiaya . Hihi ' a-yapyap miak kalwiedweda , maka Aghi ' reri totpa Aliernohor reria A A'mu nhiopanni de , hare er mak ktutga he ' A ' u .
But you do n't believe , because you are not of my sheep , as I told you . ||| Mere miy edonna mpiesiaya yoma miy edonna mlier wut lia A pipi-du'mu .
My sheep hear my voice , and I know them , and they follow me . ||| A du'mu re ratlin la A li'ru . Agatga re , ne irlernohor A ' u .
I give eternal life to them . They will never perish , and no one will snatch them out of my hand . ||| Agala mormiori-dardiari la ira , ne hota ir edon rler la matmiati plalahwa mere rmormior pia nodi liarni . Riy id mana edonna nlernan talan pa na'ala harella ' A li'mu ralamni .
My Father who has given them to me is greater than all . No one is able to snatch them out of my Father 's hand . ||| A A'mu mak kal olek harella ' mai A ' u , de Nareh dioinia haneknek wawannu . Pede riy id mana edonna narur pia nwarui niana harella ' A A'mu limni ralamni .
I and the Father are one . ||| Agora A A'mu de lir ida .
Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him . ||| Noma riy Yahudi re ra'ala owa'an watu yoma riwra ra rwa'ala Yesus .
Jesus answered them , I have shown you many good works from my Father . For which of those works do you stone me ? ||| Mere Yesus Nakot la re , Miy e mimkek oleka hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona mak karehi-kalawna harahu , maka A A'mu Nhopna Aghi ' a . Pa la ' a hihi ' a-yapyap mak kamehi-kayona meni ed maka kariei pia miy miwa mpia'ala A ' u ?
The Jews answered him , We do n't stone you for a good work , but for blasphemy , because you , being a man , make yourself God . ||| Noma Yahudi re rwalolla riwra , Hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona maka Omhi ' nande edonna ratota-rariei pia ampa'ala O ' a , mere yoma Omhi ' lir yat la Uplerlawna . Rimormiori id nek O ' a ne , Omhi ' inonmu de emekneka Uplerlawna .
Jesus answered them , Is n't it written in your law , ‘ I said , you are gods ' ? ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Miy e mitlin oleka maka miy Puk deulu-tatarmi de e rhorat targa , de Uplerlawna lirni Niwra , Miy die rpol miy lia Uplerlawna a'nani .
If he called them gods , to whom the word of God came and the Scripture ca n't be broken , ||| Itatga la Puka lirni maka ha rhorat taru re rnairia pa nodi liarni . La ' hade pede la'pa riy maka klernana Uplerlawna lirni-tunnu deullu-tatarni nek de , er maka Uplerlawna Nwet la niwra , Uplerlawna a'nani ,
do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world , ‘ You blaspheme , ' because I said , ‘ I am the Son of God ' ? ||| nihya'pa miy e miwra A ' g e wuohora-tiatra Uplerlawna la'pa A ' g e ukota Uplerlawna A'nani A ' u ? Uplerlawna nekane ed maka Nwaliri-nwalioh nan A ' u me Nhopan pa muai .
If I do n't do the works of my Father , do n't believe me . ||| La'pa A ' g edonna ghi ' nana tulla-kniar miaka A'mu Nala pa Aghi ' nande yana mpiesiay A ' u .
But if I do them , though you do n't believe me , believe the works , that you may know and believe that the Father is in me , and I in the Father . ||| Agat niohora mihmena mpiesiaya A li'ru maka nhi'inde A'ukot tiy miy , mere yoma mimkek nan oleka hihi ' u-yapya'pu mak kalwiedweda re mak Aghi ' nan oleka , hota mpiesiay A ' u . Hota la ' hare pede miat tioto ' meman de Agora A A'mu de riy id ami .
They sought again to seize him , and he went out of their hand . ||| Dewade rawenan pa honona re rwahak pa rtorna Yesus , mere ta'en niana rtorna yoma E Nala ' doin olek ir wa .
He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first , and he stayed there . ||| Noma Yesus Nawali owa'an la gerlawna Yordan walli , la ' gen miaka Yohansi nharan ulia de , pa Nden la hande wa .
Many came to him . They said , John indeed did no sign , but everything that John said about this man is true . ||| Rirahu rma rre ' teman Yesus la hande , na'nama rakota riwra , Yohansi nmeh ' a neka edonna nhi ' a hihi ' a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona mak ktutga Uplerlawna rurni-laini , mere hya ' maka Yohansi nakota nohora la ' riy di , de naplola .
Many believed in him there . ||| Noma rirahu la hande rpesiaya Yesus .
Now a certain man was sick , Lazarus from Bethany , of the village of Mary and her sister , Martha . It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair , whose brother Lazarus was sick . ||| La ' ler de , de muanke ' ida nanni Lasarus nor rewre'wa narni Maria nora Marta rhol wiutu la ' leta Betania . Mari di de ed mak khuria wu'ru hup mikmikri la ' Itmatromni lakni , ne nala moratnu na nkuhi akerna . Noma la ler ida de Lasarus e namehra .
The sisters therefore sent to him , saying , Lord , behold , he for whom you have great affection is sick . ||| Pede narni rora rhopan pa rla rod kiot la ' a Yesus onnila Lasarus mehrani-maunu . Pa la'pa rla rakot la Yesus , Matroma , Maria nora Marta narni mak Omsiayn de e namehra .
But when Jesus heard it , he said , This sickness is not to death , but for the glory of God , that God 's Son may be glorified by it . ||| Pa la'pa Yesus Natlin nana lir de noma Nakot la Niwra , Hota nnien die edonna nodia matmiati la ' Lasarus . La ' hare honona de itamkeka totpena ya'uli-yawedi nden rer lia Uplerlawna , me totpena nden rer wial lia Uplerlawna A'nani A ' u .
Now Jesus loved Martha , and her sister , and Lazarus . ||| Yesus Nsayn reria Marta , Maria nora narni Lasarus .
When therefore he heard that he was sick , he stayed two days in the place where he was . ||| Mere la'pa Yesus Natlin nana Lasarus e namehra de , noma Entot pa Nden nek la hande pa mahnekni lera worg owa'ana .
Then after this he said to the disciples , Let 's go into Judea again . ||| Lera woru nte ' doin la dewade Nakot la maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re Niwra , Mai pia tawal lia Yudea .
The disciples asked him , Rabbi , the Jews were just trying to stone you . Are you going there again ? ||| Noma rakot la riwra , Tungkurga , na'nama riy Yahudi riwra rwatliewria O ' a la ' hande totpa rwunu-rwenn O ' a , noma dodo'ondi Omuiwra muwali owa'ana ? !
Jesus answered , Are n't there twelve hours of daylight ? If a man walks in the day , he does n't stumble , because he sees the light of this world . ||| Noma Yesus Nnairia yawalliohora totpa ratga de la'pa hota ror E ' talla de hota edon rler la kropna-krieutu yoma lerni edon ntutu ma'ta Nakot la Niwra , Miplinga de la ' lera ida , de lera nhita-nrepra jama termida wehrani woru ? ! Riy maka kor rewre'wa A ' tialla de emeknekama nalala ' lola lelerni , pede edonna ndunti-nwetru , yoma e namkek reria noha wawannu .
But if a man walks in the night , he stumbles , because the light is n't in him . ||| Mere mak kala ' a la lera mel'utni de hota ndunit taru , yoma noha melmela-kalkalma .
He said these things , and after that , he said to them , Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep , but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep . ||| Yesus lirni emkadella ira na'nama Nakot owa'an la re Niwra , It talanni Lasarus e nanin oleka wa , mere pena A lia umata .
The disciples therefore said , Lord , if he has fallen asleep , he will recover . ||| Noma maka Yesus ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re rakot la riwra , Matroma , la'pa Lasarus nanina de hota plet pa nkalwieda .
Now Jesus had spoken of his death , but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep . ||| La'pa Yesus Niwra e nanina de Yesus ralma-riorni de Lasarus nmati olekwa . Mere iratniekame Yesus ralma-riorni , de Lasarus e nanin toto ' a .
So Jesus said to them plainly then , Lazarus is dead . ||| La hade pede Yesus Nto'pi-ngaur lirni Niwra , Plollolli de Lasarus nmati olekwa ,
I am glad for your sakes that I was not there , so that you may believe . Nevertheless , let 's go to him . ||| mere hota hadi nwal lia talan pa mimpiesiaya . La ' hade pede A ralmu e nahepru kennama A ' g edonna lia ' a hande wonyira-melulu pa Aghi ' kalwied e ' a . Mere dodo'ondi de mai pia tla teka Lasarus mak kmat die !
Thomas therefore , who is called Didymus , said to his fellow disciples , Let 's also go , that we may die with him . ||| Noma Tomsa , maka rhoiya la A'na Dio ' de nakot la mutwualli maka Yesus ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re niwra , Mai pia tlernohora Yesus la Yudea , la'pa tmat niohora E ' a .
So when Jesus came , he found that he had been in the tomb four days already . ||| La'pa Yesus Nte'ela Betania noma rakot la Yesus de riwra , rkenia olek Lasarus inonni la liena ralamni pa lerni wogat olek la hande wa .
Now Bethany was near Jerusalem , about fifteen stadia away . ||| Mere leta Betania di , de olietni la Yerusalem , de edon nhal de kilu wotelu .
Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary , to console them concerning their brother . ||| Pede riy Yahudi liawanni rma rod niohora Marta nora Maria totpena ramatar nohora yoma narni nkurn olekwa .
Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming , she went and met him , but Mary stayed in the house . ||| La'pa Marta natlin nana Yesus Nmai nieka , dewade nla nwatroma Yesus , mere Maria edon nlergot ma'ta .
Therefore Martha said to Jesus , Lord , if you would have been here , my brother would n't have died . ||| Noma Marta nakot la Yesus niwra , Matroma , la'pa ler de Matro'mu etla handi mana taken niana a na'ru de nmati .
Even now I know that whatever you ask of God , God will give you . ||| Mere Agat niohora meman de la ' dodo'ondi wali pia Uplerlawna hota Nal to ' a hya ' a mak Matroma Nwaka la E ' a .
Jesus said to her , Your brother will rise again . ||| Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Marta , o narmu de hota nmori owa'ana .
Martha said to him , I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day . ||| Marta nwalolla , Matroma , Agatga de hota Lasarus nmori owa'an la ' a lera noha niatni maka ramoria mak kmati rella matmiatni ralamni .
Jesus said to her , I am the resurrection and the life . He who believes in me will still live , even if he dies . ||| Noma Yesus Nakot la Marta Niwra , A ' g ed mak kamoria mak kmati me gal mormiori lia ira pa nodi liarni . Riy mak kpesiay A ' die hota matmiati edon nodi plolli la mere rmori owa'an la ' a matmiatni ralamni .
Whoever lives and believes in me will never die . Do you believe this ? ||| Ne mak kmormiori mia'ta , makpesiay A ' u , de hota rler la mormiori plalahwa pa nodi liarni . Hota ompuesiay lir maka A'ukota re me edonna ?
She said to him , Yes , Lord . I have come to believe that you are the Christ , God 's Son , he who comes into the world . ||| Marta niwra , Matroma apuesiaya , Matro'mu de Uplerlawna A'nani mak khi ' a Ray Makamori-Kalewna maka Uplerlawna Nano'taru pa Nmai lia nohkeran di wawannu .
When she had said this , she went away and called Mary , her sister , secretly , saying , The Teacher is here and is calling you . ||| La'pa Marta nakot emkade noma nla npolga elli Maria pa napup lia tlinni niwra , Tungkuru Nmai olekwa ne e Natian o ' a .

Now Jesus had not yet come into the village , but was in the place where Martha met him . ||| La hade de Yesus edonna nler ma'ta la leta ralamni . Enden ma't la leta to'orni maka Enor Marta rwatrom pa rwahauru .

When Jesus therefore saw her weeping , and the Jews weeping who came with her , he groaned in the spirit and was troubled , ||| La'pa Yesus Namkek nana Maria nkakru , me la ' walia riy Yahudi mak kor rewre'wa Mari ' talla re honona rko ' a-rkakur wali , dewade Yesus mana ralamni nmayo ' doin wali .
and said , Where have you laid him ? They told him , Lord , come and see . ||| Noma Yesus Natiana re Niwra , Miy e midera Lasarus inonni la hanmeni ? Noma rwalolla riwra , Ma Mumkeka Matroma .
Jesus wept . ||| Noma Yesus Nkakur wa .
The Jews therefore said , See how much affection he had for him ! ||| Noma Yahudi re riwra , Mimkek to'ola hade e Nsayn wenna Lasarus .
Some of them said , Could n't this man , who opened the eyes of him who was blind , have also kept this man from dying ? ||| Mere la ' dom de e riwra , Hade nhi ' a mak matni kyata pa rkalwieda ne nihya'pa E edonna Nhi ' Lasarus pa edon nmati ?
Jesus therefore , again groaning in himself , came to the tomb . Now it was a cave , and a stone lay against it . ||| Noma rla'awa lien maka rkenia Lasarus inonni de . La'pa rte'ela hande Yesus ralamni nmolu-nhelma . La ' hande e rala wat liawna id la ra rherit targa lienni de nhiarni .
Jesus said , Take away the stone . Martha , the sister of him who was dead , said to him , Lord , by this time there is a stench , for he has been dead four days . ||| Yesus Nakot la re Niwra , Mpiaklol doinia wat diel la ' a nhiar de gaini . Noma Lasarus mak kmat die narni Marta nakot la niwra , Matroma , rader olek hadella ' melul handena , la lera wogat olekwa pa hota inonni ngehpa-nta ' l olekwa !

Nhor nia'nama Yesus Nwatniar la lyanti na'nama Niwra , Ama , A ' u'uli-uwedi O ' a yoma Omutlin olek la mai A wua .

When he had said this , he cried with a loud voice , Lazarus , come out ! ||| La'pa Nakot emkade , na'nama Nhaun matmiat pia Niwra , Lasarus ee ! Mliergot pa mmuai ee !

Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him . ||| Riy Yahudi harahu maka kma kamatar nohora Maria , de rpesiaya Yesus , yoma ramkek oleka hya ' mak Yesus Nhi ' nan oleka re .

If we leave him alone like this , everyone will believe in him , and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation . ||| La'pa it edonna tatut niana hade , de hota rirahu rpesiaya , pa reiniande kokokna-rariarni lalawna , ne la'awa honi de hota mak kodi plolli la hairi Roma rmai pia hota rwakloli-rwaklalia Yahudi itora it roma kreini di .

nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people , and that the whole nation not perish . ||| Miy e miplinga de la ' samomuounu de rirahu nariei pia riy ida nmati , mere yana riy ida nariei pa it luwnu-a'nani namkoha-namnanna .
Now he did n't say this of himself , but being high priest that year , he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation , ||| Kayafas enakot hade , mere ha wniaror wamueheni atia ' hade mere yoma Uplerlawna Nariei . Enakot nohora hare yoma la ' a anin de ralamni de , E de , o'ta lawna la imam-imam re , pa lirni de nror targa nakot targa Yesus matmiatni de yoma la ' a Yahudi rerieini .
and not for the nation only , but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad . ||| Ne edonna ntut nian to ' a riy Yahudi rmeh ' a mere la ' walia Uplerlawna upni-a'nani mak kden la meni-meni totpa hota rawok wutga la ida .
So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death . ||| La'pa ler de meman pa mak kodi plolli la Yahudi re rla lir id pa riwra rwenna Yesus .
Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews , but departed from there into the country near the wilderness , to a city called Ephraim . He stayed there with his disciples . ||| La ' hade pede Yesus Nahmena Nayamkek la riy mutlialawna riy Yahudi nhiopannu-pniepanni . Yesus Nwaran la hande pa Nla'awa la ' let maka ha rweta la Efraim mak rehgorgorga wo'orletna-kawurloini . Yesus Nor wutga maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re rden la hande wa .
Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand . Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover , to purify themselves . ||| La ' ler de de nhi ' pa nwakriania lera-mela Yahudi lerlalawanni Paska . Matialo'onama E ' edonna Nmai lia ' a lerlalawna ri ?
Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was , he should report it , that they might seize him . ||| Irakot emkade yoma la imam-imam re o'tani-matni rora riy Parisi ralgot oleka tita la ' a riy meni mak kat niohora Yesus handen la , de plet pa nma nakot totpena rla rtorna .
Then , six days before the Passover , Jesus came to Bethany , where Lazarus was , who had been dead , whom he raised from the dead . ||| Tre ' ma'ta lera wonem pa lerlalawna Paska , noma Yesus Nla ' a leta Betania , la Lasarus letni maka Yesus Namori Lasarus la ' matmiatni ralamni de .
So they made him a supper there . Martha served , but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him . ||| La hande de riy rhi ' ya'anlawna-yemunlawna pa rhoi-rtania Yesus , ne Marta ed mak kamkek la hare pa ra'ana . Lasarus nor wutga mak kmai re pa ra'an rewre'wa wut lia Yesus .
Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard , very precious , and anointed Jesus ' feet and wiped his feet with her hair . The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment . ||| Edon nalo'on wali ne Maria nodia wu'ru hup mikmikri narwastu , mak welli werta , edonna nhal de potla nwatniarnara stenga liter , na'nama nhuria wu'ru della ' Yesus lakni , nhor nioma nala moratnu na naha kerna . Noma wu'ru de huwnu mikmikarni nawah ' a nana rom de tetema .
Then Judas Iscariot , Simon 's son , one of his disciples , who would betray him , said , ||| Mere Yudas Iskariot , riy id la riy maka Yesus ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re , maka hota e ' nekpa nwaldioin pa na'olga Yesus , de edon nwayow nan pat de hihi'ini de pa niwra ,
Why was n't this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor ? ||| Hoi ! Nihya'pa edonna na'ol nieka wu'ru de pa welli de hota rala la riy mak kakleha-kaplara ? ! Hota welli de nla ' nan meman la kupna-kai gaji la anni id gahani .
Now he said this , not because he cared for the poor , but because he was a thief , and having the money box , used to steal what was put into it . ||| Yudas lirni de edonna ntar lia riy mak kakleha-kaplara , mere yoma riy kamna ' mera id e ' a . E ' ed maka ktorreri Yesus Nora maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye ' a re kupanni , ne nhi'inde ena'ala kupna la ' a kaha pa enken wiutga la e kupan wamueheni .
But Jesus said , Leave her alone . She has kept this for the day of my burial . ||| Mere Yesus Nakot la Niwra , Miolin doin e ' pa nhi ' samomuou A lia dodo'ondi to ' a . E ' edon na'olu hup mikmikar de yoma niwra nwahi ' tar A pua rtamni A ' u .
For you always have the poor with you , but you do n't always have me . ||| Hota A ' g edon gor miy pia nodi liarni . Mere riy mak kakleha-kaplara re nhi'inde e ror wutga miy totpa mtiulan la ' ira .
A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there , and they came , not for Jesus ' sake only , but that they might see Lazarus also , whom he had raised from the dead . ||| Riy rahu ratlin de Yesus etla ' Betania , noma irla ' wal lia hande . Rla ' de , edonna riwra rwatrom to ' a Yesus mere e riwra ramkek walia Lasarus maka Yesus Namoria la matmiatni ralamni de .
But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also , ||| Hade wal pia ed mak kariei pede imam o'tani-matni re rna'ohma pa rwenan walia Lasarus .
because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus . ||| Yoma la ' e ' pede Yahudi harahu rawlar dioinia ir la , ne rla rpesiaya Yesus .
On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast . When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem , ||| La'pa repar wa , dewade rirahu mak kmai Yerusalem totpena ramuki-rahepur nohor lerlalawna Paska de , ratlin de Yesus hota Nmai wialia Yerusalem , ne ed ma'ta la talan letgara .
they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him , and cried out , Hosanna ! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord , the King of Israel ! ||| Noma rla ra'ala korma tawni na'nama rla pa rwatroma Yesus , ne he ' i-hepur nohora la loi liawna-talan lawna ralamni . Rhaunu-rhaun pa riwra , Ya'uli-yawedi nden rer tiy O ' ee ! Ta'uli-tawedi , tsu'ru-tselma O ' mak kmai pia kodia Orgahi-Orha ' a nanni ! Ta'uli-tawedia , tlilili-tmamuawua O ' ee , makla ' Israel Rayni !
Jesus , having found a young donkey , sat on it . As it is written , ||| La ' ler de Yesus Nmai die Nha ' nana keledai a'na ida , maka Nwak nana la ' riy ida . Pede plola la Puka lirni mak kiwra ,
