The End . ||| Nhoruwa .
One year , there was a woman named Oktovina and her male siblings two grownup female children , one named Mina , one named Jakomina , and also a male named Godtlifa . ||| Anni ida , patke ’ a nanni Oktovina nora kakni muanke ’ a a ’ nani patkeʼa lawna woru , ri ’ ida nanni Mina , ri'ida nanni Jakomina , muankeʼa ida wali nanni Godtlifa .
This Godtlifa , was Oktovina 's youngest child and so they went to sea to look for octopus at Lailiawna . ||| Godtlifde , Oktovina a'nani gari pa la ' a rerunla rwahaka krita la Lailiawna , Tamta onni .
They went to Lailiawna then mother Oktovina and those two girls got down ( off the boat ) . ||| Rla'wa la ' a Lailiawna dewede inni Oktovina nora patke ' a rrora rerunla .
They got off at Lailiawna and the three of them searched for octopus . ||| Rerunla Lailiawna pa irwotelu rwahaka krita .
They told Godtlifa to pole the canoe , to go ahead of them to Tamta . ||| Ir'rhopna Godtlifa te'ena loi pa nalaullia Tamta .
The three of them were absorbed in the search for octopus then the tide also began to rise . ||| Irwotelu tepartarlia krita wnyahakni dewede metimana napra .
On that day the three of them had gotten many octopus , then the three of them threw their octopus on the land . ||| Lerdede irwotelu lernana krita liawanni dewede irwotelu rahlera krita la keranni .
They were in the process of walking when the current came with great strength heading for Upahrui . ||| Tepartarlia yala ' a dewede wauwau nmaide merannidi nokru Upahrui .
The three of them could not stand against the tide , then they threw away all the octopus which they had gotten . ||| Irwotelu ta'eni thannana wauwau dewede irhoplia la krita makra'enniana hanona .
The three of them swam for Upahrui but at that time mother Oktovina and Mina could not swim . ||| Irwotelu rnanlia Upahrui mera lerdede inni Oktovina nora Mina ta'eni rnanniana .
Then mother Oktovina and Mina sank into the sea but Jakomina was strong at swimming and got to the land at Upahrui . ||| Dewede inni Oktovina nora Mina teprerunla tah ' i mera Jakomina narurlia niani pa lernana Upahrui la keranni .
Then she took a good breath then climbed up to the top but she could not see them . ||| Noka na'ala aranni samomou dewede nha'atla tutuwawannu mera donna namkekanana ra .
The two of them had already drowned then Jakomina cried , and shouted because her mother Oktovina and Mina had already died . ||| Ir'rora rteprernu olekwa dewede Jakomina nkakurwa , nhawnu , yoma inni Oktovina nora Mina rmati olekwa .
That day not even one boat or canoe passed by , then the sun also set . ||| Lerdede puou , loi , idmana edonna rlereti , noma leramana nheriawa .
That day Godtlifa who had poled the canoe to go ahead of them , did not even know that his mother and Mina had already died . ||| Lerdede Godtlifa maka kte'ennana loi pa nalaullia , naplingeti inni nora Mina rmatia olekwa .
At sun down then one man named Timotius went to Tamta . ||| Lera ntuini dewede muanke ' a ida nanni Timotius la ' a Tamta .
He was in the process of poling his canoe then mother Oktovina 's hair became entangled around his pole . ||| Tepartarlia ntie'ena dewede inni Oktovina moratnu nmanaknyuinla te'ena .
Uncle Timotius was shocked , seeing this dead person so he yelled , “ Mother Oktovina . ” ||| Yei Timotius nheduma , namkeka rimatidi pa naknyaunanade inni Oktovina .
Then he motioned to the canoes that went to Tamta to come and get mother Oktovina and bring her to the village . ||| Dewede nkawi la loi makla ' a Tamta pa rmara'ala inni Oktovina pa rodia la ' a leta .
When they went to the village , those in the village we shocked . ||| Rla'wa letade , makdella leta rheduma .
The relatives were called , they cried for them to come get her , and bring mother Oktovina to the house . ||| Inni narni rpolu , rkakru pa rmarala , rodi inni Oktovina la roma nayanni .
The village chief ordered the people to go search for those three children , hopefully they had not already died . ||| Paprai nhopna limarora la ' a rwahaka kekenkua rwotelu , yanpa rmati olekwa .
They just kept searching so some went to Tamta , to Upahrui , and to Hawna . ||| Rwahakneka pa makla ' a Tamta , Upahrui , Hawna .
When those that went to Upahrui came close to the shore , Jakomina saw them then called them to come get her . ||| Makla ’ a Upahrui wakriani keranni , Jakomina namkeknana dewede npolu pa marala .
When they came and got her she was crying and crying , then they asked , `` Where are Godtlifa and Mina ? '' ||| Maralade nkakrunande , noka iratiana Godtlifa nora Mina erlameni ?
Then Jakomina said , `` Godtlifa is at Tamta , Mina and mother Oktovina could not swim so they already died . '' ||| Noka Jakomina nakotniwra Godtlifa etla Tamta , Mina nora inni Oktovina ta ’ eni rnanni pa irrora rmati olekwa .
Then those that went to get Jakomina said that they already found mother Oktovina . ||| Noka maklakala Jakomina rakotniwra inni Oktovina lernana olekwa .
Then they brought Jakomina and came to the village . ||| Noka irodia Jakomina pa maila ' a leta .
They came to the village , then they let Jakomina down then they returned again to search for Mina . ||| Rmai la leta dewede iralernu Jakomina noka rawalio wa'ana pa la rwahaka Mina .
They used a pole to push their boat toward Tamta . ||| Irte'ena pa rokru Tamta .
The people who went to Tamta already brought Godtlifa and the people who went to Hawna and Kpuri . ||| Limarora makla ’ a Tamta rodia oleka Godtlifa me limarora makla ’ a Hawna , Kpuri .
They were in the process of searching but they still had not found anything . ||| Tepartarlia wnyahaka mera ira edonna lernanetia .
Then they returned back to the village . ||| Noka ira walpia rmaiwia leta .
Early the next morning , they divided the people ; those to stay behind to bury the dead ( mother Oktovina ) , and those to go search for Mina . ||| Repardoin yawyawra ma ’ ata , rhakretia limarora makwarini pa rtamin mati ( inni Oktovina ) , makla ’ a rwahaka Mina .
They just kept searching till the sun set again . ||| Irwahaknekpa normar lera owa ’ ana .
Then those who were at Tamta came to the beach then they saw that ( Mina ) was rolling on the beach . ||| Dewede makdella Tamta irmai eniwawanu noka ramkekde ( Mina ) nanyewa la eniwawanu .
Then they got her and put her in the canoe to bring her to the village ( Luang ) . ||| Noka irala pa rkenia la loi rodia maila ' a leta ( Lgona ) .
When they came to the village , they made a coffin in order to quickly bury her because she already smelled . ||| Rmaila leta , irayapi lumni pleta pleta pa irla ’ a rtamni yoma nahuwu olekwa .
The relatives were extremely distressed by the tragedy on that day . ||| Hare matmiatni lerdede inni narni rsusdoinla .
What is more , Godtlifa and Jakomina cried day and night . ||| Yahoamde Godtlifa nora Jakomina rkakru lelera melmela .
Finished ||| Nhorwa .
Oh , our Lord , Lord God . ||| Ei , Matromlawnu ne , Orgahi Orha ' a , Uplerlawna Mempulwatnu .
You are in the highest , in Heaven . ||| O'etla gentutulu-watliolo'ona , Ilwio'itu-Darwonema , Ilyamou Watyatoha .
But now , I say your name , I pray to you , I worship you in order that you will listen and see us who are on this earth . ||| Mere dodo'ondi de , aghoi lia kotmu-awetla nanmu , apualu-wuak tiy O ' a , ghoi idma rrama lia'ara , totpena muheri tlinmu-mutatar matmu , mutlina-mutaili , mlina-muata reria ami lia noh kerna-rai kieran di wawannu .
I pray to you in order that you take care of and watch over us on this earth . ||| Apuolu-awuak tiy O ' a totpena mhilpai-muanatu , muhlili-mulakma , muyori-mudari ami lia riy ornoha-orrai di .
Take away disease and plagues from us . ||| Mudopardoini-muhaldoini nyeni-nyhena , rinni-kniahra maiya ami .
Take away evil from us . ||| Mitieridoini-muhaldoini yotyotni-yatyatni maiya ami .
Give us long life so that we will live a long time until we are old with white teeth and fallen teeth , then God will come and call our name . ||| Muala amormior mamni pa nawerna-naplahwa , ammorniana a tup mamni , amlawannana a liawan mamni , la'pa amlerla mto ' a-ppe ' a nihtuini-mortihamra , lli'ina ndahla-awu npo'pa nanpena Orgahi-Orha ' a mhoi lia mkot mamni-mpetla a nan mamni mtieman la a lim mamni miriyhamilla a dopal mamni .
We pray to you in order that you take care of our relatives on this earth of ours , so that on the day we meet each other we will praise your name . ||| Ampolu-ampak tiy O ' a totpena mhilpai-muanatga a ' in mamni nar mamni , a ' am mamni hyali miamni la ' a a noh mamni raiy miamni , totpena lera idpa am idma nwatroma-ntahnei id de , ama'uli mawedi reria o kotmu-o-nanmu .
Erase our sins . ||| Mho'doini-mhaidoini a do ' mamni-hal mamni .
This prayer of ours we are connecting to the one whose name is the one and only heir/son . ||| Polpuolu mamni-wakwak mamni di de amheli-mpapna he ' dilla a'namu Wutmeha-Laimieha .
True . ||| Totto ' a ( Amin ) .
Respected elders and relatives , those who are gathered around . ||| Ina-ama , Ina-nara , makle'lu-makdalwa .
At one time the Lord God created , formed , put together our ancestors Adam [ lit . gathered dustgathered red clay ] and Eve [ lit . one rib only mother-only rib ] . ||| La ' lera Orgahi-Orha ' a Uplerlawna Mempulwatnu Nakoki-nayapia , Nakoma-napala , Nhedruh ' a-ntaplihi it upni-tgarni Wuwtian wioka-Lai tian miera nora Ruh meh inni-Uh mueh riwni .
Then he took care of them with peace and blessings on every side . ||| Nhornioma Ntera-ndema la kalwiedni-paitiotni .
Adam and partner/pair ( Eve ) lived in paradise . ||| Wuwtian wioka-Lai-tian miera nora ulwualli-tnialwialli de rmori-rdarlia il wiyo'riwnu-gen wio'mara .
Then the devil was jealous/angry at our two ancestors who were living in blessedness . ||| La ' noma hegana amlawanni ralamni namehra la it upni-tgarni rrora rmori-rdarlia pripanni-fa'anni ralamni .
Then the devil turned his body into a snake ( lit . reptile red spying-snake yellow ) in order to bring deceit to Eve ( lit . one rib only mother-only rib ) . ||| Noma hegana nawiru-nawalia inonnila Tok mier wu ' u-Ni ' mar rahlu pa nodia nur siawortra-namsale ' u la Ruh meh inni-Uh mueh riwni .
Then he deceived Adam so that they received death which resulted even in being buried in the earth and becoming dust again . ||| Noma nwotra-le'niana Wuwtian wioka-Lay tian miera pede rlerla matmiati-molmuolu hoho ' a-tawtiawu la'pa ralumni rakietra la Up rar noha-Rar rayi nora kodni awnu-topni-tanni owa'ana .
Even though our ancestors were tempted like that , God did not stop taking care of Adam 's descendants ( Lit seminal fluid water-exchange ) . ||| La'pa it upni-tgarni yatotni-yarieini emkade ho'mana , Orgahi-Orha ' a edona Nolin lima-nwe'er-rorni la Wuw tian wioka-Lai tian miera kotnu-turnu gerni-wniaunu .
Time went on till Kain hit very hard Habel till he died ( lit . blood came out-turn into feces ) . ||| La'pa Kain nkaklia po ' a-liwra manga garni Habel pa nok rara-nwaltie'eni .
Then Habela 's sacrificed life ( death ) was a witness crying out to the Lord God who lives in heaven ( lit . One who owns all , the great grandfather sun the most precious jewel/stone who dwells at the sixth or seventh level on the pure mountain/land-set apart rock ) . ||| La'pa Habela aranni naprir niohora tniunu hniaranni-odawni la'pa natipu-natnian lia Orgahi-Orha ' a Uplerlawna-Mempulwatnu makdenla Ilwo'itu-Darwionema , Ilyamou-Watyatoha .
Then the Lord God sent Kain away for good [ lit . completely washed out Kain 's footsteps . ||| Noma Orgahi-Orha ' a Uplerlawna Mempulwatnu Ndi'na Kain yeheni-lowa Kain hlorni .
But when Kain was about to leave then God put a sign on Kain 's forehead . ||| Mere la'pa Kain nwaktarlia pa lergotwa noma Uplerlawna nhonnia Kain reranni .
The book/Bible says that God does not forget the words/promise he has said/made . ||| Puka lirni enakota de Uplerlawna edona nhortaplinga lir mak ha nakota .
Long ago he said to Adam : `` Bear children and fill the earth . '' ||| Nomlerni de enakota la ' a Wuwtian wioka-Lai tian miera niwra : Mi'upa-mi ' a'na totpena mipenga noh di wawannu .
But when those people multiplied , then they did not have respect for God until it reached until Noah 's time . ||| Mere la'pa rimormiori re rpeh mutliawna-rlawan ketiaru , noma kleh ya'unna-yamta'ata la Uplerlawna-Mempulwatnu pa la'pa nte'ela Up Nuh tuwnu .
Then the Lord God split apart the heavens so rain fell down and stepped on the earth so the springs of water would flow . ||| Noma Orgahi-Orha ' a Uplerlawna ritie'era lyanti pa ger otna naktiowru me nha'apre'era noh marna pa ger ormata roplia riwriwu-hararna .
Then he caused people to reach to destruction . ||| Noma narieniande rimormiori rlerla kowlora-pah ' a meti .
But because of God 's own love therefore he took a boat to save Noh and his wife and children . ||| Mere Uplerlawna orgahani sniayanni pa Nala konkona-aupuali na nalewna Nuh nor hawni-a'nani .
The multitudes of people ( were not saved ) except God set apart those eight people to walk along the right path/path of righteousness . ||| Rimormioria riwnu-halli re enekneka Orgahi-Orha ' a ntawdioinia rimormiori re wo'awa pa rtikilrerlia yehtan miera me rhaparrerlia hlor wewnihi .

God himself used his hands to hold his law which was written on stone and give to Musa so in order that we can really see ( the truth ) but all the more greatly sin increased . ||| Uplerlawna orgahani Nal limni nantoreri lirNi-tunNu deulLu-tatarNi maka kahniorattarlia watu le ' u pa Nala la Musa pa totpena itamkek memna mere yeher to'ame do ' a-hala naitittarrerlia .
Perhaps God could not endure this any longer . ||| Matialo'onamde Uplerlawna takenia ntahanana .
Then he used people who are uncivilized ( lit . people who live all ears and hairy tongue ? ) to become prophets concerning ( the fact that ) the One and Only Son/Heir will descend down to this earth . ||| Noma Nnairia rimormioria makmori-kdarlia tlin tetema-nampulwullu pa rhi ' a makwohor ulu-ktatrulu la ' a Wutmueha-Lai mieha hota ntopur la maiya noh marna wawannu .
In Luke 's book it talks about the time that Jesus was born in the Betlahem stable . ||| La ' a Lukas pukni de e nwahaur nohora la lerni ha rtora Yesus la krahana Betlahem .
When we hear the words saying , `` rtora , '' its meaning is bear or give life/birth . ||| La'pa itatlina lira niwra : rtora , nnia'eratni de rayoria onde rmoria .
But in the traditional culture in the Luang language of our ancestors they say : The One and Only Son/Heir descends on the earth . ||| Mere la ' pa'etnu de nhi'inde yawala Lgona lir ina-ama riwra : Wutmeha-Lai mieha Ntopurla noh marna wawannu .
It is as if the Luang people do not know the words like this : just then a baby named Jesus was born . ||| Emaknekame Lgona ra'aplinga lir maka kiwra : na'nama e rtor papayi id de nwaw Yesus .
Because it is just like Luang people know that the one who was just born , was the true One-and Only Son/Heir of a king . ||| Yoma emaknekame Lgona e ratniohor de Yesus maka na'nama ha rayori de , Wutmueha-Laimieha e inhatte .
Why was that ? ||| Yoma la ' a hya ' a ?
We Luang people say this , because in the time of our ancestors the ancestor westerners came and put holes in our earth and opened our eyes , that-is they gave us Yesus ' name and they taught us how to read the book , they said this Jesus , he was born in Betlahem on an island in the far west . ||| Pede Lgona itakot emkadena , de onnila lerni upa-wlada rma rhu'ula ita tlinni-twer it matni , de rala Yesus nanNi me rwatut itla pniaki la puka ralamni de , riwra Yesus di , de rmor hya'dilla Betlahem la ' noh makden warta roo !
But long ago , when the earth was young/newly created , the boulders and rocks were breaking apart , in our ancestors words they would say : the chicken lays strongly its egg in the nest , and dogs are tamed from the chains . ||| Mere nomlerni , la noha nhera-rayi nwanni , illi npoka-watu npetu , de lir in-ama riwra : hiwi naro'wa pitga terannu la ' kuranni , me ahu nayamarlia diadallu .
We here in Luang ( Luang Sermata , Island swallow-Land dark , Rock mountain face Village north ? ) , we lived in darkness . But on every rock there was a banyan tree and a village already . ||| Itla maiye Lgona-Mdona , Nohlumni-Ray Mietma , Watga'illi-Let Ra ' leta , it mori-tdarlia melmellikalkalamni . Mere la ' a rima-rima illi-watnu de nu'nu mutu-natar leta er olekla wa .
Our history says that concerning us our Luang ancestors knew how to pray ( lit . bow to the sky and cry out to the sun and moon ) , in the praying house . ||| Tui nakota de la ' a itla Lgon di , de ratu rwatniarla lyanit marna pa rhoilia wunu-rtanlia lera , la roma polwunu-waklera .
That is what strengthens us in our position , so that we can also talk about the One-and Only Son 's affairs . ||| Hade edmaka karurnian itla it hnia'argeni , pa itakot nohor walia Wutmueha-Lai mieha ha lollola .
Come let us use the Luang language to talk about Christ Jesus ! ||| Miai pia tal it yawala Lgonni ta takot nohora Yesus Makamori-kalewan de !
Just like the prophet Mika 's chapter , `` One 's crying over Samaria and Yerusalem saying : All of you on earth listen . God who dwells in the highest will come and stand to war with you . '' ||| Emaknekam de Makwohorullu-ktatrulu Mika wniahaurnu yanullu me ntatra yatnianila Samaria me Yerusalem de niwra : Makden nohkerna wawannu honomi mitlina : Orgahi-Orga ' a makdenla tutullulolo'oni hota nma Ntutrer wial pia miora mihuri-wiwo'ora .
The third verse says that He will come down from glory . ||| Tniatar lirni re'eni wotellu de niwra e Nwatiauwua hititni-lomomarni pa Nernu .
When we Luang people had not yet received the words of the book/Bible , our ancestors of long ago said that when the ancestor westerners brought this book of the good news , they used the words : `` Jesus has been already born . '' ||| Lgona ita edon tlernana ma'ta puka lirni , de it upni-tgarni lirni meman la ululu genni , de upa-wlada rodia puka kot kalwieda-paitiot di , de e riwra e rayor oleka Yesus .
But our Luang language in the traditional language says : The One-and Only Son descends . ||| Mere it yawala Lgonni la wniohor lir maranni de niwra : Wutmueha-Lai mieha ma Ntopru .
When we say descent , it means that , it is like we are talking about descending in battle . ||| La'pa itaweta tniopru , ha nnia'eratni de , emolmolan neka me itiwra maktopru la aralma .
The meaning of 'He descends ' is just like a person who is up high and jumps down . ||| Ntopru nnia'eratni emakwalime ri'ida ndella heyanan pa nehtiar lia yawa .
The book/Bible 's words truly go along/back up our Luang language . ||| Puka lirni toto meman pa nod niohor it yawala Lgonni .
Our Luang language helps to make clear God 's secret/deep words in the book/Bible . ||| It yawalla Lgonni re'ela nwahainiana Uplerlawna lir yade'eni-yamoyanni la ' a puka ralamni .
Let us use our Luang language to look closely into the book/Bible , just as if we were breaking it open . ||| Itala it yawala Lgonni tatwakerkar wutlia puka ralamni de , emolmolan nekame po ' a wnieta .
It is in the book/Bible it says : The Majus or in Malay it says ahli bintang/astronot , the term in the Luang language is : those who do unusual things , in traditional language we say those who can discern the early morning stars . ||| Etla puka ralamni de eniwra : Majus onde lirmelai niwra ahli bintang/astronot , yawala Lgona niwra makodia ukru-rehera , wniohora niwra makatu kakwieta lotielu lipni-rarlimna-laini .
Then when those who discern the early morning stars went to ask Herodes , the one in charge of the kingdom they asked saying : `` Where is the child that was just born ? ' ||| Noma la'pa makatu kakwieta lotielu lipni-rarlimna laini rla ' pa ratiana Herodes , maktorna lodna-hairi ratiana riwra : `` Keke'en maka na'nama ha rayorniande etla me ?
We come and ask for you to point out the place for us to go ( to find Him ) . ' ||| Ama matian pa mtiut geni totpa amla ' a .
Because He is the one who will go along the right path/path of righteousness and He only is the one who has power over this large number of Yehudi people . ||| Yoma ot E edmaka ktikiltarlia yeh tan miera , me khapar rerlia hlor wewnihi ne E ' nanpena edmaka kodi plolli la Yehudi riwnu-halli ri !
Herodes said : `` I do not know about it ! ' ||| Herodes niwra : `` Age uplin niohora de !
But if He really exists , then you tell me in order that I can worship him . '' ||| Mere la'pa plola pa etla , de mikot a ' tiotpena arie ' e la guh idma-riama lia'arni . ''
King Herodes himself did not even know . ||| Raye Herodes nmeh ' a nekade naplinga .
But those who really knew the scriptures knew because in the book/Bible it talks about Mika 's words in the fifth chapter and first verse saying : Oh Betlahem Efrata area , people say that you are the smallest of the villages in Yehudi . ||| Mere makanina-kamat niohora puka lirni de e ratga yoma la ' puka ralamni de ed makakot nohora Mika lirni re'eni wolimni tniatarni yanullu niwra : Hei Betlaham Efrata yapatni , riy riwra o kuku ' u-keke ' u maiya Yehudi ri letni re .
But later coming from this your small village/area I will raise one who is very great to rule over Israil who came from this village from of old . ||| Mere hota nwatiau let ku'umu di pa A ' u ariana metam keranni idla pa nodi plolli la Israil makatenna ulga let dilla ululu plialiani .
When Herodes heard that he was afraid , because of the prophet 's words , and we also are also afraid because in our words from the very beginning even , we say the One-and Only Son/Heir of the king will descend to the earth just like he is searching for war with those who do not respect God 's Words . ||| Herodies natlina de namta'ata , yoma makwohor ulu-ktatrulu lirni , ne itmana tamta'at wali yoma it lirni la ululu meman mana , itiwria Wut mueha-Lai mieha nma Ntopru la noh marna , de emakwalime e nahak ya'arni la ri ' maka edon kamta'ata Uplerlawna Mempulwatnu lirNi-tunNu .
If we think about the words that we have read in the book/Bible , let us not pretend that we do not know about the thinking that the One-and Only Son/Heir will descend on the earth . ||| La'pa itwarora lira-tun muak ha tpaiknana la puka ralamni ri , de yana seslia pa tiwa plinu-plo ' nek itla wniarora-wnialiai la Wutmueha-Lai mieha Ntopur la noh kerande wawannu .
Because He knows that we here in Luang , are fighting . ||| Yoma Enatga de ita maiyi Lgon di , de tlerla yahuri-yawo'ora .
We say that this Luang is what carries traditional true law but yet we seize each other 's possessions so that later the result will be that will not prosper ( lit . our sprouts will not grow into wide leaves which push up for the sky and our roots will not be long and grow deep into the ground ) . ||| Itiwra Lgon di ed makodia deulu-tatra plola-mneha mere twaldionia de tamat mera-tawul kgaulu pa hota narieiniande it uhwanu mana edona napniarwutlia wirtawi wewerna makokarla lyanti me mur la ' a plalahwa maka kwahipnila noha uwarnu .
Why are we not thinking about/paying attention to the words in the book/Bible which say the One-and-Only Son/Heir will descend bringing true judgment ? He will descend because He knows that we have run away already from peace . ||| Edona twarornana lira puka ralamni niwra Wutmeha-Lai mieha Ntopur de nodia kalwieda-paitiota rhinlel tiutu-relan mahmara yoma Natga de itawlar hal oleka kalwiedni-paitiotni ?
Let us pay attention to ( the needs of ) these widows and orphans ( the destitute ) here in Luang . ||| Twer it matni la a'na riyi patiata Lgona ri .
Let us not wait until full tide before we go fishing ( let us not put off helping them ) . ||| Yan itwei pia meti nhapenga nanpena itna'aili .
What about the widows/poor ? ||| Ne emkameni la a'na riyi patiata ?
Nets are all over the island , traps ? are killing octopus and shellfish , how about the many Luang people 's cry to the one who cares for people , the Creator and Sustainer ? ||| Dari nwewar noha , towa namatia krita-watrora , emkameni la Lgon uhunu riwni polpuolu wakwakni la maktera-kdema , makohi-kara , makawilla-kayomtia .
Jesus came to bring peace so that we do not argue about harvesting the reef . ||| Yesus Nmai die nodia kalwiedni pa yan tahuri-tawo'or nohora meti haru .
People from West Luang say it is their reef , People from East Luang say it is their reef . ||| Mutu Mnoa riwa ir metni , Enwiawna riwra ir metni .
The ancestors already created a boundary , but the young people are learning to seize other possessions . ||| Upa-tgara rhi ' taru-ryaptarg oleka watu niohora autiatra mere tuwuari-laweru rwatutlia matmera wulkgaulu .
History says that Luang 's navel-and Mnietu 's stomach are the ones that bring refreshment to Luang ( lit . island of our mothers-land of our fathers ) . ||| Tui nakottarga de Lgona ohorni-Mniet apannu ed makodia rinni-woki maiye Lgona Nohinna-Ray amni di .
West Luang , when they agreed traditionally , said that Enwiawna Mnietu are the ones to do the rebuking , but where is it ? ||| Mutu Mnioa la'pa rwa'ilga maranni de Enwiawna Mnietu edmaka kpolliohora , mere etla me ?
When West Luang and East Luang want to make rules about the reef , it is Letupnu that must rebuke , but where is it ? ||| Mutu Mnoa rora Enwiawna riwa rwanatarla metkierna wawannu , de Letupnu edmaka kpolliohora , mere etla me ?
In Psalms chapter twenty-two , verse twenty-eight it says : Do not move a boundary marker from old land concerning which you do not know the discussion from your ancestors time . ||| La ' Amsal wniahaurni re'eni teramporu wehrani woru tatarni teramporu wehrani wo'awa eniwra : Yana mpuatitnia rira tiemni-liannu la ' a tan ululu maka ha muplin niohora wniahaurnu la upmu-tgarmu lerni .
The Lord Jesus Christ says : I am descending to the earth , you know about Me because you have searched for My place ; the inns were too full for me therefore you found Me in the goat and sheep stable . ||| Orgahi-Orha ' a Yesus Makamori-kalewna Niwra : Atiopurla nohkerna wawannu , de mimiat niohor A ' u yoma mpiata'wa a ge'nu , de lep mutmu-lakpona rpennian A ' u pede mliernan alia pip-diuma lowanikrahani .
Your knowledge and insight found me in my mother 's lap . ||| Lirmi-yatmi ukru-rehermi rtutnian alia a i'nu riwni wawannu .
They have placed me in the sheep and goat 's place . ||| Rariwa-rahai alia pipi-wawi geni tienni .
The one who is all powerful/kings ( lit . holds the octopus head and the flags top ) also , they have not yet seen me so later I will return and come to meet you Luang people , I will be like a thief at night which you do not know about ! ||| Maktorna krita o'tani me hairi lia wuwannu mana , edona rkil mia't ma ' u pa hota Auwali pia Amua teman ti makdena Lgona miy die , hota A ' g emolmolla makwuri-makgalla la mela plinniohora !
Luang people pay attention ! ||| Lgon twahniorta !
True Peace to you . ||| Plola/Amin Itkalwiedni .
